title: Virtual Assistant
description:
## Virtual Assistant — GoHighLevel / Systems & CRM



**Part-Time | Up to 10 Hours/Week Initially | Potential Long-Term Role**



I’m looking for a highly organized, tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help me implement new systems into my established online fitness coaching business, **Dorian Core Performance**.



I recently joined the **IFCA (Impact Fitness Coaching Academy) Path to 4% mentorship program** and am working through their onboarding and systems implementation process.



My immediate priority is finding someone who can work alongside me to take IFCA's instructions, templates, documentation, and training and help me **implement them correctly and efficiently into my business.**



A major part of this will involve setting up and organizing my business inside **GoHighLevel**, working with **Skool**, completing Google Docs and onboarding documents, entering existing business data, and helping integrate IFCA's recommended systems into the way my business currently operates.



### You Must Be Experienced With:



* **GoHighLevel (GHL)** — most important

* **Skool**

* Google Docs / Google Drive

* CRM organization and management

* Data entry and documentation

* Following SOPs, training videos, and detailed instructions

* Systems implementation

* Excellent written English

* Strong organization and attention to detail



You don't necessarily need to design these systems from scratch. **IFCA provides the framework and instructions.** I need someone technically capable enough to understand those instructions, work through them with me, and implement everything correctly without needing constant hand-holding.



Experience working with **IFCA, online fitness coaches, or similar online coaching businesses would be a major advantage.**



### Schedule & Role



Initially, I expect this to be **10 hours per week or less**, with the heaviest workload occurring during the next few weeks while we complete the IFCA and GoHighLevel implementation.



You need to have some availability during **U.S. daytime/business hours** so we can occasionally work through implementation together in real time. I am flexible on exact hours, but I am not looking to conduct working sessions in the middle of the night U.S. time.



For the right person, this could develop into an **ongoing VA/operations position** within Dorian Core Performance, including responsibilities such as:



* CRM management

* Lead organization and follow-up

* Client onboarding

* Systems management

* Administrative support

* Maintaining business documentation and processes



### Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience. **I'm willing to pay toward the higher end for someone who is genuinely experienced, efficient, reliable, and highly capable with GoHighLevel.**



### When Applying



Please answer these questions:



1. How much experience do you have with **GoHighLevel**?

2. What have you personally built, implemented, or managed inside GHL?

3. How experienced are you with **Skool**?

4. Have you previously worked with **IFCA or an IFCA coaching business**?

5. Have you worked for an **online fitness coach or online coaching business** before?

6. What hours are you available to work with someone based in the United States?

7. What is your desired hourly rate?

8. Are you interested in potentially growing into a **long-term VA/operations role**?



**Please be specific about your GoHighLevel experience. I'm looking for someone who has actually worked inside the platform, not someone who is simply familiar with what it is.**

title: Weekend Operations & Customer Retention Specialist
description:
About SudDrop



SudDrop is a tech-enabled laundry pickup and delivery service operating in Halifax and Toronto, Canada. We're growing fast and building a lean, high-performing team to match.



About the role



This is a combined role covering two distinct functions each week:



Weekend Operations Management (Saturday–Sunday)



- Live oversight of weekend pickup and delivery operations

- Coordinating drivers, routes, and schedules during weekend business hours

- Handling day-of issues: delays, failed pickups, driver questions, rescheduling

- Monitoring on-time performance and driver utilization in real time



Customer Feedback & Retention Calls (Tuesday & Thursday)



- Calling customers post-order to gather feedback and encourage Google reviews

- Reaching out to customers who signed up but haven't ordered yet, to convert them with support and incentives

- Identifying opportunities to move satisfied repeat customers onto SudDrop's subscription plan

- Logging all calls and outcomes accurately in our systems



Requirements

- Must be available and working live during Atlantic Time (Canada) weekend business hours — this is a hard requirement, not flexible or asynchronous, regardless of your location

- Strong spoken English with a natural, warm phone manner — this role is customer-facing and relationship-driven, not just administrative

- Comfortable handling an unhappy or hesitant customer calmly and turning the conversation around

- Basic comfort with scheduling/dispatch tools and logging data accurately

- Reliable internet connection and quiet space for calls



Schedule

- Saturday & Sunday: live operations coverage during weekend business hours (Atlantic Time)

- Tuesday & Thursday: customer feedback and retention calls

Total: 4 days per week



Compensation

- All pay is in CAD

- Monthly set salary

- Plus bonuses if targets are met



What success looks like

- On-time pickup/delivery rate and driver utilization targets met on weekend shifts

- Low failed-pickup rate

- Consistent, accurate feedback call logging

- Meaningful conversion on customer reviews and subscription sign-ups from retention calls

title: Marketing Director For Real Estate Company
description:
🏡 **WE’RE HIRING: SOCIAL MEDIA & MARKETING DIRECTOR – REAL ESTATE**



**Real estate experience, strong knowledge of the real estate market, and a proactive mindset are highly important for this role.**



We’re a fast-growing real estate team looking for a **proactive, creative, and results-driven Social Media & Marketing Director** who understands the real estate industry and knows how to turn marketing into measurable business results.



We want someone who understands the **real estate market and the speed of the business**—new listings, open houses, price changes, closings, market updates, buyer and seller lead generation, agent recruiting, and everything in between.



### 💡 WE WANT SOMEONE WHO BRINGS IDEAS TO THE TABLE



This is especially important to us.



We are **not** looking for someone who simply waits for instructions or completes assigned marketing tasks.



We want someone who actively brings **ideas, recommendations, strategies, and new opportunities** to the team.



You should be comfortable looking at our current marketing and saying:



**“Here’s what we should improve.”**

**“Here’s an opportunity we’re missing.”**

**“Here’s a campaign we should try next—and here’s why.”**



We want someone who can identify opportunities, recommend strategies, develop campaigns, and take ownership of executing those ideas from start to finish.



If you think marketing is just making flyers and posting on social media, this role isn’t for you.



If you understand that:



**Marketing → Attention → Traffic → Leads → Conversions**



…keep reading.



### 📱 SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & MANAGEMENT



• Lead and manage our social media presence across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms

• Develop and execute a consistent social media and content strategy

• Create content that builds our brand, showcases listings and agents, educates consumers, and generates leads

• Proactively identify real estate trends, local market topics, and content opportunities

• Create and maintain an organized content calendar

• Monitor engagement, reach, traffic, follower growth, and conversions

• Recommend new content and campaign strategies based on performance

• Assist with paid social campaigns, retargeting, and boosted content

• Identify new platforms, formats, and strategies that could expand our reach



### 🌐 DIGITAL & WEBSITE MANAGEMENT



• Update and maintain the team website, including properties, landing pages, team information, and market content

• Optimize pages for lead capture and user experience

• Monitor website traffic and proactively recommend improvements

• Handle basic SEO optimization

• Manage or coordinate CRM forms, IDX, lead capture tools, and other website integrations

• Identify opportunities to improve website traffic and conversion rates



### 🏠 PROPERTY & AGENT MARKETING



• Develop marketing campaigns for new listings, open houses, price improvements, Just Listed, Under Contract, and Just Sold properties

• Create professional flyers, brochures, social media graphics, postcards, and other marketing materials

• Develop creative ideas for promoting listings beyond standard property posts

• Market our agents and team—not just our properties

• Coordinate and order sign riders, signage, postcards, brochures, and other print materials

• Maintain consistent branding across all marketing channels



### 📈 LEAD GENERATION & GROWTH



• Develop campaigns designed to generate buyer, seller, renter, landlord, and agent recruiting leads

• Drive qualified traffic from social media and digital campaigns to our website and landing pages

• Assist with paid advertising, retargeting, and audience development

• Track where traffic and leads are coming from

• Analyze results and continuously improve campaigns based on performance

• Regularly bring new lead-generation ideas and opportunities to the team

• Identify areas where we can improve conversion from attention → traffic → leads → clients



### 📧
 MARKETING



• Create and send consistent newsletters and marketing campaigns

• Develop campaigns for past clients, prospects, active leads, our database, and real estate agent recruiting

• Write engaging content featuring market updates, listings, real estate education, and team news

• Build, segment, and maintain
 lists

• Track open rates, click-through rates, responses, and conversions

• Test and improve subject lines, messaging, content, and calls to action

• Propose new
 campaigns based on opportunities within our database



### ⚙️ MARKETING OPERATIONS



• Own marketing timelines for new listings and campaigns

• Coordinate marketing vendors and maintain marketing inventory

• Support agent recruiting campaigns through digital, social, and
 marketing

• Keep projects organized and ensure deadlines are consistently met

• Identify opportunities and bring new marketing ideas to the team

• Take ownership of marketing projects from concept through execution and performance review



### 🎯 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Strong candidates should have:



• **Previous real estate marketing or social media experience**

• **Strong knowledge and understanding of the real estate market**

• Experience marketing real estate listings, agents, teams, or brokerages

• A **proactive mindset—you see opportunities and take initiative instead of waiting for instructions**

• Ability to regularly bring **new ideas, suggestions, strategies, and solutions** to the team

• Strong understanding of social media strategy, content creation, and audience growth

• Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools

• Experience managing or editing websites using WordPress, Squarespace, or similar platforms

• Experience with
 marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Constant Contact, or similar tools

• Working knowledge of SEO, lead generation, digital advertising, and analytics

• Ability to understand marketing performance beyond likes and followers

• Excellent organization and project-management skills

• Ability to manage multiple listings, campaigns, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously

• Strong written communication and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently while collaborating with agents and leadership



### ⭐ WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT



• Hands-on experience marketing for a **real estate team, brokerage, or successful real estate agent**

• Strong understanding of how buyers, sellers, renters, and homeowners engage with real estate content

• A track record of bringing new marketing ideas and turning them into successful campaigns

• Experience generating buyer and seller leads through social media and digital marketing

• Experience with Meta Ads, retargeting, and audience development

• Experience with real estate CRMs and IDX websites

• Strong portfolio of real estate social media, property, and branding campaigns

• Experience creating short-form video, Reels, and other video-first content

• Experience with agent recruiting campaigns

• Ability to analyze marketing data and turn it into actionable recommendations

• Ability to spot opportunities and say, **“Here’s what I think we should do next—and here’s why.”**



### 📊 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



This position will be measured by results, including:



• Increased qualified website traffic

• Consistent social media growth and meaningful engagement

• Increased inbound buyer, seller, and recruiting leads

• Strong and consistent brand presence

• High-quality listing marketing delivered quickly and on schedule

• Consistent
 campaigns with improving open and click-through rates

• Increased traffic and conversions from digital campaigns

• New marketing strategies and ideas being regularly introduced and tested

• Continuous improvement based on marketing performance and analytics



### 🚀 THE PERSON WE WANT



We want this person to become the **marketing expert on our team**—someone who understands real estate, understands our goals, and is constantly thinking about what we should be doing next.



You won't just be asked:



**“Can you make this?”**



We also expect you to come to us and say:



**“Here’s an idea.”**

**“Here’s what I noticed.”**

**“Here’s what we can improve.”**

**“Here’s what our competitors are doing.”**

**“Here’s what I recommend we do next.”**

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As the  Project Manager at Hatcher Construction, you serve as the operational bridge between field teams, project managers, subcontractors, and clients—ensuring all project documentation, schedules, and communication remain on track and clearly organized.

You’ll play a key role in coordinating the administrative and logistical backbone of each project—from permitting and procurement to change order documentation and progress tracking. This is an ideal position for a highly organized, construction-savvy professional who thrives on clarity, collaboration, and moving pieces into place with precision.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES AS A PROJECT MANAGER

Project Documentation & Communication

• Manage and maintain project documentation, including RFIs, submittals, drawings, and change orders

• Support project managers in updating schedules, look-ahead timelines, and job logs

• Manage permit status, inspection reports, and city correspondence

• Communicate with clients and trade partners regarding updates, deliverables, and documentation requests

Subcontractor Coordination & Compliance

• Collect and track all subcontractor insurance, licensing, and compliance forms

• Organize subcontractor documentation in Procore or shared platforms

• Support bid package distribution and subcontractor onboarding for new projects

Meeting Preparation & Support

• Assist in preparing agendas, distributing meeting minutes, and tracking action items

• Attend project meetings and coordinate follow-up assignments

FM

 

• Ensure deadlines for RFIs, submittals, and procurement are proactively managed

Procurement & Financial Admin Support

• Track purchase orders, material deliveries, and vendor invoices

• Coordinate material procurement timelines with field needs

• Support tracking of job costs and matching documentation to purchase orders and contracts

Technology & Digital Workflow

• Maintain and organize project data in Procore

• Keep drawing logs, document control logs, and project directories up to date

• Help ensure projects remain audit-ready and organized across phases

What Success in This Role Looks Like

• Project teams have seamless access to accurate, current documentation

• Subcontractor onboarding and compliance are consistently handled on time

• Project managers are supported with clear information and administrative backup

• Communication with clients and vendors is professional, timely, and proactive

• Construction projects remain coordinated, on track, and free of administrative bottlenecks

Ideal Candidate Profile

• 3–5 years of experience in construction project coordination or construction administration

• Excellent organizational and time management skills

• Strong familiarity with construction workflows, terminology, and documentation

• Proficient in Procore, Excel, Word, and digital filing systems

• Clear communicator with the ability to manage details and deadlines

• Professional, reliable, and confident under pressure

Character Qualities

• Positive attitude with a problem-solving mindset

• Strong team player with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• Respectful of confidentiality with sound business judgment

• Flexible and responsive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

• Dedicated work ethic with a commitment to excellence

• Initiative-taker who is proactive within their area of responsibility

FM

 

• Client-focused mindset with high emotional intelligence

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Executive Assistant to provide direct support to an executive in a fast-paced business environment.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing executive communications, calendars, scheduling, follow-ups, and administrative coordination. This individual must be highly dependable, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities with minimal supervision.



The Executive Assistant will serve as a key point of coordination across internal teams, external partners, vendors, candidates, and other stakeholders, ensuring that important communications, meetings, agreements, and action items are handled efficiently and professionally.



Key Responsibilities



Executive Support & Inbox Management

Manage and organize multiple
 inboxes, including executive and role-based inboxes.

Triage incoming
s, prioritize urgent and important matters, and ensure timely responses.

Draft and send professional correspondence on behalf of the executive.

Track open
 threads and proactively follow up to ensure matters are resolved.

Maintain inbox organization and filter promotional, marketing, and low-priority communications.

Identify items requiring executive attention and escalate appropriately.



Calendar & Scheduling Management

Own and manage the executive's calendar.

Schedule meetings, interviews, calls, and appointments across multiple stakeholders.

Coordinate availability and resolve scheduling conflicts.

Send calendar invitations and confirmations.

Communicate directly with internal and external parties to coordinate meetings and ensure schedules remain accurate and up to date.



Phone & Communication Support

Answer incoming calls professionally when required.

Make outbound calls on behalf of the executive.

Communicate with clients, candidates, vendors, partners, and other stakeholders.

Take accurate notes and ensure necessary follow-up actions are completed.



Contract & Agreement Coordination

Coordinate contracts and agreements through the review and signing process.

Manage and follow up on DocuSign agreements and other business documents.

Track outstanding agreements and ensure timely completion.

title: CRM + AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST — WORK DIRECTLY WITH THE CEO & BUILD THE FUTURE WITH US
description:
CRM + AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST — WORK DIRECTLY WITH THE CEO & BUILD THE FUTURE WITH US



Full-Time Remote | GoHighLevel + Funnels + Automations + AI



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to build a workflow in GoHighLevel.

We are looking for someone who is obsessed with figuring things out.

Someone who sees what is happening with AI right now and thinks:

“I want to learn everything I possibly can about this.”

Someone who hears about a new AI tool, automation, agent, or way of building something faster and immediately wants to test it.

Someone who doesn't wait for a YouTube tutorial to tell them exactly what to do.

They search.

They test.

They troubleshoot.

They ask AI.

They try again.

And eventually...

They figure it out.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.



THE OPPORTUNITY

Canine Conversions is a fast-growing marketing and business growth company that helps dog trainers generate leads, close more clients, and build better businesses.

We already use funnels, CRM systems, automations, paid advertising, AI, and sales systems every single day.

But we're going much deeper.

We want to integrate AI into more of how our company operates.

And I’m looking for someone who wants to help me build it.

You’ll work directly with me, the Founder & CEO, Jorge Mateo, initially helping me with internal Canine Conversions projects and a small number of client projects that we use to test and refine new systems.

This is NOT a role where you disappear into the background completing support tickets all day.

You’ll be helping us BUILD.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE BUILDING

Some weeks you might be:

• Building a new funnel inside GoHighLevel

• Creating lead follow-up automations

• Connecting forms, calendars, pipelines, triggers, SMS, and
 campaigns

• Using AI to help build landing pages and funnels faster

• Building AI-powered workflows

• Testing new AI tools to see whether they can improve our operations

• Connecting different software using Zapier, Make, APIs, or webhooks

• Helping us improve our lead qualification and appointment-setting systems

• Troubleshooting an automation that isn't working

• Taking something we're currently doing manually and asking:

“How can we automate this?”

And eventually:

“How can AI make this even better?”

You will also help test systems with select clients before we roll them out further.



YOU DO NOT NEED TO KNOW EVERYTHING

This is important.

I am NOT expecting you to already be an AI expert.

AI is changing too quickly for anyone to know everything.

What I care about much more is whether you are the type of person who actively searches for answers.

If I tell you:

“I want to see if we can build an AI agent that does XYZ…”

I don't want your first response to be:

“I've never done that before.”

I want it to be:

“I haven't done that before... but let me see if I can figure it out.”

That mentality matters more to me than knowing every piece of software on this job description.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR

You’ll probably love this role if you:

• Naturally enjoy technology

• Love AI and actively follow what is happening in the space

• Use ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools regularly

• Get excited when you discover a new AI tool

• Enjoy funnels, automation, CRM systems, and marketing technology

• Are constantly trying to make things faster or more efficient

• Google things you don't know

• Watch tutorials when you need to learn something

• Use AI to troubleshoot problems

• Take ownership instead of waiting to be told every next step

• Pay attention to details

• Test your work before saying it's finished

• Can communicate when you're stuck instead of disappearing

• Want feedback

• Are coachable

• Want to become extremely good at what you do

Most importantly:

You are CURIOUS.

You genuinely enjoy learning.



EXPERIENCE WE'D LIKE TO SEE

Ideally, you already have experience with CRM systems, funnels, marketing automation, or similar work.

Experience with any of these is a big plus:

• GoHighLevel (GHL)

• ClickFunnels

• Zapier

• Make

• APIs / Webhooks

• ChatGPT

• Claude

• AI agents

• AI workflow tools

• Landing page builders

•
/SMS automation

• Marketing funnels

• ClickUp

• Google Workspace

You don't need to know every tool.

I'd rather hire someone who knows 60% of this but is hungry to learn the other 40% than someone who knows everything today but has stopped learning.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



I don't want to hire someone who stays a “CRM Specialist” forever.

There is a much bigger opportunity here.

AI is going to completely change how businesses build funnels, follow up with leads, communicate with prospects, automate operations, and deliver services.

I want us on the front edge of that.

And I want someone next to me who wants to learn it too.

As your skills increase, your responsibilities can increase.

As your responsibilities increase, your compensation can increase.

And as we build more advanced AI systems inside Canine Conversions, there is an opportunity for this role to evolve into something much bigger:

CRM + AI Systems Specialist

Automation Builder

AI Implementation Specialist

AI Systems Manager

And eventually potentially someone who leads this area of the company.

I'm looking for someone who wants that kind of trajectory.



YOU'LL WORK DIRECTLY WITH THE CEO

You will work directly with me.

You'll see the problems I'm trying to solve inside the company.

You'll help me turn ideas into actual systems.

I'll show you what we're trying to accomplish from a marketing and business perspective, and you'll help figure out the technology and implementation behind it.

Sometimes I will know exactly what I want built.

Other times I may tell you:

“Here's the outcome I want. Let's figure out how to make it happen.”

If that sounds exciting instead of scary...

You're probably the type of person I'm looking for.



COMPENSATION & DETAILS

Position: CRM + AI Automation Specialist

Type: Full-Time Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday

Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time

Starting Compensation: $900/month

30-Day Performance Review: Compensation will be reevaluated based on your performance, skill level, reliability, communication, initiative, and contribution.

Reports Directly To: Founder & CEO, Jorge Mateo

There is room to grow here.

I don't want someone who stays at their starting salary while becoming dramatically more valuable to the company.

If you become more valuable, I want your role and compensation to reflect that.



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF...

You need extremely detailed instructions for every task.

You regularly say “I don't know how” without first trying to find the answer.

You don't enjoy learning new technology.

You avoid AI.

You copy/paste AI outputs without thinking.

You wait for someone else to catch mistakes.

You want to do the exact same tasks every day.

You are looking for the easiest possible remote job.

This probably won't be a good fit.



YOU SHOULD DEFINITELY APPLY IF...

You've ever spent two hours trying to make an automation work because you refused to let it beat you.

You have 15 tabs open because you're researching how to solve something.

You genuinely get excited about what AI will be capable of over the next few years.

You constantly think:

“There has to be a better way to do this.”

And then you try to build it.

That's the person I want to talk to.



HOW TO APPLY

Do NOT send us a generic copy-and-paste application.

Start your application with:

“I like figuring things out.”

Then answer these 5 questions:

1. What is the most advanced CRM, funnel, or automation you've personally built?

Tell us what it did, what tools you used, and what YOU personally built.

2. Tell me about something technical you didn't know how to do but figured out on your own.

What was the problem? How did you find the answer?

3. How are you currently using AI?

Tell us the AI tools you use and give us specific examples.

4. What is one AI tool, update, workflow, or technology you've discovered recently that you're excited about? Why?

5. Imagine I tell you:

“We have leads entering GoHighLevel. I want an AI system to qualify them, follow up with them, answer basic questions, and push qualified prospects toward booking a call.”

You have never built this exact system before.

Walk me through how you would figure out how to build it.

I'm less interested in whether your technical answer is perfect.

I want to understand how you THINK.



ONE LAST THING

This isn't a job for someone who just wants to check boxes.

We're building something.

AI is moving ridiculously fast, and I believe the people who become great at combining marketing + CRM + automation + AI over the next few years are going to become extremely valuable.

If you want to become one of those people...

And you want an opportunity where you'll actually be able to experiment, build, learn, make mistakes, improve, and work directly with the person making the decisions...

I want to hear from you.

title: Part-Time Foreclosure Data & Skip Trace Specialist (Real Estate, US Central Hours)
description:
Nationwide Equity LLC is a Texas real estate investment company. We buy homes and land headed to foreclosure across Texas, and our data team is what gets us to the seller before anyone else. We are hiring a part-time data specialist, 30 hours a week, to join that team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Pull the daily foreclosure notices for our Texas counties and upload every notice PDF to the correct Google Drive folder

- Enter new leads into our master Google Sheet using our column format, with no blanks and no typos in addresses, names or loan amounts

- Manually skip trace every lead in SkipGenie, one by one, and log phone numbers,
s and mailing addresses into the sheet and our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- On deceased-owner leads, go further: search obituaries and public records to identify heirs and family, then skip trace them too

- Research the 50 highest-priority leads of the day and write a short profile on each: amount owed, property details, liens or judgments, deceased-owner flag, and a plain summary of pros and cons

- Check the oldest deed-of-trust leads against obituary sites and flag likely deceased owners

- Monitor tax-sale postings from the two Texas tax law firms, PBFCM and Linebarger (
), and log new listings. PBFCM releases in the first half of each month; Linebarger posts on a rolling basis, so check it daily.

- Download the day's SkipGenie sheets and back them up to Google Drive

- Run a daily quality check on the sheet: duplicates, missing phone numbers, wrong county, bad formatting



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You have done manual skip tracing for a US real estate investor or wholesaler before. This matters more than anything else.

- You know Google Sheets well: filters, VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, basic formulas, keeping a shared sheet clean

- You have used SkipGenie, or a similar tool like PropStream, TLO, or BeenVerified, and GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

- Your written English is clear enough to write a two-paragraph property summary a US buyer can act on

- You can read county records, deeds of trust and foreclosure notices, or you pick that up fast. Familiarity with Texas tax sale sites such as PBFCM and LGBS is a plus.

- You are detail-obsessed. One wrong digit in a phone number wastes a cold caller's afternoon.



SETUP WE REQUIRE

- Fiber or wired internet, 25 Mbps or faster (send a speed test screenshot with your application)

- A backup connection such as pocket wifi or a mobile hotspot

- A computer with at least 8 GB RAM that can hold 15+ browser tabs without lagging

- A quiet workspace and reliable power



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- 30 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 6 hours a day inside 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time

- Steady pay on the 15th and 30th of every month

- 13th-month bonus

- Review at 90 days, raises tied to accuracy and output

- Full training on our exact workflow, and a direct line to the owner. Small team, no middle management.



HOW TO APPLY

 
 with the subject line "Foreclosure Data Specialist - [Your Name]" and include:

1. A few sentences on your manual skip tracing experience and the tools you used

2. Your resume

3. A screenshot of an internet speed test taken today

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test task: 10 real foreclosure leads to skip trace in SkipGenie and write up using our template. We pay $25 for the test whether or not you are hired. It takes about 3 hours.



Applications that do not follow the subject line format or skip the speed test will not be reviewed.

title: Real Estate Photo Editor
description:
Full-Time In-House Real Estate Photo Editor — Individual Applicants Only



Boardwalk Media Group is an established real estate media company based in Orange County, California. We photograph approximately 60 properties per month and are looking for one talented photo editor to join our team in a stable, long-term, full-time position.



This is not a freelance overflow project. We want to build a lasting working relationship with one editor who will learn our style, maintain consistency across every property, and take pride in the final product.



Important: No Agencies or Teams



This position is exclusively for an individual editor.



We are not accepting applications from:



* Editing agencies

* Editing teams

* Account managers or brokers

* Applicants who plan to subcontract or delegate the work

* Applicants sharing an OnlineJobs.ph profile with another person



The person we interview must be the person who personally completes every part of our editing work. Our files may not be downloaded, shared, or sent to anyone else for any reason.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Editing bracketed and flambient real estate photographs

* Blending ambient and flash exposures naturally

* Performing clean, realistic window pulls

* Correcting white balance and mixed-light color casts

* Maintaining consistent wall and room colors throughout an entire property

* Straightening vertical and horizontal lines

* Producing natural, accurate, high-end results without an artificial HDR appearance

* Removing minor distracting objects when requested

* Editing exterior, aerial, twilight, and detail photographs

* Creating virtual twilight images when requested

* Reviewing completed images for quality and consistency

* Following Boardwalk Media Group’s editing standards

* Completing revisions promptly when necessary

* Organizing, exporting, and uploading completed files

* Communicating clearly with our project coordinator and photographers

* Meeting daily turnaround deadlines



As you grow into the position, additional responsibilities may include final quality control and preparing completed jobs for client delivery.



Required Skills



You should have:



* Strong Adobe Photoshop skills

* Experience with layers, masks, actions, blending modes, and manual selections

* Experience editing real estate, architectural, interior, or similarly complex photographs

* A strong understanding of color correction and white balance

* The ability to make multiple rooms within the same property look consistent

* Careful attention to small details

* Reliable internet and a computer capable of processing large RAW and Photoshop files

* Good written English

* The ability to accept feedback and reproduce a specific editing style consistently

* The ability to work independently without passing assignments to anyone else



Experience with Adobe Lightroom, Camera Raw, Dropbox, Google Drive, and real estate delivery platforms is helpful.



What We Value



We are not simply looking for the fastest editor. We care about:



* Consistency from one image to the next

* Accurate colors

* Natural-looking windows

* Clean flash blending

* Reliability

* Honest communication

* Coachability

* Attention to detail

* A genuine interest in becoming part of one company long-term



We will provide examples, feedback, and training on our preferred style. However, applicants should already have solid Photoshop fundamentals.



Schedule and Availability



This is intended to become a full-time, long-term position. You must be consistently available during the agreed-upon working schedule and able to meet next-business-day delivery deadlines.



You may have personal projects or clients outside your scheduled working hours, but you may not perform other client work during the hours paid for by Boardwalk Media Group.



You may never delegate Boardwalk work to another editor—even if you are sick, unavailable, or experiencing a heavy workload. If a problem occurs, you must communicate directly with us so we can make other arrangements.



Hiring Process



Shortlisted applicants will complete the following process:



1. A live video interview

2. A live Photoshop screen-sharing exercise

3. A small paid take-home editing test

4. A paid probationary period with gradually increasing volume



During the interview, you will be asked to share your screen, open Photoshop, and explain your editing process. You may also be asked to show layered PSD files from previous work when permitted by your former clients.



The quality of your live editing exercise must be consistent with the quality of your portfolio and take-home test.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the exact words:



I AM THE EDITOR



Then answer every question below:



1. How many years have you personally edited photographs?

2. What types of photography have you edited?

3. How much real estate or architectural editing experience do you have?

4. How many real estate images can you personally edit in one working day?

5. How many clients are you currently editing for?

6. Does anyone ever assist you with downloading, blending, masking, retouching, quality control, exporting, or uploading your work?

7. If you become sick or overloaded, what do you normally do with your clients’ assignments?

8. Are you personally the owner and only user of your OnlineJobs.ph profile?

9. Are you comfortable completing a live Photoshop editing exercise while sharing your screen?

10. Are you looking for freelance projects or a stable full-time position with one company?

11. What computer, monitor, internet connection, and version of Photoshop do you use?

12. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?

13. What working hours are you available in Philippine time?

14. When would you be available to begin?



Please also include:



* A link to your real estate or architectural photography portfolio

* Three complete property examples, if available—not only your best individual images

* Before-and-after examples

* A screenshot of one of your layered Photoshop files

* A short video introducing yourself and explaining your normal editing process



Please do not send work belonging to another editor, employer, or team and represent it as your own.



Do not complete an unpaid sample edit. Applicants selected for the take-home test will receive test files directly from us and will be paid for completing the assignment.



Confidentiality and Personal-Work Requirement



The selected applicant will sign an agreement requiring that:



* All editing is personally performed by the hired editor

* No work is subcontracted or delegated

* Company and client files remain confidential

* Files are never shared with another person

* Company images are deleted from personal storage according to our file-retention policy

* Client names, property information, workflows, presets, and pricing remain confidential



Unauthorized sharing or subcontracting of our work will result in immediate termination.



If you are a skilled individual editor who wants consistent work, clear expectations, constructive feedback, and the opportunity to grow with an established company, we would like to hear from you.

- Maintain a live supplier database and landed-cost comparison sheet

- Flag risks early: long lead times, unstable pricing, customs problems



What I actually care about:

Not how many suppliers you can list. Anyone can send twenty Alibaba links.

I care how far you move a price after the first quote, and whether the

supplier you picked is still reliable on the third order.



Paid test task (I pay for it whether or not I hire you):

I'll send you one real product. You return, within 48 hours:

- 3 verified suppliers with quotes

- MOQ, lead time, and payment terms for each

- Full landed cost per unit

- Your recommendation and the reason behind it

- A short note on what you asked to move the price, and what you got



Pay: hourly during a paid two-week trial, then a fixed monthly rate.



To apply, start your message with ANCHOR and answer:

1. A negotiation you're proud of. Opening price, closing price, what you traded.

2. A supplier that went wrong on you. What was the warning sign you missed?

3. Which of the three lanes (China / Gulf / local) is your strongest, and which

   would you rather not handle? Honest answers rank higher than "all of them."

4. Your hourly rate and daily availability.

title: TikTok Shop Short-Form Video Editor – Beauty & Skincare
description:
I am looking for a creative and reliable short-form video editor to help me produce TikTok Shop affiliate videos in the beauty and skincare niche.



I will film and provide all the raw FACELESS product footage.

You will NOT be required to film content, appear on camera or create UGC yourself.

Your job is to take my raw footage and turn it into engaging, natural-looking short-form product videos that I can finish and post to TikTok Shop in the UK.

The videos should feel like natural TikTok creator content — not polished corporate advertisements.



What I Will Provide

For each product, I will provide a folder of raw vertical footage which may include:

Product close-ups

Hands holding the product

Opening/closing products

Pumps and droppers

Skincare texture shots

Product application

POV demonstrations

Bathroom/bedroom lifestyle shots

Product hero shots

Different camera angles

B-roll

Problem/solution footage where appropriate



The content will primarily be faceless.

I will also provide basic product information and guidance on the type of videos required.



Your Main Responsibility



Your most important job is to take a folder of raw footage and turn it into multiple DIFFERENT short-form videos.

For example, footage from one skincare product might become:

Problem → solution video

Product demonstration

Curiosity-led video

Benefits-focused video

Product-focused/conversion video



I do NOT want five nearly identical videos with minor changes.



You should be able to look at raw footage and identify different ways to tell the product story.



What You Will Do

You will be responsible for:



Reviewing the raw footage

Selecting the strongest clips

Creating strong opening visual sequences

Structuring each video to hold attention

Creating natural, fast-moving pacing

Cutting unnecessary footage

Creating smooth cuts

Using zooms/transitions only where appropriate

Creating product demonstrations

Creating problem → solution sequences

Creating different versions from the same raw footage

Basic colour/exposure correction where necessary

Exporting clean vertical 9:16 videos

Making reasonable revisions following feedback



Videos will generally be approximately 12–30 seconds, although length may vary depending on the product and concept.

You will also normally NOT need to add the final on-screen text unless requested.



You are welcome to suggest hooks, text or creative ideas, but I will control the final wording and TikTok sound used.



This means your main focus should be:



Clip selection + storytelling + pacing + retention + creative editing.



Editing Style

The videos should feel:



Natural

Authentic

Creator-style

Product-focused

Fast-moving

Scroll-stopping

Suitable for TikTok

Like genuine iPhone/UGC content



I DO NOT want:

Corporate-looking advertisements

Excessive transitions

Heavy effects

Over-editing

Generic templates used repeatedly

AI-looking videos

Highly polished commercial-style edits



Simple, natural and effective is better.



Experience I'm Looking For



Experience with the following is preferred:

CapCut

TikTok

TikTok Shop

UGC-style editing

Short-form product videos

Instagram Reels

YouTube Shorts

Beauty/skincare content

Direct-response or performance creative



You should understand that the first 1–2 seconds of a short-form video are extremely important.



Previous TikTok Shop experience is helpful but is NOT essential if your short-form editing skills are strong.



Working Relationship



I am looking for someone reliable who I can potentially work with long term.



Initially, this will be freelance/part-time work.



If we work well together and the content performs, there is potential for regular ongoing work and increased volume.



Communication, reliability and willingness to learn are very important to me.



Paid Trial

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a PAID editing trial.

Everyone completing the trial will receive the same raw footage.



You will be asked to create:



TWO different short-form product videos from the SAME raw footage.



The videos should have noticeably different:



Opening sequences

Clip selection

Structure

Storytelling approach

Pacing where appropriate



The purpose is to see how creatively you can use the same footage.



The trial videos should be delivered as clean edits without music or final on-screen sales text.



Full instructions will be provided.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your experience editing TikTok, TikTok Shop, UGC, Reels or other short-form videos.

Three examples of short-form videos that YOU personally edited.

At least one beauty, skincare or product-demo example if available.

Your usual turnaround time.

Your preferred hourly rate and/or per-video rate.

Tell me briefly:



What makes the first 2 seconds of a TikTok product video effective?



Please start your application with:



GLOW EDITOR



This confirms that you have read the full job description.



I am looking for someone who wants to develop a reliable, long-term working relationship rather than simply complete a one-off editing job.

title: Pricing Research & Shopify Product VA — Luxury Fashion (Long-term)
description:
We run international luxury fashion e-commerce stores (Shopify, selling to Europe, US, and Australia). We need a careful, detail-obsessed VA for a LONG-TERM role. One person, growing responsibility, no churn — our longest team members have been with us for years.



THE WORK (about 20 hrs/week to start):

1) Weekly competitor price research (the core of the job): for a list of luxury products (Canada Goose, Lemaire, Zegna, Loro Piana, etc.), find the LOWEST LEGITIMATE price online — brand-new condition only, from official brand sites or authorized retailers. You must reject secondhand/resale sites (eBay, Vestiaire, StockX, etc.) and suspicious "outlet" sites. You deliver an evidence spreadsheet: our price, competitor URL, their price, whether it's a sale price, and your recommendation. Accuracy matters more than speed — every price you report must be real and verifiable.

2) Shopify product work (occasional): adding/editing products — photos (light background, clean), descriptions, tags, SEO fields, metafields, CSV uploads.



We encourage using AI tools (ChatGPT etc.) to work faster — but every fact and price must be verified by you on the actual retailer page. 



REQUIREMENTS:

- Experience with e-commerce product research or competitive pricing (or provable ability to learn it fast)

- Shopify admin experience

- Meticulous: you keep change logs, double-check your work, and tell us early if something will be late

- VPN (or willingness to set one up) to check European/US market prices

- Good written English; some working-hours overlap with Hong Kong time

- Long-term intent — we are not looking for a 3-month gig



PAY: $7–10/hour USD depending on experience (≈ $600–850/month at 20 hrs/week), paid reliably. Hours can grow toward full-time as we add stores.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — applications that skip this are rejected without being read):

Start your application with the single word CROISSANT, then answer these 4 questions. Short, specific answers beat long generic ones.

Q1. Name at least 3 websites you would NOT trust when researching competitor prices for new luxury goods, and why.

Q2. Mini-task (10–15 min): Find the lowest legitimate price for the "Canada Goose Women's Expedition Parka" — new condition, from the brand or an authorized retailer. Paste: the URL, the price, and one sentence on why you trust that retailer.

Q3. Your longest client engagement: how long, what you did, why it ended. Plus: how many hours/week you can commit now, and what times of day you work.

Q4. How do you use AI in your work today? And would you trust an AI chatbot's answer about a competitor's current price — why or why not?



We reply to shortlisted applicants within 2 weeks. This is a stable, long-term seat for someone who takes pride in being exact.

title: Video / Reels Editor + Social Media Creative Designer
description:
Video / Reels Editor + Social Media Creative Designer

We are looking for a highly creative Video Editor and Social Media Creative Designer who can produce high-quality video, advertising creatives and social content across multiple brands and accounts.



This role is ideal for someone who combines strong natural creative ability with modern AI-powered production workflows.



You should be equally comfortable editing a high-performing Reel, designing an advertising creative, planning a storyboard, writing hooks and generating video or image assets using the latest AI tools.



What You’ll Be Doing

You will create content across multiple social media and advertising platforms, including:



Instagram Reels

 and Meta ads

TikTok videos

YouTube Shorts

LinkedIn video and social content

Static advertising creatives

Carousels

Social media graphics

Promotional videos

Product videos

Explainer videos

Campaign creatives

Video ads

Creative variations for A/B testing

Video Editing

You should have strong natural video editing ability and understand:



Pacing

Storytelling

Hooks

Retention

Transitions

Sound design

Music selection

Motion graphics

Captions and subtitles

B-roll

Visual hierarchy

Short-form social video structure

You should understand what makes content feel native to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use editing software. You should have a strong instinct for what makes a video engaging.



Graphic Design & Social Creatives

Strong graphic design skills are also essential.



You should be able to create:



Meta ad creatives

LinkedIn ads

Social media graphics

Carousels

Promotional graphics

Display ads

Campaign concepts

Branded social content

Multiple creative variations for testing

You should have a good eye for:



Typography

Layout

Colour

Branding

Composition

Visual hierarchy

Advertising design

AI Video & Image Generation

A major part of this role will involve using AI to improve both the quality and scale of creative production.



You should be comfortable using or learning modern AI creative tools such as:



Seedance 2.5

Higgsfield

Kling

Veo

Runway

Midjourney

Flux

Nano Banana

ChatGPT

Claude

Other emerging image and video generation models

You should understand or be willing to learn:



Text-to-video

Image-to-video

AI-generated B-roll

Reference image workflows

Character consistency

Product consistency

Style consistency

Prompt engineering

Iterative creative generation

AI-assisted storyboarding

AI-assisted editing

We especially want someone who can think beyond generating one image or one video at a time.



The goal is to build repeatable creative workflows that allow us to produce high-quality content at scale.



For example:



Generate multiple video concepts from one campaign brief

Produce 10-20 variations of a winning ad

Create different hooks for the same video

Generate AI scenes and B-roll

Adapt creatives for different audiences

Adapt creatives for different countries

Produce multiple formats and aspect ratios

Build reusable prompts and workflows

Combine AI generation with traditional video editing and design

Marketing & Psychology

You should have a good understanding of marketing and why people respond to advertising.



Useful knowledge includes:



Consumer psychology

Direct-response marketing

Attention and retention

Emotional triggers

Pain points

Benefits vs features

Social proof

Offers

Calls to action

Advertising hooks

Creative testing

Conversion-focused content

You should be able to understand a product or service and think about how it should be presented visually and verbally.



Copywriting & Storyboarding

You do not need to be a dedicated copywriter, but you should be able to write strong:



Video hooks

Headlines

Captions

Calls to action

Short scripts

Ad concepts

Storyboards

You should understand structures such as:



Hook → Problem → Emotion → Solution → Proof → CTA



You should be able to take a marketing idea and turn it into a structured video concept.



Creative Production at Scale

We manage multiple campaigns, brands and markets, so we are particularly interested in people who can think in terms of creative systems.



Rather than producing one ad at a time, you should be able to think like this:



5 different hooks

4 visual concepts

3 messaging angles

3 CTAs

Multiple formats

and turn them into a large number of structured creative variations for testing.



The ability to maintain quality while producing creative at speed is very important.



Preferred Tools

Experience with some of the following is useful:



Adobe Premiere Pro

After Effects

Photoshop

Illustrator

CapCut

DaVinci Resolve

Canva

Figma

Seedance

Higgsfield

Kling

Runway

Veo

Midjourney

Flux

ChatGPT

Claude

You do not need to know every tool listed.



Strong creative judgement, adaptability and the ability to learn new tools quickly are more important.



Who We’re Looking For

You would be a strong fit if you:



Have excellent visual taste

Are a strong video editor

Understand short-form social video

Can create professional advertising graphics

Understand social media culture

Understand basic marketing psychology

Can write strong hooks

Can storyboard video concepts

Are comfortable using AI image and video tools

Can create multiple creative variations quickly

Understand performance marketing and creative testing

Can work independently

Learn new tools quickly

Care about both creative quality and commercial results

Portfolio Required

Please send examples of:



Short-form videos or Reels you have edited

Video ads you have created

Social media or advertising graphics

AI-generated video or image work, if available

When Applying

Please answer the following:



1. Send us your three best examples of short-form video editing.



2. Send us three examples of advertising or social media creatives you designed.



3. Which AI video generation tools have you used?

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
- Customer Success Manager (Wholesale and B2B) for US Headwear Brand) - 



About Lift Down



Lift Down is a premium headwear brand based in New York City. We make unbranded, better-fitting caps in three real sizes and sell them direct to consumers and to businesses that want custom embroidered caps for their teams, events, and merch. More than 500 companies have ordered from us, including Google, Shopify, The Ritz-Carlton, and Stanford University.



Our wholesale side is growing fast. We now handle around 125 wholesale and custom orders every month, and we need someone whose full-time job is making sure those customers feel looked after and come back.



## The role



This is a customer relationship role with two halves.



1. Wholesale customer success

- Reach out to every new wholesale customer after their order ships to make sure it arrived and they are happy with it

- Check in with existing accounts on a regular schedule (30, 60, 90 days and beyond) to see how the caps are being used, whether they need a reorder, and whether anything went wrong that we should fix

- Keep our CRM accurate and up to date for every wholesale account, including contact details, order history, notes from each conversation, and next follow-up dates

- Spot reorder opportunities (events coming up, new hires, seasonal needs) and bring them to the team

- Flag any issue, complaint, or at-risk account to the founders right away

- Work closely with the Lift Down team to learn our communication style and upsell tactics, and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and what they need



### 2. Instagram B2B outreach: Many businesses follow our Instagram after seeing one of our B2B ads. They are interested but not ready to order yet, or they mean to come back to our custom cap configurator and forget. Your job is to catch them before they go cold.



- Monitor new followers, likes, comments, saves, and DMs every day and identify which ones are business accounts, brands, agencies, or companies

- Assess whether an account is a legitimate business worth pursuing (real website, real team, real activity) versus a fake, spam, or irrelevant account

- Reach out to qualified accounts by DM or
, introduce Lift Down, and offer a blank sample cap so they can feel the quality

- Point them to our self-serve custom cap configurator and help them get started

- Log every lead in the CRM with a status and a follow-up date, and follow up on schedule until they order or clearly decline

- Report weekly on how many accounts you reached out to, how many replied, how many requested samples, and how many placed an order



## What we are looking for



- At least 2 to 3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or B2B sales, ideally for an ecommerce or product brand

- Sales experience is important. A big part of this role is turning interested followers into customers and existing customers into repeat customers, so you need to be comfortable asking for the order

- Excellent written English. You will be writing to US business owners, marketing managers, and procurement teams every day, and your messages need to read as clear, warm, and professional

- Able to write without relying on AI. Our customers should never feel like they are talking to a bot, so you need to be able to write messages in your own voice and style, without running everything through ChatGPT first. AI tools are welcome for working through complex problems or tightening up a sentence now and then, but your English has to be strong enough to stand on its own

- Hands-on experience keeping a CRM organized (any CRM is fine as long as you are disciplined about it)

- Comfortable doing outreach on Instagram and by
, and comfortable with polite persistence

- Good judgment about people. You can tell the difference between a real company and a time-waster, and you know when to push and when to back off

- Organized and self-directed. You will own your own follow-up calendar and nobody will chase you on it

- A real understanding of how different kinds of businesses work and buy. A 10-person startup, a marketing agency ordering for a client, a hotel, a university, and a Fortune 500 procurement team all have different needs, timelines, and decision makers, and you should be able to adjust how you talk to each one

- Comfortable dealing with large companies. Some of our customers are S&P 500 companies, and you need to be able to hold a professional conversation with them without being intimidated or overly casual

- Familiarity with Shopify is a plus

- Full alignment with the US Eastern schedule. You need to be online and available from at least 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



## Who you are



- Communication is the most important trait for this role. You write clearly, you listen well, and people enjoy hearing from you

- You understand how business relationships actually work. Trust is built over time, not in one message, and a customer who feels remembered is a customer who reorders

- Adaptable and a quick learner. We are a fast-growing company and things change often. You pick up new tools and processes quickly and you are not thrown off when priorities shift

- Comfortable with ambiguity. You will not always have a script, and you are fine figuring things out and asking good questions



## What you get



- A long-term, full-time role with a small team where your work is visible and directly affects the business

- Direct access to the founders. No layers of management

- A clear playbook for the customer journey, plus the freedom to improve it



## How to apply



We would rather read a few strong applications than a hundred generic ones, so please do the following.



(1) Put the words CLASSIC CAP at the start of your application subject line so we know you read this far.



Then, in your application, answer this question in a few sentences. Do not send a template or a copied cover letter.



(1) Tell us about a time you re-engaged a customer or client who had gone quiet. What did you say and what happened?



Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.

title: Full-Time Content Operations & Executive Assistant for MacSparky
description:
A Note From David



Hi!



I’m David Sparks, the creator of MacSparky. I publish podcasts, videos, newsletters, online courses, and a private membership community focused on technology and productivity.



I’m looking for an organized, enthusiastic person who can help keep this work moving and gradually take ownership of the operations surrounding it. If you’re kind, tech-curious, careful with details, and excited to learn, I’d love to hear from you. You do not need prior media-production or editing experience.



This is a full-time role where you would help with things like:

 • Owning my content and social-media calendars

 • Turning finished videos, newsletters, podcasts, and member material into useful social posts

 • Publishing approved social posts and checking the live results

 • Preparing weekly and monthly member updates for publication

 • Performing light audio cleanup after training

 • Coordinating assets, deadlines, and handoffs with my existing editors

 • Helping with research, scheduling, and follow-up as you learn the business



I already work with professional editors for involved projects, and I have someone producing video Shorts. I need someone who can handle the many details around the content, publish the rest of the social package, and close the open loops so I can focus on creating useful work.

As you learn my preferences and demonstrate good judgment, the role can expand into more scheduling, research, project coordination, and executive-assistant work.

Perhaps, most importantly, I’m looking for someone who wants to be a legitimate part of what I’m making here and help me make it better. No Dementors!



Responsibilities



Content operations: Keep recurring projects organized and moving, with accurate status, complete assets, clear deadlines, and sensible next steps.



Social media: Adapt approved videos, blog posts, newsletters, podcasts, and member material into platform-appropriate written posts and simple static graphics. Schedule or publish approved posts, verify the live copy, artwork, tags, and links, and maintain the social calendar. Coordinate finished video Shorts with the existing producer. Creating or editing those Shorts is outside this role.



Content publishing: Review drafts for weekly and monthly member updates, correct the writing, verify that nothing is missing, check every link, stage or schedule the finished posts, and inspect the published result. Format and stage approved blog posts and pages when needed. No coding experience is required.

Light media production: Perform simple, repeatable audio edits after training, including podcast ad reads and a weekly audio report. Simple video editing may become part of the job later if it proves to be a good fit. Prior editing experience is not required.



Project coordination: Gather files, artwork, links, sponsor copy, and other required assets. Prepare complete handoffs for professional editors and follow up on missing pieces.



Research and support: Help research content topics, products, services, meetings, and business questions. Bring back a concise recommendation rather than a pile of unfiltered links.



Systems: Work from a shared task list, maintain the production calendar, and turn recorded walkthroughs into clear checklists and standard operating procedures.



Sounding board: Provide honest feedback on my ideas and point out missing details or avoidable problems.



Executive assistance: As trust develops, help with scheduling, travel research, routine correspondence, outside-party follow-up, and other administrative work.



How We’ll Work



I will teach unfamiliar workflows by recording myself doing the work and explaining my decisions. You will turn those walkthroughs into clear instructions, use them, and improve them as the process becomes familiar.

We already use AI for transcription, research, and routine processing. You should be comfortable checking AI output carefully and carrying the work through to completion. The job is finished when the deliverable is correct, organized, published or staged, and verified.



Early work will receive close review. As you learn my preferences, that review should become shorter. Collect questions and bring them to scheduled check-ins with enough context and a recommended next step whenever possible.



You May Be a Good Fit If You

 • Communicate clearly in written and spoken English.

 • Notice missing files, bad links, awkward wording, caption errors, and other details before someone points them out.

 • Can follow a process while also recognizing when the process needs improvement.

 • Work independently, keep files organized, meet deadlines, and report problems early.

 • Are comfortable receiving specific feedback and applying it to the next project.

 • Are enthusiastic about learning new software, including social-publishing and simple editing tools.

 • Have a reliable computer (Preferrably a Mac), stable internet connection, and a quiet workspace.



Familiarity with media tools, Canva, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Gling, Riverside, or similar software is useful but not necessary. Curiosity and a track record of learning new tools are more important.



Compensation and Benefits

 • $800–$1,000 USD per month, based on experience and demonstrated ability

 • 13th-month pay

 • Paid Philippine holidays

 • 10 paid vacation days each year

 • 5 paid sick or personal days each year

 • Compensation review after six months

 • Company-controlled accounts and paid access to the software required for the job



How to Apply



Use the subject line Content Operations Application – [Your Name] and include:

 1 A short introduction explaining why this combination of content operations, social media, and assistant work interests you.

 2 One or two examples of work you have organized, improved, or carried through to completion. These do not need to be media projects. Explain exactly what you did.

 3 Imagine you receive a finished blog post, newsletter, or podcast episode. Briefly explain how you would turn it into several useful social posts while keeping the original voice and checking that every post went live correctly.

 4 A short description of how you approach learning unfamiliar software or a new repeatable process.

 5 An example of a mistake, missing asset, or other problem you caught before anyone else noticed it.

 6 Your current work schedule, computer setup, internet reliability, and preferred monthly compensation.

We’re looking for a **Video Editor** to help us turn our weekly coaching and sales calls into high-quality content for YouTube, social media, our client Learning Center, and podcast platforms.



We’re looking for someone who can watch long-form content, understand what is being discussed, identify the strongest moments, and turn them into clean, engaging content.



*What You'll Be Editing



We have several recurring calls each week:



**Tuesday – Coaching Calls**



* Edit the full coaching call for our Learning Center and YouTube

* Incorporate presentation slides/PPTs

* Identify strong moments for short-form social media content

* Identify client wins and testimonials that can become standalone content



**Thursday – Deal Desk**



* Turn each deal/case discussed into a standalone YouTube video

* Extract strong short-form clips from the conversation



**Friday – Live Call Reviews**



* Turn reviewed calls into standalone YouTube videos

* Identify useful or interesting moments for social media



**Podcast**



* Prepare clean audio versions of long-form content for podcast distribution



*What We're Looking For



You should be able to:



* Edit long-form YouTube content

* Create engaging short-form videos for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

* Remove filler, pauses, repetition, and unnecessary sections while preserving context

* Create clean, professional on-screen captions

* Work with presentation slides and other supporting visuals

You need to be able to watch a conversation and recognize:



* A strong insight

* A useful lesson

* An interesting story

* A client win

* Have experience editing podcasts, coaching content, business content, interviews, or educational videos

1. A short introduction

2. Links to 2–3 examples of your best work

3. At least one example of long-form YouTube or podcast editing, if available

4. At least one example of short-form content you've edited
