title: YouTube Virtual Assistant / YouTube Growth Specialist
description:
# YouTube Virtual Assistant / YouTube Growth Specialist



## About the Channel



I'm looking for a reliable, proactive and ambitious **YouTube Virtual Assistant / YouTube Growth Specialist** to help manage and grow my YouTube channel, **Rexy Breaks It Down**.



The channel focuses on fascinating topics surrounding wealth, luxury, billionaires, powerful families, secret societies, ultra-rich lifestyles and other high-interest subjects.



Our content primarily follows a **"7 Levels" format**, breaking down a topic from the lowest level to the most extreme.



I'm looking for someone who doesn't just want to complete tasks, but wants to actively contribute to the growth and success of the channel.



---



# The Role



This is more than a simple video uploading position.



I am looking for someone who can help manage the channel, monitor performance, identify opportunities and actively suggest improvements.



You should think like a **YouTube Growth Specialist**.



The goal is to find someone who can eventually become an important part of the channel and grow together with the business.



---



# Main Responsibilities



## 1. Uploading & Publishing Videos



You will be responsible for making sure videos are consistently uploaded and published correctly and on time.



The channel currently aims to publish approximately:



### **3 videos per week**



Your responsibilities include:



* Uploading videos to YouTube

* Scheduling videos correctly

* Making sure videos are published on time

* Uploading the correct thumbnail

* Adding titles and descriptions

* Optimizing metadata and relevant keywords

* Selecting the correct playlists

* Adding end screens and cards where appropriate

* Checking subtitles or captions when available

* Checking monetization and video settings

* Performing a final quality check before publishing



Reliability is extremely important. Videos should always be uploaded and scheduled correctly.



---



# 2. Video Optimization



Every video should be properly optimized to give it the best possible chance of performing well.



This includes:



* Reviewing and optimizing video titles

* Reviewing titles for clickability and audience appeal

* Optimizing descriptions and metadata

* Reviewing thumbnails before publishing

* Making sure the title and thumbnail work well together

* Identifying opportunities to improve video packaging

* Suggesting alternative titles when necessary

* Suggesting thumbnail improvements

* Optimizing videos after publishing when opportunities are identified



I don't want someone who simply uploads the files and moves on.



I want someone who actively thinks about:



**"How can we give this video the best possible chance to perform?"**



---



# 3. Channel Monitoring & Analytics



You will regularly monitor the performance of the channel and individual videos.



Important metrics include:



* CTR (Click-Through Rate)

* Impressions

* Views

* Average view duration

* Audience retention

* Watch time

* Subscriber growth

* Traffic sources

* Overall video performance



You should actively look for patterns and opportunities.



For example:



* Why is one video performing better than another?

* Which titles are generating the highest CTR?

* Which thumbnails are working?

* Which topics are performing best?

* Which videos are underperforming?

* Where are viewers dropping off?

* What can we improve?



You don't need to simply report the numbers.



I want you to analyze what is happening and make recommendations.



---



# 4. Improving Underperforming Videos



Part of your role will be identifying videos that are not performing as well as expected.



When appropriate, you should suggest improvements such as:



* Better titles

* Alternative titles

* Thumbnail changes

* Improved packaging

* Metadata improvements

* Other optimization opportunities



The goal is to continuously improve the channel rather than simply uploading a video and forgetting about it.



---



# 5. Topic Research



Topic research will be an important part of your role.



You will help research and identify:



* New video topics with strong potential

* Topics with proven audience demand

* Trending topics within our niche

* Successful competitor videos

* Topics that are currently gaining momentum

* Opportunities that fit the Rexy Breaks It Down format



I prefer research based on **actual YouTube performance and evidence**, rather than simply brainstorming random ideas.



For example:



* What similar videos are currently getting views?

* What topics have recently performed well?

* Which competitors are growing?

* Which subjects have proven audience demand?

* What titles are working?

* Are there successful ideas that can be adapted to our format?



You should regularly bring researched topic ideas and opportunities to me.



---



# 6. Competitor & Trend Research



You will also monitor relevant competitors and trends.



This includes:



* Following relevant YouTube channels

* Monitoring what competitors are uploading

* Identifying successful videos and topics

* Analyzing titles and thumbnails

* Looking for emerging trends

* Identifying opportunities before they become oversaturated

* Finding successful formats that could inspire new content



The goal is not to copy other channels.



The goal is to understand what audiences are currently interested in and identify opportunities that make sense for Rexy Breaks It Down.



---



# 7. Proactive Channel Growth



This is one of the most important parts of the position.



I am **not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions**.



I want someone who takes initiative.



If you notice an opportunity, problem or potential improvement, I want you to bring it to my attention.



Ideally, your communication should look something like this:



**"I noticed this video is underperforming compared to similar videos. I believe the main reason could be the title and thumbnail. Here are three improvements I recommend."**



I want someone who actively:



* Looks for opportunities

* Analyzes performance

* Identifies problems

* Suggests solutions

* Brings new ideas

* Monitors competitors

* Researches new opportunities

* Helps improve the overall channel strategy



Think like a **YouTube Growth Specialist**, not simply an uploader.



---



# Working Hours



The position will initially start at approximately:



### **5 hours per week**



The workload will initially focus on:



* Approximately 3 video uploads per week

* Upload optimization

* Channel monitoring

* Basic performance analysis

* Improvement suggestions

* Topic and competitor research



However, the channel is growing and we are planning to expand the content production significantly.



Therefore, there is strong potential for the number of hours and responsibilities to increase quickly.



The ideal candidate should be interested in a **long-term collaboration** and preferably have the availability to take on additional hours as the channel grows.



---



# What I'm Looking For



The ideal candidate:



* Has experience working with YouTube channels

* Understands YouTube Studio and Analytics

* Understands CTR and audience retention

* Understands what makes titles clickable

* Understands thumbnails and video packaging

* Has experience with YouTube optimization

* Can conduct topic and competitor research

* Is proactive and independent

* Pays close attention to detail

* Is reliable and organized

* Can consistently meet deadlines

* Communicates clearly in English

* Is interested in YouTube growth and content strategy



Experience with tools such as the following is a plus:



* vidIQ

* TubeBuddy

* Nexlev

* YouTube Analytics

* Other YouTube research or optimization tools



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



This position is intended to become a **long-term collaboration** for the right person.



We are currently starting with approximately **5 hours per week**, but the channel is expanding quickly and the workload is expected to increase.



The right candidate will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and potentially become a larger part of the channel's operations.



As the channel grows, the role may expand into:



* More channel management

* More uploads

* Advanced analytics

* Growth strategy

* Topic research

* Competitor analysis

* Content strategy

* Channel optimization



I want to find someone who can **grow together with the channel**.



---



# When Applying, Please Include



Please answer the following:



1. Tell me about your experience managing YouTube channels.

2. Have you worked with channels similar to this before?

3. Please share examples of channels you have worked on, if possible.

4. What experience do you have with YouTube Analytics?

5. How do you analyze CTR and audience retention?

6. What experience do you have with optimizing titles and thumbnails?

7. How do you normally research new YouTube video topics?

8. Which tools do you use for YouTube research and optimization?

9. How would you identify opportunities to grow a YouTube channel?

10. Are you available to take on more hours as the channel grows?

11. What is your hourly rate?



### Important Question:



**If you were hired today, what would be the first three things you would analyze or improve on a YouTube channel?**



I'm looking forward to finding someone proactive, reliable and ambitious who wants to help grow **Rexy Breaks It Down** into a much larger channel.

title: Virtual Bookkeeping Lead
description:
# Experienced U.S. Bookkeeper / QuickBooks Online Specialist



**Remote | Full-Time or Long-Term Role**

**Compensation: Up to $1,200 USD/month**



Phænix Advisory Services is a boutique CPA and advisory firm based on the U.S. West Coast. We work with small businesses, business owners, and real estate investors.



We are looking for an experienced **U.S. Bookkeeper / Accounting Assistant** to join our team.



This is **not a general virtual assistant position**. We are looking for someone with strong hands-on bookkeeping experience, especially with **QuickBooks Online and U.S.-based clients**.



## What You’ll Do



You will help manage the bookkeeping for a portfolio of small-business clients.



Responsibilities include:



- Monthly bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online

- Bank and credit card reconciliations

- Transaction categorization and review

- Balance sheet account review

- Accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Payroll reconciliation

- Basic journal entries

- Loan and fixed asset tracking

- 1099 vendor tracking and support

- Month-end close procedures

- Cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping

- Preparing Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports

- Identifying accounting errors or unusual transactions

- Requesting missing information from clients

- Maintaining organized workpapers and documentation

- Communicating with our internal accounting team



Our clients may include small businesses, LLCs, S corporations, real estate investors, and rental-property owners.



## Required Experience



You should have:



- **3+ years of professional U.S. bookkeeping experience**

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience

- Experience managing multiple small-business clients

- Strong bank and credit card reconciliation skills

- Understanding of U.S. bookkeeping and accounting principles

- Experience reviewing Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to identify problems instead of simply processing transactions

- Strong written English communication

- Reliable internet and remote-work setup

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- Availability for some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



## Preferred Experience



Bonus points if you have:



- 5+ years of bookkeeping experience

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

- Experience working for a U.S. CPA or bookkeeping firm

- Experience with LLCs and S corporations

- Real estate or rental-property bookkeeping experience

- Cleanup/catch-up bookkeeping experience

- Month-end closing experience

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and 1099 reporting



## Who We’re Looking For



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to enter transactions.



We want someone who can look at a set of books and recognize when something **doesn’t make sense**.



You should be:



- Diligent

- Dependable

- Detail-oriented

- Organized

- Hard-working

- Comfortable asking questions

- Able to follow procedures

- Able to work independently

- Accountable for deadlines and quality



Accuracy and quality are extremely important to us.



## Schedule



This is a fully remote position.



Because our firm is based on the U.S. West Coast, you must be able to maintain some reasonable working-hour overlap with **Pacific Time**.



Exact hours can be discussed.



## Compensation



**Up to $1,200 USD per month**, depending on experience, skill level, availability, and responsibilities.



There is potential for increased responsibility and growth for someone who proves they can independently manage high-quality client bookkeeping.



## How to Apply



Please answer **all of the questions below** in your application:



1. How many years of U.S. bookkeeping experience do you have?

2. How many years have you used QuickBooks Online professionally?

3. Approximately how many clients have you managed at the same time?

4. What types of U.S. businesses have you performed bookkeeping for?

5. Briefly describe your month-end bookkeeping process.

6. Are you a QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor?

7. What hours can you consistently work that overlap with Pacific Time?

8. What is your expected monthly compensation?

9. Describe one bookkeeping problem you discovered that someone else had previously missed.

title: Part-Time Video Editor & Storyteller — Premiere Pro
description:
We are looking for a long-term, part-time video editor who is as comfortable finding the story as handling the technical edit.



This is not a special-effects-heavy role. Strong pacing, editorial judgment, clean audio, organization, and reliable communication matter more than flashy transitions.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



• Social Reels, Shorts, and vertical videos with clean captions, music, audio cleanup, basic color correction, and reframing

• Interview-driven recruiting, testimonial, and brand-story videos built from multiple people and longer raw interviews

• Scripted 15- and 30-second TV commercials using supplied scripts, voiceovers, graphics, and clear creative direction

• Long-form YouTube explainer videos



WHAT WE PROVIDE



• Organized footage and creative direction

• Scripts, voiceovers, and core graphics for commercials

• Brand assets and reference examples

• A standardized Synology Drive folder and file-transfer workflow

• Clear feedback and priorities



REQUIRED



• Fluent written and spoken English

• Strong Adobe Premiere Pro experience; all edits must be completed in Premiere

• Portfolio examples showing interview or documentary storytelling—not only fast-cut social clips

• Ability to identify the strongest soundbites and build a clear, emotionally compelling narrative from multiple interviews

• Solid audio cleanup, music selection, captions, basic color correction, multicam syncing, and delivery for 9:16 and 16:9

• Reliable high-speed internet, enough local SSD storage for active projects, and a computer capable of editing 4K proxy workflows

• Excellent file organization, naming, versioning, and relinking

• Proactive communication



WORKFLOW REQUIREMENTS



Synology Drive is our source of truth for file transfer and project storage. You must follow our folder structure exactly. All footage, project files, graphics, captions, licensed music, and exports must remain inside the assigned ecosystem.



Active projects will be synced locally before editing. Premiere cache and temporary files stay local. Only one person owns a project file at a time, and Premiere must be closed before the updated project syncs back. Do not upload client footage to personal cloud storage, AI tools, or third-party transcription services without written approval.



ARRANGEMENT



• Long-term, part-time role

• Initially approximately 15–18 hours per week; workload may grow

• $1,000–$1,500 USD per month depending on experience, speed, and capacity

• Some scheduled communication overlap with U.S. Central Time

• Paid editing test for selected finalists, followed by a 30-day trial

• Two reasonable revision rounds per deliverable unless the brief materially changes



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words STORY FIRST and include:



1. One interview, testimonial, documentary, recruiting, or brand-story example that shows narrative editing.

2. One Reel, Short, or vertical social example.

3. One long-form YouTube, explainer, commercial, or advertisement example.

4. A short video introduction in English.

5. Your computer specifications, internet download/upload speed, available local storage, and current Premiere Pro version.

6. A short explanation of how you decide what to remove when turning several interviews into one concise story.

7. Your typical turnaround time and weekly availability.



Please apply only if the portfolio links are work you personally edited and you can provide organized, relinkable Premiere project files—not only finished exports.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Part-Time, Long-Term) for Business & Marketing Channel

Links to two or three YouTube videos you edited, and what you did on each



Your software and weekly availability

title: Experienced Short-Form Video Editor for UGC & Lifestyle Content
description:
Hi!



I’m a Perth-based UGC & lifestyle creator and a working mum, and I’m looking for an experienced short-form video editor for a long-term collaboration.



My content is mainly for Instagram Reels and TikTok and focuses on:



• Working mum life

• UGC & content creation

• Lifestyle

• Beauty

• Fashion

• Everyday life

• Event experiences



Who I’m looking for

I’m looking for an experienced video editor who has a strong understanding of Instagram Reels and TikTok and, preferably, has worked with UGC creators, influencers or personal brands before.

I’m not simply looking for someone who can edit footage. I want to work with someone who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch until the end, share, follow and ultimately take action.



Together, we’ll be working towards creating content that:

• has strong viral potential

• increases reach and attracts new followers

• is engaging and shareable

• builds my personal brand

• helps brands connect with their target audience

• ultimately supports brand conversions and sales

I’d love an editor who can bring their own creative perspective and say, “I think we could make this stronger by…” rather than simply following instructions.



Editing style

I do not want overly edited videos with lots of unnecessary transitions, effects or trendy editing just for the sake of it.



My preferred style is:

Natural • Clean • Feminine • Relatable • Engaging • Modern



The content should feel native to Instagram/TikTok and still feel like me, rather than looking overly produced or generic.



Your responsibilities

• Select the strongest footage from my raw content

• Create compelling hooks/openings

• Create strong pacing and retention

• Edit for Instagram Reels & TikTok

• Add natural captions/subtitles

• Select suitable music/audio

• Use simple transitions and effects where appropriate

• Structure the video for maximum engagement

• Understand how to make content more shareable and follow-worthy

• Export in 9:16



I will provide the raw footage, ideas and references when needed, but I’m also looking for someone who can contribute creative ideas and editing recommendations based on what is currently working in short-form content.



IMPORTANT — please only apply if you have relevant experience.

Please send me:

Your portfolio

Examples of Reels/TikToks you have personally edited

Examples of UGC creator, influencer or personal-brand content you have worked on, if applicable

Your price per Reel

Your usual turnaround time

What editing software you use

Your timezone and availability

If possible, examples of content you edited that performed particularly well



I’m especially interested in experienced editors from who have worked with UGC creators, influencers or lifestyle creators and understand short-form content performance.



If we seem like a good fit, I’d like to start with a paid test Reel before moving into a long-term collaboration.



Looking forward to seeing your work!

title: Sales & Marketing Representative:  Private Label Suncare & Clean Beauty

With 18+ years of expertise and FDA-registered, globally compliant formulas, we help brand founders and established firms go from concept to shelf.  We're a small, high-trust, high-growth team, and we're looking for an enthusiastic, service-oriented sales representative who genuinely wants to understand each client's goals and find creative ways to solve for them.



This role is the first friendly, knowledgeable point of contact for incoming brand owners. You'll need to be a fast learner who can grasp the technical side of bringing cosmetic and OTC products to market: formula, packaging, and regulatory requirements, and translate client timelines into the right next step with our team.



What you'll do:



-   Respond to and qualify inbound leads from our website contact form, creating and managing each as a deal in HubSpot

Uncover client requirements: product type, formula, packaging, volume, timeline, and compliance needs, and pass qualified clients to our sales and operations team

-  Keep HubSpot clean and accurate: data integrity, deal hygiene, and up-to-date records

-  Build and organize our product catalog and offerings

-  Create sales materials for current and new products

-  Develop a monthly newsletter and an
 outreach program

-  Research high-potential brands and firms and launch structured outreach

-  Make sure every prospect gets a timely response and quick, accurate answers to their questions



You should have:



-  Excellent written and spoken English; polished, warm, professional client communication

-  A genuine service mindset and curiosity: you like solving problems for people

-  The ability to learn technical product concepts fast (cosmetic/OTC formulation, packaging, FDA and international compliance basics, production timelines)

-  HubSpot experience (deals, pipeline, data hygiene), or the ability to get up to speed quickly

-  Content/marketing skills for sales sheets, catalogs, and newsletters (Canva or similar)

-  Research and outreach/lead-generation experience

-  Organized, proactive, and comfortable in a close-knit, fast-moving team



Bonus: experience in beauty, cosmetics, personal care, private label/contract manufacturing, or B2B sales



To apply: Put "Suncare + [your favorite beauty or skincare brand]" in your subject line. Briefly tell us (1) a time you helped a customer figure out what they actually needed, (2) your HubSpot experience, and (3) an example of something technical you taught yourself quickly. Applications without the subject line won't be reviewed.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Marketing Director

Location: Remote

Reports to: COO 



About the Role

We're a $6.5M-revenue, B2C-focused company running on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System), looking for a Marketing Director to own our marketing function end-to-end. This is a full-time leadership role replacing our outgoing fractional CMO, accountable for lead generation, strategic direction, budget, and continuous improvement of the marketing department.

You'll sit on the leadership team, own the Marketing seat in our EOS structure (Rocks, Scorecard, L10 meetings), and be accountable for translating company-wide goals into a marketing strategy and execution plan that drives B2C growth.



What You'll Do

Lead Generation & Strategy

Own lead generation to support annual revenue targets and B2C growth

Set marketing strategic direction across campaigns, messaging, and brand

Build quarterly plans based on strategic direction; identify new marketing channels and tests

Negotiate marketing agreements with partners and external resources; research and evaluate channel partners

Own annual marketing review — what's working, what's not, market trend analysis, and strategy shifts



Brand, Content & Channel Oversight

Maintain oversight of brand standards (DRM brand)

Final approval of content for
 marketing/sequences, social media, blogs, and paid advertising

Determine campaign design direction for print materials and collateral; sign off on creative

Identify and approve required website updates

Oversee content creation and data clean-up/organization work



Budget & Vendor Management

Manage and optimize the marketing budget for ROA (return on ad spend); recommend and manage budget allocation

Negotiate and execute agreements with marketing resources (e.g., PPC agency, CRO)

Review incoming initiatives against budget and strategic alignment

Determine budget for ambassador program and other strategic initiatives



Tools & Technical Direction

Identify needs for new marketing tools/assets; define requirements, specs, and budget

Direct Marketing team to either source/implement solutions or bring in outside experts

Oversee backend builds, landing pages, and UX/template updates 



KPIs, Scorecard & Continuous Improvement

Define quarterly marketing goals, KPIs, and success metrics; own the marketing Scorecard

Weekly monitoring of Scorecard metrics/KPIs — flag off-track metrics and recommend corrective action

Audit prior-quarter results each quarter and refine priorities (Scorecard, Rocks, etc.)

Ensure Scorecard metrics/KPIs are reported accurately at all times, using analytics tools

Final QA across marketing initiatives, channels, platforms, and vendors — own what "good" looks like, measured via demand volume, conversion rates, brand awareness, CAC, and ROI



What We're Looking For

5+ years of marketing experience with at least 2+ years in a leadership/management role

Experience owning marketing strategy and execution in a small-to-mid-size company (ideally $5M–$20M revenue range) — strategic and hands-on

B2C marketing experience, ideally including direct mail/print, ambassador or referral programs, and paid media (PPC/CRO)

Proven track record managing a marketing budget for ROA/ROI, and negotiating vendor/agency agreements

Experience managing people, including junior team members (content, data) and technical contractors

Comfort working in a company that runs on EOS — Rocks, Scorecards, L10s, accountability charts — EOS experience strongly preferred given the operating cadence of this role

Strong grasp of digital marketing fundamentals: content,
/SMS, SEO/SEM, marketing automation, and website/landing page coordination

Excellent communication skills — able to present strategy and Scorecard results clearly to leadership



Nice to Have

Experience transitioning from a fractional/consulting marketing leader into an in-house structure

Experience with direct-to-consumer channels: mailers, print, stuffers, newspaper inserts, swag/promotional campaigns

Familiarity with the specific tools and marketing tech stack currently in use: 
, Google Analytics, 
, Excel/google sheets

title: Ecommerce Project Manager – Shopify & Analytics
description:
JOB TITLE: Ecommerce Project Manager – Shopify & Analytics

COMPANY: Jupiter

LOCATION: Remote, Philippines

HOURS: Full-Time, Monday to Friday, PST Hours

REPORTS TO: Aekta Das, VP, Growth & Ecommerce

PAY: $1,800 to $2,500 USD per month

MUST SPEAK AND WRITE ENGLISH FLUENTLY.

LONG-TERM, FULL-TIME POSITION





Please only apply here, do not message us on onlinejobs.ph we streamline our application here:  



This is a technical ecommerce project management role. You must have strong hands-on Shopify experience and be comfortable working directly with developers and designers. This is NOT a general project coordinator or purely administrative PM position.







You do not need to be a Shopify developer, but you must understand Shopify well enough to communicate effectively with developers, understand technical requirements, identify issues, and manage Shopify development projects from brief through launch.



Please only apply here: 





TO MY FUTURE ECOMMERCE PROJECT MANAGER,







Since 2020, Jupiter has been raising the bar in dandruff care with clinically proven products that look, smell, and feel completely different from traditional products in the category. Today, Jupiter is growing across our website, Amazon, and more than 1,200 Target stores nationwide.







Behind that growth is our team. We believe our employees are our greatest investment, which is why we have worked hard to create a place where talented people are trusted to take ownership, solve problems, and make a real impact.





As we continue to grow, I am looking for an Ecommerce Project Manager to help connect our ecommerce, design, development, analytics, and promotional work.





As the technical Ecommerce Project Manager, you will be the glue to our ecommerce operations and help keep projects moving across teams:







• You have “eagle eyes” and naturally zoom into the small details, gaps, bugs, and issues that other people may miss



• You must be highly proficient in Shopify



• You are experienced working with both development and design teams and know how to speak both of their languages



• You know how to keep projects on track across timelines, handoffs, blockers, and next steps



• You can spot bugs on the site quickly and work with the right teams to get them fixed



• You are comfortable clearing blockers and making sure nothing gets lost between design, development, and launch



Please only apply here: 





You will also help us understand what happens after something goes live. If conversion rate, revenue, AOV, or funnel performance changes, I want someone who can dig into the data, understand what may be driving it, and recommend what we should do next.



If this sounds up your alley then keep on reading through the job post and apply. We're looking forward to meeting you.







Aekta Das



VP, Growth & Ecommerce



Jupiter







WHO YOU ARE







• You have strong hands-on experience with Shopify and ecommerce websites



• You naturally notice bugs, inconsistencies, missing details, and things that do not look right



• You can turn an incomplete request into a clear plan with owners, deadlines, dependencies, and next steps



• You are comfortable working directly with designers and developers



• You do more than pass requests between teams. You ask questions, identify gaps, and keep work moving



• You understand ecommerce metrics such as CVR, AOV, revenue per session, funnel performance, and PDP performance



• When a metric changes, your instinct is to investigate before making assumptions



• You are highly organized, communicate clearly, and follow through without needing constant reminders







WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



ECOMMERCE PROJECT MANAGEMENT







• Own website projects from brief through UX/UI, design, development, QA, launch, and post-launch monitoring



• Turn business needs into clear briefs, tickets, requirements, and timelines



• Coordinate designers, developers, and internal partners across handoffs, dependencies, and blockers



• Maintain and prioritize the ecommerce roadmap and development backlog



• Make sure projects are properly scoped and ready before they go live







SHOPIFY & QA







• Manage day-to-day ecommerce needs within Shopify



• Support product launches, collections, promotions, discount codes, merchandising, and site updates



• Troubleshoot issues and determine whether they require design, development, Shopify configuration, or analytics support



• QA mobile and desktop experiences across key browsers



• Review PDPs, cart, checkout, subscriptions, pricing, promotions, merchandising, and tracking



• Catch functional, visual, and regression issues before they impact customers







ANALYTICS & REPORTING

title: Social Media Specialist for US Church Marketing Agency
description:
We’re a US-based church marketing company looking for one sharp, creative Social Media Specialist to help run social media for the churches we serve. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who can handle a little bit of everything: posts, captions, simple graphics, short videos, scheduling, and engagement. You won’t be boxed into one task. You’ll touch all of it.



The basics:

- Full-time and long-term. This is not a short project or a gig.

- Salary: $800 USD per month. Paid in USD, reviewed at 90 days.

- Schedule: flexible. (We’ll set your hours together, and at least part of your shift will fall during Philippine daytime. This is not the full graveyard shift most US-hours roles demand. Once we agree on your hours, you’re reliably at your desk during them, every workday.

- 100% remote.



What you’ll own:

- Creating and scheduling social media posts for multiple churches every week

- Writing captions that sound like each church, not like a template

- Building simple graphics in Canva that follow each church’s brand

- Cutting sermon clips and short videos for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok (we train you on our tools and workflow)

- Replying to comments and messages on church pages with warmth and good judgment

- Pulling monthly numbers so churches can see what’s working

- Jumping in wherever our social media team needs a hand. You’ll work alongside our social media manager, video editors, and graphic designer, and they’ll count on you

- You will not make phone calls to clients. This is behind-the-scenes creative and production work.



Who we’re looking for:

This is a faith-based role. You must be a born-again Christian who is passionate about helping churches reach more people and grow. We are especially looking for people who are active leaders in their own local church.



At least two years of real social media experience managing pages for a business, a church, or an agency, not just posting on your personal accounts. And you can prove it: you know your numbers and can show what grew under your care



Excellent written English. Captions live or die on it, and yours will be read by thousands of people every week

Comfortable in Canva and basic video editing (CapCut, Premiere, or similar). You don’t need to be a pro editor. You need to be dangerous in all of it



Organized enough to juggle several churches, each with its own voice, brand, and weekly deadlines, without dropping anything

A generalist at heart. You like variety, you learn tools fast, and “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary

Rock-solid reliability. You show up every day, on time, and you do not need to be managed



This job is NOT for you if

- You can’t commit to a set schedule. Your hours are flexible until we agree on them, then they’re fixed

- You only want to do one thing. If you’re a designer who won’t touch video, or an editor who won’t write captions, this role will frustrate you

- You need step-by-step instructions for every task and a manager checking your work daily

- You’re planning to keep freelance clients on the side. We’re hiring your full attention

- You’re not a believer, or you’d rather not spend every workday on church content. Our whole business is churches. There’s no version of this job that isn’t

- Your internet or power situation is shaky and you have no backup plan. Deadlines don’t wait for brownouts



If any of those describe you, no hard feelings. Save us both the time and skip this one.



About us:

REACHRIGHT is a US-based church marketing agency, 10 years old, with team members across the US and the Philippines. We already have 11 Filipino teammates. We are an openly Christian company, and everyone on our team shares one mission: helping churches reach more people. We serve pastors and churches every single day.



How to apply

1. Start your application with the word “Aloha” so we know you actually read this posting.

2. Show us your results, not just your portfolio. Send links to 2 or 3 real social media accounts you have personally managed. 



For each one, tell us:

1. What the account looked like when you started (followers, reach, engagement)

2. What you specifically did

3. Where the account is now

4. Include screenshots of the analytics if you have them. Numbers with proof beat pretty graphics every time.

5. Tell us how you are involved in your local church today.

6. Include a resume and a link to a short video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself.

7. If an account grew because of a team, tell us honestly which part was yours. We’d rather see a small account you genuinely grew than a big account you barely touched.



Applications that do not start with “Aloha,” that have no account links with results, or that have no video will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Paid Media Specialist : Google ads / Meta ads / Linkedin Ads
description:
Senior Paid Media Manager — Google, Meta & LinkedIn Ads

Type: Full-time · Location: Remote · Markets served: South Africa, UK, Netherlands, Australia/New Zealand



About the role:



We're building a full-service performance marketing team serving clients across South Africa, the UK, the Netherlands, and ANZ. 

The role will be conducted during Australian business hours.



We're looking for a Senior Paid Media Manager to own paid acquisition end to end — strategy, build, optimisation, and reporting — across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.



This is a hands-on senior role, not a coordinator seat. You'll be the person in the ad accounts every day, making the calls that move ROAS, CPA, and lead quality. 

You'll work alongside our SEO, web/funnel, creative, and development specialists to ship full-funnel campaigns that actually convert.



What you'll do



-  Plan, build, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube), Meta 
/Instagram, Advantage+), and LinkedIn (Lead Gen Forms, ABM, sponsored content)



- Design and run remarketing and retargeting funnels across all platforms (prospecting ? re-engagement ? conversion)



- Manage budgets across multiple clients, markets, and currencies — allocating spend for efficiency and scale



- Own the metrics: ROAS, CPA, CPL, MER, lead quality, and pipeline impact — and improve them



- Build and structure conversion tracking with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and server-side tracking; partner with our developer where deeper implementation is needed



- Run structured creative testing in partnership with the creative team (audiences, hooks, formats, offers)



-Produce clear, client-ready reporting (Looker Studio or similar) that ties spend to outcomes, not vanity metrics

Collaborate with SEO, funnel, and dev to keep landing pages and tracking aligned with campaign goals



Stay current on platform changes and bring proactive recommendations, not just execution



What we're looking for



4+ years of hands-on paid media experience managing live budgets (agency or in-house)



Proven, demonstrable results across both Google and Meta — dual-platform expertise is essential, not a bonus



Working experience with LinkedIn Ads, especially lead gen and B2B targeting



Strong command of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, and attribution



Comfortable managing multiple accounts and markets simultaneously, with the organisation to keep them all on track



Data-driven and commercially minded — you optimise toward revenue and lead quality, not just clicks



Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication (you'll be client-facing and async-heavy)



Able to work hours that overlap with our client markets (see Hours below)



Nice to have



TikTok, YouTube, or programmatic experience

Experience with e-commerce (Advantage+ Shopping, catalog/DPA) and lead-gen funnels

Familiarity with CRO and landing-page optimisation

Google Ads / Meta Blueprint certifications

Experience with server-side tracking, Triple Whale, or similar attribution tooling

Exposure to multi-language markets (e.g. Dutch-language campaigns)



Hours & setup



Remote, full-time

Mainly AU business hours 

Reports to Global head of digital marketing 

Works closely with the SEO, web/funnel, creative, content, and development tea
mbers



Compensation



Starting salary: USD 1,700 / month, with scope for increases based on performance and results





How to apply

Please send:



Proof of results (required) — case studies or account screenshots from real campaigns showing measurable outcomes (ROAS / CPA / CPL, before and after). Redact client-sensitive details, but the numbers must be real and you must be able to speak to them in detail.

A short write-up of your most successful paid campaign — the goal, what you did, and the result

Your portfolio showing Google and Meta work (LinkedIn a plus)

Which coverage hours you can commit to (UK/EU or ANZ)

Confirmation that the starting rate of USD 1,300 /month works for you





Applications without specific, verifiable results won't move forward. We hire on proven outcomes — not platforms you've "touched."



Hiring process

We run a structured process so it's a strong fit on both sides:



Application review — we screen for real, verifiable results. No proof, no progress.

Screening call (~30 min) — intro, background, and a check on your coverage hours.

Skills interview (~60 min) — you'll walk us through a past campaign in detail and talk through how you'd approach a sample brief or account audit.

Practical task (short, paid) — a real-world exercise, e.g. auditing a sample account or outlining a campaign structure, so we can see how you actually think and work.

Final interview — with [the founder / Head of Performance] to align on expectations and ways of working.

Offer & onboarding.

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Customer Success & Retention Manager – $2,000 p/m + Uncapped Commission
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Role

- On-Target Earnings are $2,500, including a $500 performance bonus (capped).

- Commission on renewals and upsells is uncapped and paid in addition to base and bonus.

ABOUT US



Young Publisher –

SCHEDULE

- Difficult situations are handled calmly.

- Near-native spoken English with very clear pronunciation for U.S.-based clients.

- Confident on Zoom.

- Strong emotional intelligence.

- Calm under pressure.

- High ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations.

- Proactive and organized.

- Reliable internet and professional home setup.

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines.



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success or Account Management

- High-ticket program

- Knowledge of social media monetization.

- Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.).



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:

title: E-commerce Specialist
description:
Role Type

Within Philippines • Permanent • Full-time • Associate



Let’s start with the perks 

→ Work with one of Australia’s leading specialty coffee brands  

→ Join a B Corp, and 1% for the Planet brand  

→ Remote role based in the Philippines, working with a Sydney-based team (minimal time difference and no commute)  

→ Learning and development opportunities  

→ Quarterly Performance Bonus 

→ HMO Program  

→ Volunteer and training leave  

☕ P&R coffee delivered to your place every month  

→ Work somewhere that genuinely values their Team, doing things differently, using tech and innovation and delicious coffee to change the world! 



Oh, and we get the team together each year in the Philippines for an epic gathering! 





A little about you 

You’re the kind of person who notices when a product page is almost right, but not quite. 



A banner is slightly off. A mobile layout could convert better. A promo flag has not been updated. A landing page could be cleaner, faster, sharper. You spot it, you fix it, or you find a smarter way to make sure it does not become a recurring problem. 



You know Shopify (inside and out). Not just “I can update a product description”… But “I can get into the theme, understand what is going on, and build or improve a page using Liquid, HTML and CSS”. You have a practical eye for UX, layout, hierarchy and mobile experience, and you care about whether the online store is easy to use, accurate, on-brand and performing properly. 



You’re organised, curious and detail-driven, not someone who wants to spend their days doing the same manual audit over and over again. You like building templates, SOPs, better ways of working and simple automations that make the job cleaner and easier next time. Work smarter, not harder. And yes, AI is a tool, not a threat when you know how to use it well. And your favourite time of year is when Shopify drop their seasonal updates. You’re quickly thinking about the application of the updates and if it aligns with our strategy and mission! 



Most importantly, you care about doing good work with great people. You’re happy working with cross functional Team Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support. You’re confident turning numbers, feedback and site performance into clear recommendations people can actually act on. 



About us 

Pablo & Rusty’s Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, Australia. We’re a proud B Corp, Carbon Neutral Certified, and 1% for the Planet members meaning we give 1% of our revenue (not profit) to environmental partners. We’re 100% committed to using business as a force for good. 



Our mission is to positively impact people and the planet through coffee. We source specialty coffee, roast with care, support cafe partners, and help more people Drink Better Coffee™ at home, at work and beyond. 



We are digital, design-centric and sustainability-led. We have high expectations, we move quickly, and we are always looking for ways to improve how we work. We strongly believe that if we are not spending at least 10% of our time innovating, we will not succeed. 



About the role 

We’re looking for an E-commerce Specialist to own the day-to-day performance, accuracy and build quality of our online store. 



This is a hands-on Shopify role with a strong mix of platform build, content updates, campaign support, reporting and catalogue accuracy. You’ll help keep the store clean, current and easy to use, while also building custom landing pages, supporting promotional campaigns, maintaining product information, and helping stakeholders understand what is working online and what needs to improve. 



This is not a role for someone who only wants to pass tasks on to developers or rely entirely on page-builder apps. We need someone who is comfortable getting into Shopify, working with themes, building properly, testing carefully and using good judgement. 



Okay, you’re mid way through this ad, congrats but to help ensure you’re not just using AI tools to skim the
 make sure you include “Buy Better Coffee Online” in your application subject line. 



You’ll work closely with Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support to make sure the online store is accurate, on-brand, commercially useful and improving over time. 



A few things you’ll be across 

• Owning Shopify theme customisation, including hands-on use of Liquid, HTML and CSS 

• Building and maintaining sections, templates and custom landing pages 

• Keeping the Online Store 2.0 structure and theme configuration clean, current and easy for others to use 

• Applying practical UX and conversion judgement to page layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

• Managing website content, including homepage, category pages, landing pages, promo flags, navigation and seasonal campaign content 

• Working closely with the Marketing team to execute the promotional calendar as it relates to e-com outputs. 

• Setting up and testing promotions in line with planned campaign activity 

• Coordinating assets for new product launches, sales, campaigns and e-commerce changes with Design, Marketing and the wider team 

• Supporting end-to-end online e-commerce projects, from stakeholder briefing through to testing 

• Providing real-time and monthly reporting on campaign, product and site performance 

• Translating reporting into clear, useful recommendations, not just sending raw numbers 

• Maintaining sources of truth for performance data that stakeholders can reference directly 

• Monitoring stock and maintaining accurate catalogue information 

• Auditing the site and assets to make sure all available products are live, current and accurate 

• Supporting and optimising subscription operations through Recharge 

• Building SOPs, templates and automation where possible to reduce manual catalogue and audit work over time 



What you’ll bring 

• Minimum two years’ experience in a similar Shopify-focused e-commerce role 

• Advanced Shopify experience, including hands-on theme customisation with Liquid, HTML and CSS 

• Confidence building custom landing pages and templates without relying only on third-party page-builder apps 

• Practical UX and conversion design sense, especially around layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

• Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy 

• Good written and verbal communication skills 

• Confidence working with stakeholders across Customer Support, Design, Marketing and Operations 

• Ability to turn data and reporting into clear, practical recommendations 

• Comfortable working independently across time zones, while still being part of a collaborative team 

• Confidence using Microsoft 365 systems, tools and a willingness to learn new apps, plugins and systems. Bonus points if you’ve got Microsoft Business Central experience. 

• A continuous improvement mindset, you notice repetitive work and look for better ways to get it done 



Highly regarded 

• Experience with Recharge or a comparable subscription app 

• Experience with Yotpo or a comparable rewards app 

• Experience with Shopify Plus, including Plus migration experience 

• Familiarity with Figma or a similar design/collaboration tool 

• Experience in online coffee, food and beverage, retail, subscription, or multi-channel e-commerce (including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Google Shopping) 

• Experience using AI or automation tools to improve workflows and reduce manual effort 



What success looks like 

• The online store is accurate, organised, current and easy to manage 

• Product catalogue data is clean, reliable and well maintained 

• Campaigns and assets are turned around within agreed timelines 

• Promotions are uploaded, tested and launched accurately 

• Reporting leads to clear recommendations and better decisions 

• Manual audit effort reduces over time through SOPs, templates or automation 

• Stakeholders have confidence in the store, the data and the way campaign work is coordinated 

• You help make the e-commerce function smarter, cleaner, more scalable over time and ultimately a more profitable channel 



What’s in it for you 

First up: we want this role to be one of the best jobs you’ve ever had. That is our commitment to everyone in our team. 

 

That does not mean the work will always be easy. It will be detailed, fast-moving and sometimes full of competing priorities. But it will also be rewarding. You’ll be working with a team that genuinely cares about our mission, our customers, our impact, and each other. 



You’ll have the chance to grow your skills, improve systems, work on meaningful e-commerce projects, and help a purpose-led coffee brand keep building a better online experience. This role will be part of our growing e-com Team. 



We offer a generous package, Quarterly Performance bonus after probation, HMO Program after one year of tenure, Volunteer and Training Leave, Philippine Public Holidays converted to Annual Leave credits, access to ongoing learning and development, and an Employee Assistance Program. 



And importantly, you’ll get P&R coffee delivered directly to your place every month. 



Work schedule 

This is a full-time independent contractor role, 40 hours per week. 



The role is remote and based offshore, with working hours to overlap with Sydney business hours Monday to Friday, AEST/AEDT. Specific hours will be agreed based on business needs. 



Sounds like your kind of role?

Send us your resume and cover letter (Resume without cover letters won’t be considered), plus: 



1. A link to one live Shopify store you’ve personally built or theme-customised (yours, a client’s, or an employer’s), with a sentence or two on one specific section or page you built using Liquid, HTML or CSS, and why you built it that way. 

2. One thing you’d change on 
 right now, why and how you’d actually build that change in Shopify. 



Let’s make great coffee easier to find, buy and enjoy. ☕

title: Business Development Manager (Inbound Leads) — Remote, Philippines
description:
Business Development Manager (Inbound Leads) — Remote, Philippines



Company: Sprint Labs (
v) 

Location: Remote, Philippines 

Engagement: Full-time independent contractor 

Hours: Full-time, with strong overlap with Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT)



About Sprint Labs



Sprint Labs is a managed staffing company headquartered in Singapore. We legally employ senior professionals across the Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and India, and place them inside client teams in Australia, New Zealand, the US, Canada, and the UK. We are an operator, not an agency. We run the vetting, employment, payroll, and infrastructure behind every placement, and only around 3% of applicants make it into our talent pool.



We are growing, and our inbound pipeline has outgrown the capacity of our current team. That is where you come in.



The role



You will own every inbound lead that comes into Sprint Labs. When a business owner or hiring manager fills in a form, downloads a guide, or replies to a campaign, you are the first human they speak to. Your job is to build rapport quickly, understand what they actually need, and move them through our pipeline to the point where they have a shortlist of vetted candidates in front of them.



Day to day, you will:



- Respond to all incoming leads promptly and professionally across
, LinkedIn, and video calls.

- Build genuine rapport with business owners, CEOs, and general managers in Australia, New Zealand, the US, Canada, and the UK.

- Run structured needs analysis calls to understand the roles they want to fill, budget, timezone requirements, and team context.

- Work with our talent team to prepare and present shortlists of candidates matched to each client's open roles.

- Keep the CRM clean and every lead's status current so nothing slips through the cracks.

- Hand qualified, shortlist-ready opportunities over to our Operations Manager, who leads the deal through to close.

- Re-engage and warm up leads that have gone cold, and support late-stage deals where a second touchpoint helps get them over the line.



This is a pipeline development and qualification role, not a hard-closing role. You succeed by being responsive, consultative, and organised, and by sending well-qualified opportunities into the handover with momentum behind them.



Who we are looking for



- 3+ years in recruitment, talent acquisition, staffing, or client-facing roles within a BPO or offshoring company in the Philippines.

- Direct experience speaking with foreign clients or hiring managers, ideally from Australia, New Zealand, the US, or the UK.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on video calls with business owners, and your written follow-ups need to be sharp.

- A consultative style. You ask good questions, listen properly, and match solutions to real needs rather than pushing a script.

- Strong organisational habits. You can manage a pipeline of concurrent conversations without letting anyone go quiet.

- Comfortable with CRMs, LinkedIn,
 sequencing tools, and video conferencing.

- Reliable home office setup with fast, stable internet and a quiet space for client calls.



Nice to have:



- Experience presenting candidate shortlists or profiles to clients.

- Familiarity with staff augmentation, offshoring, or employer-of-record models.

- Experience working with tools like Instantly, HeyReach, or Apollo.



What we offer



- Competitive monthly compensation, paid in your preferred currency. Rate discussed based on experience.

- Fully remote work from anywhere in the Philippines.

- A defined lane. You own inbound, with a clear handover point and a supportive team around you.

- Direct exposure to the founder and leadership, with real input into how our sales process evolves.

- Growth path as the company scales. This is our first dedicated business development hire, and the role will grow with the pipeline.



How to apply



Apply directly through our website by visiting 
, and fill out as much information as possible for the best chance to get an interview, and importantly, add a short voice recording (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and describing a time you turned an enquiry into a client relationship. Applications without a recording will not be shortlisted.

title: Video Editor – Real Estate & Mortgage Content
description:
I'm a mortgage consultant in New York looking for a talented, reliable video editor to work with me on an ongoing basis.



I'm building a strong content presence around mortgage education, real estate, local housing markets, and collaborations with real estate agents. A major part of the role will involve editing co-branded content featuring both myself and local real estate professionals.



## What You'll Be Editing



• Short-form Instagram Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

• Real estate/property videos and home tours

• Mortgage and real estate educational content

• Talking-head videos

• Co-branded videos with real estate agents

• Market updates and promotional content

• Potential long-form YouTube/video content in the future



## What I'm Looking For



I'm specifically looking for a **video editor**, not a general virtual assistant.



You should have:



• Strong short-form editing experience

• Excellent pacing and understanding of viewer retention

• Clean, professional captions and text animation

• Good use of B-roll, sound effects, music and transitions

• Experience editing real estate, business or personal-brand content

• Ability to create polished vertical 9:16 content

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to follow an established brand/style while also bringing creative ideas

• Fast and reliable communication

• Consistently fast turnaround



**CapCut experience is preferred**, but if you're highly skilled in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects or another professional editing platform, that's absolutely fine.



## Turnaround



Speed is important.



Ideally, most short-form videos should be returned within **24–48 hours** after receiving the footage and instructions.



I want someone who can eventually learn my editing style so the workflow becomes very efficient: I send you the raw footage and direction, and you turn it into polished, ready-to-post content.



## Long-Term Opportunity



I'm not looking for someone to edit one or two videos.



I'm looking for someone reliable who can potentially become my **long-term video editor** as I increase the amount of mortgage, real estate and co-branded agent content I'm producing.



There may also be opportunities to take on more responsibility as the content operation grows.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A link to your portfolio

2. Your **3 best short-form videos**

3. Any real estate/property videos you've edited

4. Any talking-head or personal-brand content you've edited

5. What editing software you primarily use

6. Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60 second Reel

7. Your expected hourly rate or per-video rate

title: Full-time Bookkeeper
description:
Who We Are -



Hello; my name is Casandra Armstrong, and I am the President of Resilient Pro Group LLC. We are an accounting and tax firm based out of Phoenix, AZ (United States).



We are a small, but growing company and are experiencing quite a bit of growth. This has pushed the need for us to hire you, our newest team member.



We help small businesses, just like ours, maintain, manage, and grow their businesses by ensuring accurate financials, processing payroll for their employees, tax preparation and strategy. We ensure we can take as much off the owner’s plate as possible while building trust within our working relationships.



You’re probably wondering if you would be our first Filipino team member?



Actually, no. We currently have 4 team members who are from the Philippines like yourself. We have 2 bookkeeping specialists, a tax specialist, and an administrative specialist that are based in the Philippines as well. In addition to them, our operations manager is US based.



If you’re wondering what you would be doing?



The job title is Bookkeeping Specialist. I am looking for someone who can perform detailed bookkeeping for several small business clients. Your primary duties as a bookkeeper would include document processing, data entry, account reconciliation, ledger management, and financial report processing while understanding the business structure and needs. We are QuickBooks based, so a QuickBooks background is required. However, we will also train on processes.





So, why should you join us over anyone and everyone else?



If you would like…

1) a steady pay check with the chance for bonuses based on performance,

2) the opportunity to work from home without a boss breathing down your neck,

3) a team environment where you work with others to share the work, and

4 ) if you want to work for a stable, growing U.S. firm,

…then this is a job you will enjoy and excel at.





How to know if you’re qualified for this opportunity?



We are looking for someone who has bookkeeping experience, complete understanding of debits and credits, assets and liabilities, inter-company transfers, problem solving skills, fluent in English speaking and writing with the experience of speaking directly with US clients, and most importantly someone who can work with little to no direction and meet deadlines. We do not expect you to know it all as we will train you in your position with everything you need to know about our clients and our field for you to be able to excel at your job.



I do need you to be a good leader- someone who can effectively manage him or herself at the job as well as manage others; someone who has extensive attention to detail, can manage and meet deadlines, follow processes and provide ideas for enhanced processes, problem solve and troubleshoot on their own with little to no direction, be able to effectively resolve issues with upset clients. Intermediate bookkeeping/accounting experience, and QuickBooks experience is required.



I also cannot teach you to have a good attitude and to be self-motivated. These are things you must demonstrate in the interview process.



A successful applicant must be able to demonstrate:



* A can do attitude, and the ability to work without constant supervision

* Be able to speak in conversational English and write in passable English as well

* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Dropbox, QuickBooks, and general ability to use windows based software

* Have or be willing to obtain Internet fast enough to allow for virtual meeting such as zoom and VOIP phone calls without degradation

* Working microphone and Internet video camera

* Workstation with 2 monitors



So, what are the working hours?



As I stated before, our company is based in Phoenix, Arizona so we would require you to work during the US business hours, Monday to Friday 8:00am to 5:30pm Arizona Time



What about pay?



We are serious about hiring someone and are looking to fill this position ASAP. I also want this to be a real job that can meet your financial needs. Therefore, pay is negotiable but know I want you to be happy and satisfied working here, and a good pay scale is part of that.



What about the 13th Month?



Wondering if we pay the 13th month? Unfortunately, we do not. However, we do offer other benefits such as pay time off, holiday pay, and sick time for Full-Time positions. These benefits begin to accrue after your 90 days probation period of a full-time position.



What happens next?



Since our jobs are so popular we generally get deluged with applicants. So, I have designed a multi-part interview process to make the process as simple and efficient for all parties.



The first part of the interview process is designed to examine your English-speaking & writing skills, personality type, internet speed and ability to follow directions. We are a growing US-based consultancy specializing in strategic business operations, process improvement, and organizational growth. We build scalable systems, refine client workflows, and deliver structured advisory solutions. We value direct communication, clear processes, long-term working relationships, and respect for our team members' professional growth.



Job Overview

We are looking for an analytical, systems-minded Operations, Process Improvement & Documentation VA. In this role, your primary focus will be analyzing existing workflows, identifying bottlenecks to drive process improvements, and creating clean, standardized Operating Procedures (SOPs).



Alongside process optimization and documentation, you will manage day-to-day administrative operations, handle client
 follow-ups inside our CRM, and execute our social media content calendar. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented candidate who loves eliminating operational friction and building structured business systems.



Key Responsibilities

• Process Improvement & Workflow Optimization (Core Focus): Audit current operations, identify inefficiencies or redundant steps, and recommend practical process improvements to increase speed, accuracy, and overall workflow quality.

• SOP Creation & Documentation: Turn Loom video walkthroughs, raw notes, and optimized workflows into clear, beautifully formatted, step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) using Notion, Google Docs, or Tango. Maintain and organize our central operations library.

• Inbox & Client Follow-Ups: Monitor
 inboxes, draft templated replies, send follow-ups to warm leads/clients, and log communications inside our CRM (GoHighLevel/Google Workspace).

• Social Media Execution: Schedule approved posts across social channels (using Canva, Metricool, Buffer, or native platforms), format captions, monitor basic comments/DMs, and keep our publishing calendar on track.

• General Administrative Support: Assist with calendar scheduling, file organization in Google Drive, basic data entry, and ad-hoc research tasks to keep daily operations running smoothly.



Required Qualifications

• Experience: 2+ years of experience in Operations Support, Process Improvement, Business Process Mapping, or Administrative Operations.

• Process Improvement & Documentation Mastery: Proven ability to analyze workflows, map out complex processes, and write detailed SOPs and operational manuals.

• Tool Proficiency:

  - Documentation & Ops: Notion, Google Docs, Loom, Tango, or process mapping tools (Miro, Lucidchart, Whimsical).

  - Workspace & CRM: Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets) & GoHighLevel (or standard CRM platforms).

  - Social & Design: Basic Canva skills and familiarity with social media schedulers (Metricool, Buffer, or Meta Suite).

• Skills & Reliability: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, excellent written English, exceptional attention to detail, reliable high-speed internet, and power backup.



Salary & Benefits

• Monthly Salary: $350 to $500 USD/month (negotiable up to $550–$600 for fully qualified candidates), with rapid, performance-based increases.

• 13th-Month Pay Included: Full 13th-month bonus paid every December (prorated based on hire date).

title: WORDPRESS THEME DEVELOPER
description:
WORDPRESS THEME DEVELOPER

Remote in the Philippines | Full-time contractor | $1,200-$1,600 USD/month



Dealer Lux is hiring a WordPress Theme Developer.



We already have a development team and a WordPress platform used across our dealership websites. What we’re missing is someone on the development side who really cares about the last 10% of the front end, especially how the finished site actually looks and feels.



You should be able to take an approved design or rough direction, build it cleanly in WordPress, and notice when spacing, typography, hierarchy, mobile behavior, or UX still feels off without waiting for someone else to point out every detail. If you’re the kind of developer who notices a bad mobile layout before someone files a ticket, that’s a good sign.



Most of the early work is practical. Our Website Launch team gets dealership websites most of the way there. You’ll step in on the parts that need code:



• Finish headers, footers, typography, colors, and responsive layouts.

• Fix front-end and WordPress issues found before launch.

• Handle theme-level customizations in our existing custom WordPress theme.

• Build or improve Gutenberg blocks and reusable front-end components.



The bigger goal is to stop solving the same problem twice. As you see the same requests come up, you’ll help turn them into reusable theme settings, components, and tools. One of the larger projects ahead is modernizing our existing Gutenberg block library toward a consistent JSX-based structure.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



• 2+ years of professional WordPress development experience.

• Experience working on custom WordPress themes.

• Strong HTML/CSS and responsive front-end skills.

• Working knowledge of PHP and JavaScript, plus comfort with Git.

• Familiarity with JSX or component-based JavaScript.

• Experience with Gutenberg / the Block Editor.

• Good visual judgment. The finished interface should matter to you. That includes spacing, typography, hierarchy, responsiveness, and usability.



Custom Gutenberg block 
 React, and Figma are all useful. It is fine if one or two of those are newer to you, as long as your WordPress, JavaScript, and front-end fundamentals are strong.



Dealer Lux builds websites and marketing systems for specialty dealers across North America. Around 25 members of our team are based in the Philippines, several have been with us since 2022, and some have grown from junior roles into department leadership. You’ll report directly to our CTO and work closely with the people who built the platform, along with our Development and Website Launch teams. Good work here can improve many dealership websites instead of disappearing into a single one-off project.



There’s also room to grow. Over time, this role can take on more ownership of reusable theme systems, Gutenberg blocks, internal tools, and the broader WordPress platform.



THE PRACTICAL STUFF



• $1,200-$1,600 USD/month, based on experience.

• Full-time contractor, 40 hours/week.

• Paid every two weeks through Wise.

• At least four hours of daily Pacific Time overlap for the first three months; after onboarding, most hours can be arranged more flexibly around meetings and communication.

• Clockify for time tracking. No screenshot or screen-recording monitoring.

• Paid time off.

• AI coding tools are welcome. We care that you understand, test, and own the work you ship.



APPLY
