title: Executive Assistant to GM (Remote, PH-Based, PST Hours)
description:
Umbrella Property Services is a building services company based in Vancouver. I’m Ryan, the owner/GM, and I move fast. I think in ideas and loose ends. Your job is to turn that into clear plans, tight calendars, and closed loops. You report directly to me and act as my primary leverage point for time and attention.



This is not a basic VA role. I’m looking for a true Executive Assistant who creates structure around me. Someone who wants to become exceptional at executive support, systems, prioritization, and follow-through over the foreseeable future. This role is not intended to be a short-term stepping stone while you immediately pursue a different career or business.



About Ryan & How We Work

- I’m not a micromanager. I’m not looking over your shoulder or nitpicking details. My style is “good enough, ship it, keep moving.”

- I’m chaotic by nature: lots of ideas, lots of moving pieces, and I’d rather be doing deals, strategy, and sales than admin.



Your job is to:

- Put just enough structure around me so my days are sane,

- Protect my calendar so I have real focus time,

- Own the admin and follow-through so I don’t have to chase you or the work.



If you like bringing order to a fast-moving owner and being trusted to run with things, you’ll fit here.



Your Core Outcome

- Give me back time, focus, and mental space.

- When I hand you something, you own it until it’s done. I should not have to chase updates, remember details, or manage follow-through. If you need clarity, you ask. If you don’t, you just get it done.



What Success Looks Like in the First 60 Days

- You fully own my calendar: no double bookings, protected focus time, realistic days.

- My inbox is consistently triaged; I only see what actually needs my brain, with drafts ready where appropriate.

- Recurring admin and follow‑ups are handled without me chasing you, and I’m spending noticeably more time on sales, strategy, and deals.



What You’ll Own

1. Calendar & Communication

- Protect and manage my calendar; no double bookings, clear buffers, realistic days.

- Triage inbox and messages; draft replies and summarize what needs my decision.

- Ensure follow-ups and responses don’t fall through the cracks.

2. Follow-Up & Accountability

- Capture commitments from meetings and conversations.

- Turn discussions into clear next actions with owners and deadlines.

- Follow up with internal and external stakeholders and push (respectfully) when things stall.

3. Problem Solving

- Bring solutions, not just problems.

- When something blocks you, come back with: “Here’s what happened, here are options, here’s what I recommend.”

- Ask smart clarifying questions instead of waiting passively.

4. Projects & Operations

- Coordinate small projects and initiatives. This is light operational coordination, not a general operations manager role.

- Prepare agendas, documents, and materials for meetings.

- Maintain simple systems for tasks, SOPs, and follow-ups.

- Improve or automate repetitive admin where possible, including with AI tools.

- Handle personal admin (bookings, reservations, personal tasks) so I can stay focused on high‑value work.



You’ll Succeed Here If You Are

- Highly proactive and self-directed; you don’t wait to be told what to do next.

- Strong at follow-through and holding others accountable.

- Comfortable “managing up” to a busy, idea-driven founder.

- Clear, concise written communicator.

- Calm when priorities change and things are a bit chaotic.

- Detail-oriented and reliable; you take pride in clean work.

- Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning it into structure.

- AI-literate and hungry to keep learning.



This Role Is Not For You If

- You need step-by-step instructions for every task.

- You get stressed by someone who moves fast and changes priorities.

- You wait to be chased for updates instead of closing the loop yourself.



Non-Negotiables (Read Carefully)

- Based in the Philippines and able to work 7:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. PST, Monday–Friday (40 hrs/week).

- Minimum 2 years supporting a founder / CEO / executive as an EA, PA, or similar role.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Slack for daily communication.

- Quiet, distraction-free workspace (no cafés).

- Reliable computer setup with two monitors (or laptop + external screen), headset, mouse, and keyboard.

- High-speed internet (100 Mbps or faster) for video and calls.



If you do not meet the above, your application will not be considered.



Compensation & Setup

- Fixed retainer of $1,250 USD per month, paid bi-weekly.

- 30 days paid time off per year, aligned with the Canadian calendar (not PH public holidays).

- Bonus opportunities after 3 months, based on reliability, quality, and ownership.

- $500 USD annual tech allowance to support your equipment and connectivity.



How to Apply

/recruit-ph-ea

- If shortlisted, you’ll send a short video message and complete a short series of
s with Ryan

- Final candidates will be invited to a paid trial day to test their skills in a simulated work environment

title: Full-Time AI Static Ad Creator / Performance Creative Strategist
description:
We’re looking for a full-time AI Static Ad Creator / Performance Creative Strategist who understands that high-performing creative starts with research, positioning, and strategy — not random design ideas.



This is not a traditional graphic design role, and it is not a position for someone who simply knows how to use Canva or AI image generators.



You will be responsible for researching markets, identifying opportunities, developing structured advertising concepts, producing static ads, analyzing performance, and iterating based on actual data.



Every Ad Batch Must Have a Strategy



We do not create random batches of ads and hope something works.



Every batch should be developed around a specific hypothesis and clearly defined variables, including:



Target customer avatar

Market awareness level

Market sophistication level

Specific problem or issue

Core customer desire

Advertising angle

Hook

Unique mechanism or differentiator

Customer objections

Previous solutions they may have tried

Emotional drivers

Proof architecture

Competitive positioning

The specific variable being tested



You should be able to clearly explain why an ad exists before you create it.



For example, instead of thinking:



"Let's make 10 new ads for this product."



We expect thinking closer to:



"This batch targets a solution-aware customer who has already tried multiple alternatives without getting the result they want. The market is highly sophisticated, so simply promising the end benefit is unlikely to be enough. We need to differentiate through mechanism, create contrast against existing solutions, address skepticism with proof, and test whether a problem-led or outcome-led hook creates stronger engagement."



That is the level of strategic thinking we expect.



Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Conducting deep customer and competitor research

Identifying specific customer avatars

Determining market awareness levels

Evaluating market sophistication

Finding customer pain points, desires, objections, frustrations, and language

Developing research-driven advertising angles

Turning those angles into static ad concepts

Creating high-performing
 and Instagram static ads

Using AI tools to generate realistic people, environments, product scenes, UGC-style imagery, and other supporting assets

Creating native-style ads that blend naturally into social feeds

Producing testimonial, advertorial, comparison, problem/solution, authority, editorial, before/after, product-focused, and other direct-response formats

Developing multiple executions of proven angles rather than constantly abandoning winning concepts

Reviewing creative performance and determining what should be tested next

Iterating winning advertisements through new hooks, visuals, avatars, headlines, proof devices, formats, and executions

Clearly organizing creative tests so we know what variable each advertisement is testing

PERFORMANCE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



Do not apply unless you can provide actual proof of advertising performance from previous accounts.



We are looking for people who have personally created direct-response advertisements that have scaled profitably.



At minimum, you must be able to show us an advertisement or creative concept you personally worked on that achieved:



$10,000+ in ad spend at a 2.0+ ROAS.



You must provide actual evidence from previous advertising accounts showing:



The advertisement or creative

Ad spend

ROAS

Revenue/purchase performance

Relevant date range



We may ask additional questions to verify your involvement in the creative.



Any application submitted without proof of $10,000+ spend at 2.0+ ROAS will NOT be considered.



A design portfolio alone is not enough.



We are hiring based on the ability to create advertising that performs, not simply advertising that looks good.



Research Is a Major Part of This Position



Before developing creative, you should be comfortable researching through sources such as:



Meta Ad Library

Competitor websites

Competitor landing pages

Amazon and customer reviews

Reddit

Forums

Social media comments

Customer feedback

Existing winning advertisements

Advertorials

Surveys

Product reviews

Internal creative-performance data



You should be able to convert research into clear advertising hypotheses and testable creative concepts.



AI & Creative Tools



You should be highly comfortable using modern AI creative tools.



Experience with tools such as:



ChatGPT

Midjourney

Gemini / Nano Banana

Higgsfield

Sora

Flux

Photoshop

Canva

Other AI image-generation and editing platforms



is highly valuable.



We care less about the specific software you use and more about the quality of the finished advertisement.



You should be capable of generating highly realistic images and then refining them so they do not immediately look AI-generated.



AI is a tool used to execute the strategy.



AI itself is not the strategy.



What We're Looking For



You should have:



Proven direct-response advertising experience

Proven Meta creative experience

Strong understanding of customer avatars

Strong understanding of market awareness

Strong understanding of market sophistication

Strong direct-response copy instincts

Ability to develop compelling hooks and angles

Excellent visual judgment

Strong AI image-generation skills

Ability to make AI imagery believable and realistic

Strong research abilities

Strong understanding of creative testing

Ability to analyze advertising performance

Ability to determine why an ad won or lost

Ability to systematically iterate winners

Strong attention to detail

Fast turnaround times

Reliable communication

Ability to take feedback and implement it correctly

Ability to work independently



Experience working with DTC/e-commerce brands spending significant amounts on Meta advertising is strongly preferred.



The Mindset We're Looking For



Before creating an advertisement, you should naturally be asking:



Who exactly are we targeting?



What does this person already know about their problem?



What solutions have they already seen or tried?



What awareness level are they at?



How sophisticated is this market?



What specific issue are we addressing?



What is the deeper desire behind solving it?



What angle are we testing?



What does the customer need to believe before purchasing?



What proof will make the message credible?



What variable are we testing against the previous batch?



What did the last round of ads teach us?



Not:



"What cool AI image can I make today?"



Position



Full-Time / Long-Term



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our creative team.



We continuously produce and test new advertisements, concepts, iterations, avatars, hooks, and angles.



There is significant room to grow for someone who consistently contributes winning ideas and creatives.



How To Apply



Your application MUST include:



Your portfolio

Examples of static advertisements you personally created

Screenshots proving at least one creative or concept you worked on generated $10,000+ in spend at a 2.0+ ROAS

An explanation of exactly what YOU contributed to that winning advertisement

A brief explanation of your research process before developing a new batch of creatives

The AI and design tools you currently use

Your availability

Your expected monthly salary

Any DTC/e-commerce industries you have previously worked in



Applications without actual performance proof will not be reviewed.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid trial where we provide the necessary product information, research, and performance data and ask you to develop a research-driven creative batch.

title: Client Relations and Separations - EWS Supervisor
description:
EWS SUPERVISOR



Early Warning System, Risk Management, Coaching & Retention



JOB SUMMARY



The EWS Supervisor oversees the Early Warning System (EWS) and is responsible for reviewing,

mitigating, and resolving identified VA risks that may lead to performance issues, client dissatisfaction,

termination, or separation.



CSMs are responsible for identifying and risk-tagging Yellow and Red cases, conducting the initial

check-in, and implementing the first-level intervention. The EWS Supervisor provides the next level of

support by reviewing flagged cases and intervening when risks are unresolved, escalating, recurring, or

require additional management support.



The EWS Supervisor assesses the situation, meets with the CSM and/or VA as needed, provides coaching,

conducts Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and develops an appropriate mitigation plan. Based on the findings

and progress, the EWS Supervisor may recommend resolution, continued monitoring, a Performance

Improvement Plan (PIP), or VA replacement.



The primary objective of the role is to reduce avoidable VA terminations and separations by addressing

risks early, identifying root causes, and driving effective corrective action.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

EWS & Risk Management

● Review Yellow and Red VA risk flags identified by CSMs.

● Prioritize unresolved, escalating, or high-risk cases.

● Assess whether additional EWS intervention is required.

● Monitor cases through resolution, escalation, or replacement.



Risk Intervention

● Meet with CSMs and/or VAs when additional intervention is required.

● Identify the underlying cause of the issue through assessment and RCA.

● Determine whether the issue is related to performance, capability, training, behavior, client

expectations, CSM execution, role alignment, or process.

● Develop and monitor the virtual assistant progress.

● Recommend the appropriate outcome based on documented findings: resolve, PIP, or replace.



Coaching & Performance Management

● Coach CSMs on risk management, difficult conversations, corrective action, and retention

strategies.

● Provide direct VA coaching when appropriate.

● Develop or support PIPs for documented performance concerns.

● Monitor improvement and escalate cases when corrective action is unsuccessful.



Incubation & Preventive Risk Management

● Provide heightened oversight of qualifying VA risks during the 0–30 day Incubation period.

● Support the 1st Week EWS intervention process for qualifying cases.

● Support preventive coaching and risk reviews for VAs within the 31–180 day period.



Reporting & Process Improvement

● Track EWS outcomes, intervention effectiveness, and separation trends and Analysis.

● Identify recurring risk drivers and recommend improvements to Client Success and Manager of

Client Relations and Separations



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

● Reduction in preventable VA terminations and separations of at least 15% monthly.

● Reduction in unresolved Yellow and Red cases.

● EWS intervention and resolution rate.

● 1st week resolution of high risk drivers for VAs on 0-30 days tenure

● Timely completion of required EWS interventions.

● Improvement in CSM risk-management and intervention effectiveness.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

● Experience in coaching, performance management, and people development.

● Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

● Experience developing or managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).

● Strong analytical, organizational, and case-management skills.

● Excellent written and verbal communication.

● Strong judgment and ability to make objective, evidence-based recommendations.

● Ability to manage sensitive performance and client matters professionally.

● Experience in legal services, legal staffing, law firm environments.

● Experience with escalation, retention, or separation-prevention programs.



OVERALL OBJECTIVE

The EWS Supervisor's primary objective is to mitigate identified VA risks before they become

terminations or separations by providing timely intervention, effective coaching, root cause analysis,

and measurable corrective action.

The CSM identifies the risk. The EWS Supervisor provides support to resolve it.





*** PS: Payrate Range is not negotiable so if you are expecting a higher Hourly rate please do not apply ***

*** We use Hubstaff  as productivity and screen monitoring systems, please do not apply if you are not comfortable with this***

description:
ABOUT US



We are a chartered accounting firm in New Zealand. We are a small team looking after several hundred business clients, nearly all of them owner-operated.



We run on Xero for accounting, Xero Practice Manager (XPM) for practice management, and FYI Docs for document management.



That experience is the first filter for this role.



We are looking for someone who has worked inside an accounting firm and used Xero and a practice management system as part of their normal working day, rather than someone who has simply seen them in passing.



If that is your background, you should find your feet here quickly.



We are not short of systems. We already have workflow templates, checklists, naming conventions and reporting packs. They are written, they work, and the bones of the system are already there.



What we do not have is one person who owns the admin engine and makes sure everything actually gets finished.



Almost everything here gets prepared and then waits for a human to close the loop:



The job with nobody assigned to it.

The annual return that is one signature away from being filed.

The invoice that never went out after the work was marked complete.

The client
 that was drafted three days ago but never sent.



That is the role.



You are the person at the end of those pipes. You keep things moving, follow them through, and make sure the last 10 percent actually gets done.



We would rather hire one capable person properly than spread this work across four people who each do a little bit of it.



We are a small and friendly team. People help each other here, the work is varied, and you will be trusted with real responsibility early on.



WHO YOU WORK WITH



You will work closely with our administrator in New Zealand, who handles everything that needs to happen physically at this end.



Together, you will build and run the administrative systems the firm needs.



They know how the work runs today. You bring the discipline to turn that knowledge into something written down, repeatable and difficult to drop.



Expect plenty of back and forth during your first few months while you work out how each process should run, document it properly, and then hand the routine parts to the right person.



You will also work directly with our director and our accountants.



You can ask any of us anything.



THE WORK



There are six main areas.



You will not be expected to pick them all up at once.



In your first month, expect to focus mainly on client take-on, filing and follow-up. The remaining areas will come across as you are ready for them.



1. NEW CLIENT AND ENTITY TAKE-ON

Set up new clients and entities in XPM and FYI correctly the first time, including group structures, entity relationships, balance dates, IRD numbers, contact records and job templates.

Run the onboarding checklist from beginning to end and hold responsibility for it until every box is closed.

Collect and follow up identity and verification documents. You gather and record the information. A New Zealand accountant assesses it.

Prepare engagement paperwork from our templates and send it for signature.

Request records from the client's previous accountant and follow up until they arrive.

2. COMPANIES OFFICE AND ENTITY ADMINISTRATION



New Zealand has a public companies register that every client company needs to keep current.



The work is deadline-driven, administrative and important. It is also exactly the sort of work that gets forgotten until something becomes late if nobody owns it.



You will handle:



Annual returns, run as a monthly cycle so nothing falls past its filing month.

Company incorporations, name reservations and the associated paperwork.

Trustee company set-ups.

Director, shareholder and share allocation changes.

Registered office, address for service and address for communication updates.

Company name changes and wind-ups. You prepare them, track them, and make sure nothing sits half-finished.

Following up directors for the consents and confirmations required for filings.

Reconciling our internal entity register against the public register and fixing any gaps.



You do not need to have used the New Zealand Companies Office register before.



You do need to be the sort of person who can read the rules once, turn them into a process, and then make sure a due date is never missed.



3. JOB AND WORKFLOW ADMINISTRATION



XPM is our practice management system. It controls our jobs, due dates, workflows and timesheets.



You will:



Run a standing weekly exception sweep covering jobs with nobody assigned, jobs sitting in the same state for more than 14 days, anything past its due date, and recurring templates that have stopped assigning correctly.

Produce one short action list from that sweep, not a long report.

Keep recurring job templates, due dates and job states accurate.

Manage annual accounts intake as client documents arrive, renaming and filing them according to our conventions by group, entity, financial year and category.

Update production sheets from XPM at the beginning of each week.

Maintain client and system data hygiene across XPM, FYI and our other systems.



Systems drift over time. Somebody needs to be the person who notices and cares.



4. DOCUMENTS, SIGNING AND CORRESPONDENCE



You will:



Build and send signature bundles, then follow them up until they come back.

Send final accounts and reports with the appropriate covering correspondence and file the completed documents.

Draft routine client correspondence in our voice, using templates, for approval before it is sent.

Run batch
s where the same communication needs to go to a group of clients. We already have a working process for this. You populate it and run it.

Keep the document management system tidy and consistently named.



If something is filed properly the first time, nobody should need to go looking for it twice.



5. CHASING AND FOLLOW-UP



This is the part that makes everything else work.



If something has been asked for and has not been delivered, you own the follow-up until it is resolved or escalated.



You will:



Maintain one follow-up register covering what we owe clients, what clients owe us, and what members of the team owe each other.

Put a date against every item.

Follow everything up politely, repeatedly and without needing to be reminded.

Follow up our own team for reviews, billing decisions and completed drafts that have not yet been sent.

Follow up clients for documents, signatures and consents.

Follow up timesheet completion and send a short weekly summary.



This is a polite nudge about getting the work done, not a management conversation.



6. BILLING SUPPORT



You will:



Assemble the monthly work in progress workbook from XPM and follow up managers for their billing decisions.

Identify and follow up completed jobs that have not turned into an invoice.

Run the first three stages of debtor follow-up from a written script, with a clear escalation point where responsibility passes to somebody else.

Keep the monthly billing archive tidy and complete.

AND THROUGHOUT: WRITE IT DOWN



We are saying this openly because we have been burned by it before.



Too much of this work currently lives in people's heads.



As you learn each task, you and our New Zealand administrator will document the process together in plain English so the next person does not have to start from nothing.



That is part of the role, not an extra task.



Building a reliable administrative system around the firm will be one of the things we judge the success of this role on.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



These are genuine requirements rather than a wish list, so it is worth checking them before you apply.



You need:



At least three years' experience working inside an accounting or bookkeeping firm in practice administration, corporate administration or client onboarding. This is different from a general office administration role. Please tell us the firm, the country, and roughly how many clients it looked after.

Hands-on Xero experience at a day-to-day working level. We are not looking for someone who has simply completed a certificate. You should be comfortable opening a messy client file and knowing where to start.

Daily experience using Xero Practice Manager (XPM). XPM runs every job, due date, workflow and timesheet in our firm, so genuine XPM experience puts you well ahead of the field. If you have instead used Karbon, WorkflowMax or a close equivalent properly, tell us what you used and for how long. We are not in a position to teach practice management from scratch.

Daily experience using a document management system. We use FYI Docs, but a comparable system counts if you genuinely used it as part of your normal working day.

Experience running deadline-driven work, in any country, where being late has a consequence.

Confidence working with spreadsheets. You do not need to build financial models, but you should be able to build and maintain a useful working register.

Excellent written English. You will be drafting
s that clients read and that go out under our names.

Discretion. You will handle client identity documents and financial information every day. This is a condition of the role, not a preference.

Reliable internet and a quiet home office.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT REQUIRED

Experience working for an Australian or New Zealand accounting firm.

Exposure to New Zealand GST or payroll.

Experience with a public companies register, trusts, client take-on or verification requirements.

Bookkeeping or billing administration experience.

Experience documenting a procedure for work that was originally handed to you informally.

WHAT ACTUALLY MATTERS TO US

You do not miss a fixed date. Several parts of this role have deadlines set by law and they do not move.

You raise your hand when something looks wrong instead of processing it anyway.

You are comfortable chasing people politely and repeatedly, including people more senior than you.

You can hold a long list without dropping the quiet items on it.

You finish things. The reason this role exists is that too much work currently gets to 90 percent and stops.

You enjoy building a system, not just working inside one. If you can see a better way to run something, we want to hear it.

You are happy owning careful, unglamorous work and being the person trusted with it.

HOURS



The role requires availability from 5:00am to 2:00pm Manila time, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour break.



These hours provide strong overlap with the New Zealand working day throughout the year.



We know that is an early start. We are stating it up front because the point of this role is to work alongside our New Zealand team during our normal working day.



If those hours do not fit around your life, we completely understand, and we would rather you knew before you applied.



PAY



You will be paid an agreed hourly rate for hours worked.



Payment will be made in New Zealand dollars, twice monthly.



This is intended to be a long-term position.



YOUR FIRST MONTH



By the end of your first month, we would expect you to be:



Running new client set-ups on your own.

Holding the follow-up register.

Writing up your first few procedures in your own words.



The Companies Office cycle and billing work will come across to you when you are ready for them, rather than according to an arbitrary schedule.



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application properly, so a few specific sentences will do far more for you than a long generic cover letter.



Start your message with the word REGISTER so we know you read to the end.



Then answer these four questions. Short answers are fine.



Which accounting firms have you worked for? For each one, tell us the country, roughly how many clients it had, and exactly which accounting, practice management and document systems you personally used.

You are given a list of 40 overdue things across six different people. What do you do first, and what do you send us at the end of the day?

You have asked a client for the same document three times and heard nothing. What do you do next?

What is your current work schedule, and are you genuinely able to start at 5:00am Manila time?



Attach your CV.



If you have Xero certification, tell us which certification you hold and when you completed it.

title: Senior Non-QM Mortgage Underwriter (Remote | Night Shift)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Senior Non-QM Mortgage Underwriter (Remote | Night Shift)

Php 70,000 – Php 188,179/month (based on experience)

Full-Time | Permanent Remote | U.S. Mortgage Company



>Why This Role is Different



We’re not looking for a basic underwriter.



We’re hiring someone who can confidently review and approve complex Non-QM loans — someone who understands risk, moves fast, and knows how to make solid credit decisions.



If you have strong Non-QM experience and want to work directly with a growing U.S.-based mortgage team, this is a long-term opportunity with real impact.



> What You’ll Be Doing



Underwrite Non-QM loans (DSCR, Bank Statement, WVOE, P&L)



Analyze credit, income, assets, and collateral



Review AUS findings and apply conditions or overlays



Issue decisions: Approve, Deny, or Suspend



Work closely with processors and operations to clear conditions



Maintain strong turn times while ensuring compliance



Support junior tea
mbers when needed



> What We’re Looking For



At least 5 years U.S. mortgage underwriting experience



Strong Non-QM experience (DSCR, Bank Statement, etc.)



Experience handling self-employed borrowers and complex files



Solid understanding of U.S. mortgage guidelines (TRID, ATR/QM, etc.)



Able to make independent credit decisions



Detail-oriented and reliable in a remote setup



Plus (but not required):



Experience with Encompass



Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese language skills



> Work Setup



Remote (Work from Home)



Night Shift: 11:30 PM – 8:30 AM PH Time



Stable, long-term role with a U.S.-based company



> Basic Requirements



At least 16GB RAM



Intel i5 (4th gen or newer) or equivalent



Stable internet (minimum 100 Mbps)



>> How to Apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and follow the instructions below carefully:



1. All applicants must submit their application via
 sent directly through OnlineJobs.ph.

Applications sent outside of OnlineJobs.ph will not be considered.



Include the following in your application message:



Updated Resume (PDF or link — Google Drive/Dropbox/OLJ profile)

If submitting a link, make sure it is set to “Anyone with the link can view”



Years of U.S. Mortgage Underwriting Experience



Years of Non-QM Experience (DSCR, Bank Statement, etc.)



Expected Monthly Salary (PHP)



Earliest Start Date / Availability



2. Answer This Question (Required)



In your application message, briefly answer:



What are the three main documents you review when underwriting a DSCR loan?



(Keep your answer short and direct.)



3. Important



To confirm you have read the job post, please include this line at the beginning of your message:



“I have Non-QM underwriting experience.”



4. For Shortlisted Candidates Only



If you are shortlisted, you will be asked to complete a quick follow-up step, which includes:



Internet speed test (screenshot from speedtest.net)



Computer specifications (RAM and processor)



Short Non-QM scenario-based questions



>> Note



Only applicants who follow the instructions above will be prioritized for review.



>> Shortlisted Candidates



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short screening step, which may include:



Quick technical questions (Non-QM / DSCR)



Speedtest and computer specs



Brief experience validation



>> Final Note



We’re looking for serious underwriters who know how to assess risk and make confident decisions.



If that’s you, apply now — we review applications daily.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR) – Higher Education Partnerships



Dorm Room Movers | Remote



About Dorm Room Movers



Dorm Room Movers helps colleges, universities, students, and families simplify the moving, storage, and shipping experience. We partner with colleges and prep schools across the United States to provide convenient, professionally managed solutions for students during move-in, move-out, and throughout the academic year.



We’re looking for a motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand our network of school partners and build the next generation of relationships for Dorm Room Movers.



The Opportunity



As a Business Development Representative, you’ll be responsible for identifying prospective college and university partners, reaching the right decision-makers, and starting conversations that create new business opportunities.



This is an outbound-focused role for someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, writing effective
s, researching prospects, and consistently following up.



You won’t just be working from a list. We want someone who can think strategically about accounts, identify the right contacts, and find creative ways to get conversations started.



What You'll Do



Prospect colleges and prep schools across the United States through phone,
, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels

Research prospective institutions and identify relevant decision-makers

Generate qualified meetings and sales opportunities

Build and maintain a consistent outbound prospecting pipeline

Develop personalized outreach rather than relying solely on generic sequences

Follow up persistently and professionally with prospective partners

Maintain accurate prospect and activity information in our Sales CRM (Pipedrive)

Work closely with sales leadership to prioritize accounts and improve outreach strategies

Track outreach activity, meetings generated, conversion rates, and other BDR KPIs

Test new messaging, prospecting approaches, and channels to improve results



What We're Looking For

Previous BDR, SDR, inside sales, business development, or outbound prospecting experience preferred

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Comfortable making outbound calls and initiating conversations with people you don't know

Organized and disciplined with follow-up

Ability to research accounts and identify the right contacts

Competitive, goal-oriented, and motivated by measurable results

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Experience working with a CRM and sales prospecting tools

Coachable and willing to continuously improve your sales approach



Experience selling to colleges, universities, education organizations, or other B2B organizations is a plus, but not required.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role isn't measured simply by the number of calls or
s you send. We're looking for someone who consistently turns outbound activity into meaningful conversations and qualified opportunities.



You'll be expected to build a healthy pipeline of prospective university partners and consistently generate qualified meetings for our sales team.



Why Dorm Room Movers?



Fully remote environment

Opportunity to directly contribute to company growth

Established company serving the higher education market

Significant ownership over your prospecting strategy and results

Opportunity to develop your B2B sales skills and grow within the organization

Collaborative team that values initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement



Ready to Apply?



If you're someone who enjoys prospecting, isn't afraid to pick up the phone, and gets satisfaction from turning a cold account into a real business conversation, we'd like to hear from you.



Apply with your resume and tell us a little about your experience generating new business opportunities.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Faceless Channel)
description:
Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Faceless Channels)



We're looking for a video editor to join us long-term editing faceless, long-form YouTube content. Our videos cover war and military history, documentaries, explainers, mystery and unsolved stories — narrated content with no on-camera presenter.



This is not short-form work. We are not looking for someone who edits TikToks and Reels. Our videos range from 12 minutes to full-length documentaries of up to an hour, and they live or die on whether the viewer stays past the first minute.



What you'll be doing



Editing narrated long-form videos from a script and a voiceover track

Sourcing and cutting archival footage, stock clips, maps, photos and B-roll that match the narration beat by beat

Building retention: strong hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing changes, and cuts that never let the video sit still

Sound design — this matters a lot to us. Ambience, impacts, risers, subtle SFX under the narration, and music that shifts with the story

Simple motion graphics: text overlays, lower thirds, map animations, highlights and callouts

Color and audio cleanup so the final file is ready to upload



Our stance on AI



We use AI sparingly, mostly for filler or transitional shots when no real footage exists. The backbone of every video should be real archival and stock material. If your reel is mostly AI-generated clips stitched together, we're not the right fit.



What we need from you



Proven experience editing long-form faceless YouTube content (please show it)

Strong command of Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. CapCut is fine for quick turnarounds, but it cannot be your only tool

A real feel for pacing and audience retention — you understand why a cut happens where it happens, not just how

Good taste in sound design and music selection

Comfortable finding your own footage and reference material

Reliable communication in written English

Able to hit deadlines consistently



Nice to have



Motion graphics and map animation skills

Interest in history, geopolitics or documentary storytelling



Details



Volume: 2 to 3 videos per week, depending on length and complexity

Pay: $600 per month, paid monthly

Full time, 40 hours per week

Long-term position — we want someone who grows with the channel, not a one-off gig

You'll get scripts, voiceovers and a style guide. We'll give clear feedback and revisions



How to apply



Start your application with the word BLACKBOX so we know you read this.



Then send us:



Links to 2–3 long-form faceless videos you edited. Tell us exactly what you did on each one.

Pick one of those videos and explain, in a few sentences, one specific editing decision you made to keep viewers watching — and why it worked.

Your available hours per week and your rate.



Applications without the codeword or without work samples will not be reviewed.

title: Junior Graphic Designer ( Fresh Graduate is welcome )
description:

Key Responsibilities:

• Create complete product image sets (6–10 images per SKU) following marketplace standards

• Design campaign banners, promotional graphics, and marketplace visuals

• Produce short product videos (15–60 seconds) for listings and marketing

How to Apply:

Send your resume, portfolio (if available) to Microsoft Teams: 



Thank you!

title: Part-Time LinkedIn Lead Generation & Outreach Coordinator
description:
Behavioral Health Billing & Revenue Cycle Services



We are looking for a part-time LinkedIn Lead Generation & Personal Profile Manager to help grow our presence within the behavioral health industry, identify qualified prospects, and generate conversations with facility and practice owners who may need billing, credentialing, authorization, and revenue cycle management services.



This position will involve both lead generation and ongoing management of my personal LinkedIn presence. We are not looking for high-volume spam or aggressive automation. The goal is to build a professional, credible personal brand while carefully developing relationships with qualified behavioral health decision-makers.



Who We Want to Reach



Our primary target market includes:



Substance Use Disorder (SUD) treatment facility owners

Mental health facility owners

Behavioral health practice owners

Residential treatment providers

IOP and PHP programs

Outpatient mental health and SUD practices

Behavioral health executives, founders, CEOs, administrators, and other decision-makers



The primary objective is to identify qualified prospects, build relationships, and generate enough interest to get owners and decision-makers on the phone to discuss their billing and revenue cycle needs.



Personal LinkedIn Profile Management



The person hired will also help actively manage and develop my personal LinkedIn profile as needed.



Responsibilities may include:



Keeping my personal LinkedIn profile professional, current, and optimized

Improving profile wording, positioning, headline, About section, and service descriptions

Developing and maintaining a consistent professional presence

Drafting and coordinating LinkedIn posts

Identifying relevant industry topics and opportunities for content

Helping determine when and how often to post

Drafting thoughtful comments and engagement opportunities on relevant industry posts

Helping manage incoming LinkedIn conversations and identifying messages that require my personal attention

Preparing personalized responses and follow-ups

Identifying networking opportunities with behavioral health owners and executives

Monitoring profile performance and recommending improvements

Ensuring that my profile supports our overall business-development strategy



Because this is my personal LinkedIn account and professional identity, judgment, professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail are extremely important.



Any profile management or outreach must be performed using methods permitted by LinkedIn. We will not use unauthorized account-sharing arrangements, automation, bots, scraping tools, or methods designed to circumvent LinkedIn restrictions.



Lead Generation & Outreach Responsibilities

Research qualified behavioral health prospects using LinkedIn and Sales Navigator

Build organized prospect lists

Identify owners, founders, CEOs, administrators, and other decision-makers

Research prospects before outreach

Draft highly personalized connection messages and follow-ups

Develop professional outreach sequences

Track prospects, responses, follow-up dates, and booked calls

Identify new facilities, expanding organizations, and potential business opportunities

Help move interested prospects toward a conversation with our team

Provide regular reporting on leads, conversations, and appointments generated

Excellent Written English Is Required



This is extremely important.



The person hired must have excellent written English skills and be able to communicate naturally and professionally with healthcare executives and business owners.



Messages, posts, comments, and profile content should sound natural and personalized—not like generic sales templates.



Strong grammar, spelling, tone, and written communication skills are required.



LinkedIn Compliance Is Extremely Important



Protecting my personal LinkedIn account and professional reputation is more important than maximizing outreach volume.



The following practices are NOT permitted:



No LinkedIn bots or unauthorized automation

No scraping tools

No automated browser extensions

No automated connection-request tools

No automated mass messaging

No indiscriminate bulk InMail

No fake or purchased LinkedIn accounts

No methods intended to circumvent LinkedIn limits

No mass connection requests simply to increase activity

No generic copy-and-paste spam

No aggressive repeated follow-ups

No misleading messages

No pretending to have an existing relationship with a prospect

No activity that could place my personal LinkedIn account at risk of restriction or suspension



We would rather contact fewer, highly qualified prospects with thoughtful outreach than generate large volumes of low-quality activity.



Use of AI



AI may be used as a research and writing assistant when appropriate, but it should never replace human judgment.



Any AI-assisted content must be:



Reviewed by a human

Factually accurate

Personalized

Written in natural English

Relevant to the recipient or audience

Edited so it does not sound generic or mass-produced



AI should help improve quality and efficiency—not create automated spam.



Outreach Philosophy



Research → personalize → engage → build a relationship → qualify → get the decision-maker on the phone.



This is a quality-over-quantity position.



Success is not about sending hundreds of messages per day. It is about finding the right people, building a credible LinkedIn presence, and creating real conversations with potential clients.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate will have:



Previous LinkedIn lead-generation experience

Experience managing an executive or business owner's LinkedIn presence

Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Excellent written English

Strong research skills

Strong professional judgment

Experience writing personalized outbound messages

Experience creating professional LinkedIn content

Good organizational and CRM/lead-tracking skills

Understanding of responsible LinkedIn outreach practices

Ability to work independently

Strong attention to detail



Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, medical billing, revenue cycle management, mental health, or addiction treatment is strongly preferred but not required.



What Success Looks Like



We will evaluate performance based on:



Quality of prospects identified

Quality and professionalism of my LinkedIn profile

Consistency and quality of LinkedIn content

Accuracy of lead information

Response rates

Meaningful conversations generated

Qualified decision-makers engaged

Calls or meetings generated

Quality of written outreach

Continued health and compliance of my LinkedIn account



The ultimate goal is to build my personal LinkedIn profile into a credible business-development channel that consistently generates qualified conversations with behavioral health owners and decision-makers who may benefit from our billing and revenue cycle services.

title: INSIDE SALES AGENT FOR REAL ESTATE ( NO ACCENT )
description:
*Please send your application and attach a voice recording with a quick intro about yourself!*



Job Description:

We are currently seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Real Estate appointment setter to join our dynamic sales team. As a Real Estate SDR, you will be responsible for qualifying leads, building relationships with prospective clients, and booking demo calls with our closers. Your role will be instrumental in driving the success of our sales team and ensuring the growth of our business.



Please Note: We are specifically looking for serious candidates who are committed to a long-term partnership with our company.



Responsibilities:



Call and nurture leads for our client accounts

Set appointments for our sales team with potential agents looking to partner with us

Reach agreed upon KPI targets by the deadline

Resolve lead inquiries

Set follow-up appointments to keep leads aware of latest developments

Qualifications:



Previous experience in sales, customer service, or other related fields

Fluent in English ( ZERO TO NO ACCENT! ) - This will ensure a faster hire*

Familiarity with CRM platforms

title: Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:

ALL DAY is a specialty cafe in West End, Brisbane. We serve great coffee, a focused food menu, and we're actively growing a catering and events arm. We're a small, fast-moving team — we set clear priorities, move quickly, and expect the people we work with to do the same.



The Role

We're looking for a remote Marketing Manager to own ALL DAY's marketing, PR, and growth — end to end. This is a senior role that spans both traditional and digital marketing. You'll set the priorities, build the campaigns, and drive the outcomes without needing to be directed week to week.



Roughly 70% of your time will be on revenue-driving activity: traditional marketing, catering outreach, community and resident marketing,
 campaigns, PR, and media relations. About 15–20% is brand upkeep — social media, website, in-store materials, signage. The remaining 10–15% is light executive assistant support to the owner.



If you're at your best when you're executing a clear brief, this role isn't the right fit. We need someone who can look at the business, identify what will move the needle, and go after it without being prompted.



Core Responsibilities

Marketing & Growth

Own ALL DAY's marketing strategy across traditional and digital channels — set the priorities, build the plan, execute it

Lead catering outreach: prospect lists,
 campaigns, follow-ups, booking tracking

Drive community and resident marketing: welcome packs, local area campaigns, print collateral, real estate agent partnerships

Manage
 marketing end-to-end: list growth, campaigns, segmentation, performance reporting

Create and coordinate in-store marketing materials: posters, flyers, seasonal promotions, A-frame signage



Public Relations

Build and maintain relationships with local media, food writers, and relevant publications

Pitch ALL DAY stories, milestones, and menu updates to Brisbane press and lifestyle outlets

Identify, pitch, and coordinate influencer visits and collaborations

Manage listings on food guides, review platforms, and local directories

Track PR and influencer coverage and report on outcomes



Digital & Brand

Instagram and Google Business: consistent posting, captions, story content, review responses

Website (Squarespace): content updates, landing pages, SEO basics

Coordinate packaging and print suppliers



Executive Assistant Support (10–15% of time)

Research tasks, appointment booking, supplier follow-ups

File and task system management

General administrative/personal admin support to the owner as needed



What We're Looking For

Solid traditional and digital marketing experience — you've run campaigns across multiple channels

PR background or strong PR instincts — you know how to pitch a story and build media relationships

Strong written communication — you can write copy that's warm, clear, and commercially aware

Experience with
 marketing platforms (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Mail Meteor, or similar)

You manage your own workload and don't need to be chased for updates

Hospitality or food & beverage experience is a genuine plus

Comfortable across Canva, Google Workspace, and Squarespace



Not the Right Fit If

You prefer waiting for a detailed task list before you can get started

Your background is primarily social media scheduling or admin work

You're not comfortable owning outcomes, only activities



How to Apply

Send your resume, a short cover note (3–5 sentences on why this role suits you), and at least one example or link to a campaign or project you've managed.

title: 2D Illustrator & Motion Designer for Cute Gamified Mobile App
description:
We’re looking for a talented 2D Illustrator and Motion Designer to work with us on an ongoing basis for Azora, a cute, gamified mobile app.



This is not primarily a UI/UX design role. We are looking for someone who can create the visual assets, characters, illustrations, and animations that give the app its personality.



What You’ll Create



You’ll help design and expand Azora’s visual world, including:



Mascot characters and mascot poses

Character expressions and variations

App logos and branding assets

Cute objects, rewards, collectibles, and decorations

Icons and gamification assets

Background illustrations and scenes

Empty states, onboarding illustrations, and achievement graphics

SVG/vector assets for use directly inside the mobile app

Short character animations and motion graphics

Animated rewards, celebrations, transitions, and interactions

Assets for social media and paid advertisements

Art Style



We’re looking for a style that feels:



Cute and expressive

Playful

Simple and clean

Colorful

Flat/vector based

Friendly and polished



Think along the lines of the visual quality and personality found in apps like Finch, Duolingo, Focus Friend, and other polished gamified consumer apps, while developing a unique style for Azora.



We will provide references and existing designs to work from.



A major part of the role will be taking an established character or visual style and creating new assets that feel completely consistent with it.



What We’re Looking For



You should be comfortable with:



Adobe Illustrator, Figma, Affinity Designer, or similar vector tools

Creating clean, production-ready SVG/vector artwork

Character and mascot illustration

Maintaining consistent proportions, colors, outlines, and style across many assets

Creating multiple poses and expressions for the same character

After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similar animation tools

Simple 2D character and object animation

Following visual references closely



You do not need to be an expert in every tool listed above. Strong illustration ability and a great eye for cute character design are the most important things.



Ideal Candidate



You’re a particularly good fit if you:



Have designed mascots or characters before

Have experience working on mobile apps or games

Understand what makes characters feel cute and expressive

Can simplify illustrations instead of over-designing them

Pay close attention to consistency

Can work independently after receiving references and direction

Are interested in a long-term role where you gradually help build an entire visual world

This Is an Ongoing Role



We are not looking for someone to create one logo and disappear.



There will be a continuous need for new mascot poses, animations, rewards, illustrations, seasonal assets, app content, and marketing creatives as Azora grows.



We would like to find one designer who can learn the Azora style deeply and become our go-to person for visual assets.



How to Apply



Please send:



A link to your portfolio

Your best examples of cute character, mascot, vector, or mobile game/app illustration

Any examples of 2D animation or motion design

The software you normally use



Please start your application with the word BLUE so we know you read the full posting.



If your portfolio is a strong fit, we may start with a small trial project before moving into ongoing work.

title: Full Stack and Mobile Developer, AI and Integrations
description:
We are an internationally operating digital marketing agency working with clients across different countries and industries.

We are looking for a reliable and proactive Full Stack and Mobile Developer to join our team on a long term basis. The position can be part time or full time, but in both cases we expect strong commitment, consistent availability and genuine ownership of the work.

You will contribute to websites, web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, dashboards, API integrations and AI powered features. Improve prototype and AI generated code before it is used in production.

Communicate progress, challenges and technical decisions clearly.

Professional experience with React and preferably Next.js.

Professional mobile development experience with React Native, Flutter or native technologies.

Backend development experience with Node.js and/or Python.

Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and third party services.

Good understanding of databases, data modelling and SQL.

Ability to connect frontend, backend, mobile applications, databases and external platforms.

Hands on experience building AI features, agents, integrations or automations using Claude, ChatGPT or similar APIs.

Communicates clearly and professionally.

Thinks logically and understands the wider objective behind a task.

Provides transparent progress updates.

Works independently while remaining closely connected to the team.

Is dependable and follows through on agreed responsibilities.

Is open to feedback and interested in continuously improving.



Commitment

Our team operates primarily in Europe (CET/CEST). Write "REMOTE" to make sure you have read the full job description at the beginning of your Cover letter.



You do not need to be based in Europe, but you must be able to provide reliable overlap with European working hours for communication, collaboration and scheduled meetings.



Part-time applicants should provide consistent weekly availability. Full-time applicants should be prepared to make this their primary professional role.

Previous experience within a digital agency, startup or international remote team.

Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar development tools.

PostgreSQL, Supabase or comparable database technologies.

Vercel and cloud deployment.

n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation platforms.

Google APIs, SEO platforms, analytics tools or reporting dashboards.

How to apply

Whether you are applying for a part time or full time position.

Your availability, time zone and expected monthly compensation.

Your GitHub profile, portfolio or examples of relevant work.

Examples of web and mobile applications you have developed.

At least one example of an AI powered feature, integration or automation you have built.

A short explanation of your personal contribution to each project.

We are especially interested in understanding how you solve problems, communicate and take ownership, not only which technologies you have used.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
About Us



At Apartment Lease Finders, we're more than apartment locators. We're problem solvers and advocates. Our mission is simple: help renters across Texas find a place they're proud to call home. Whether someone's relocating across the state or across the country, we make the search process personal, professional, and stress-free.



We've helped thousands of families find their next apartment, and we do it with a system that gets real results — backed by genuine care for every client who trusts us with their search.



God First. People Always.



Learn more at

This is more than a back-office role, it's a seat at the table as we scale. You'll keep the operational engine running (lease confirmation, invoicing, records accuracy), but just as importantly, you'll help us build the systems, hiring processes, and training infrastructure that let ALF grow into new markets and bring on new team members without losing quality. Sales/Client Success remains the client's single point of contact throughout, so your work is property-, systems-, and team-facing rather than client-facing.



We're looking for someone who's not just organized, but genuinely thinks in systems... someone who sees a repeated problem and wants to fix the process, not just the instance, and who's excited to grow with a mission-focused company as it scales.

-Reach out to properties to confirm lease terms are finalized and accurately reflected in our records

-Follow up on outstanding invoices/commissions with properties

Cross-Market Expansion Support



-Help stand up operational processes in new markets as ALF expands, based on what's working in Houston



Reporting & Visibility



-Track and report basic operational KPIs (lease volume, invoice turnaround, move-in confirmation rates) to keep leadership informed without needing to ask





Team



-Join and actively participate in weekly team meetings





What We're Looking For:



-Prior experience in operations, systems/process coordination, or a hybrid admin + hiring support role

-Excellent communication skills — written and verbal

-Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning ambiguous problems, not just checklists

-Comfortable working across tools like Claude, Google Meet, GoHighLevel (GHL), Airtable, and AI-assisted workflows

-Some experience with hiring, screening, or onboarding is a strong plus

****Bonus: experience in real estate, leasing, or property management





Perks:



-Work remotely with a mission-driven, faith-grounded team

-Real opportunity to grow within the company as we expand across Houston, Dallas, Austin, and San Antonio

-Ongoing mentorship and access to resources for skill development

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
I am looking for a reliable, creative video editor to help grow my YouTube, Instagram, and other social media platforms.



The primary responsibility will be editing long-form YouTube vlogs and turning that footage into short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.



My YouTube content will primarily use a simple, personality-driven vlog style similar to Sam Sulek — clean cuts, good pacing, natural conversations, training footage, minimal unnecessary effects, and an emphasis on storytelling rather than over-editing.



Expected weekly workload:



• 3 long-form YouTube videos per week

• Approximately 20–35 minutes finished length each

• 8–10 short-form videos per week

• Shorts will be created from the long-form footage

• Basic thumbnails when needed

• Organize footage and project files



Long-form editing style:



• Clean, simple cuts

• Remove unnecessary dead space

• Maintain natural personality and conversations

• Basic color correction

• Clean and balance audio

• Occasional text or graphics when useful

• Minimal transitions/effects

• Understand pacing and storytelling



Short-form editing:



• Identify strong moments/hooks from long-form footage

• 30–90 second vertical videos

• Captions/subtitles

• Punch-ins/zoom-ins when appropriate

• Strong pacing without making the videos feel over-edited

• Understand what makes fitness/bodybuilding content engaging



You will be working primarily with bodybuilding, fitness, lifestyle, business, and behind-the-scenes content.



I am looking for someone who can eventually understand my style well enough that I do not have to give detailed editing instructions for every video.



Requirements:



• Strong English comprehension

• Experience editing YouTube videos

• Experience editing Reels/Shorts/TikToks

• Reliable internet connection

• Able to work with 4K footage

• Good communication

• Consistent turnaround times

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to take feedback and make revisions



Experience with fitness or bodybuilding content is a plus but not required.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:



Please include:



1. Your editing portfolio

2. 2–3 examples of long-form videos you have edited

3. 2–3 examples of short-form videos you have edited

4. What editing software you use

5. Approximately how long it would take you to edit a 30-minute finished YouTube vlog

6. Your internet download/upload speed

7. Put the word WOLF at the beginning of your application so I know you read the full job description.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a paid editing test before being hired.



This is intended to be a long-term position with the opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance.

description:
AI-Assisted eLearning Course Developer & Instructional Designer



Location: Remote - Philippines

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

Important: This is an overnight schedule in the Philippines. Applicants must be comfortable working these hours consistently.

Position: Full-time

Company: EdgePath.pro



About the Position



We are looking for a skilled and dependable eLearning Course Developer and Instructional Designer to help us create professional online training courses.



Our courses cover subjects such as:

- Security systems

- Access control

- Video surveillance

- Low-voltage installation

- Cybersecurity

- Workplace safety

- Technician training

- Customer service and professional development



This is not only a writing position and not only a web development position. The selected person must be able to take raw information, technical documents, subject-matter-expert notes, videos, existing presentations, and AI-generated material and turn them into a complete, polished, interactive online course. The ideal candidate understands instructional design, HTML5 development, Reveal.js, SCORM, AI-assisted workflows, quality control, and LMS testing.



Primary Responsibilities



The selected candidate will be responsible for:

- Researching course topics using reliable and credible sources.

- Organizing information into modules, lessons, and learning objectives.

- Writing course content, narration scripts, scenarios, case studies, and assessments.

- Converting technical material into content that is clear and easy to understand.

- Building interactive presentations and courses using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and Reveal.js.

- Creating responsive courses that work properly on desktop computers, tablets, and mobile devices.

- Creating quizzes, knowledge checks, drag-and-drop activities, scenarios, and interactive exercises.

- Adding narration, captions, audio controls, progress tracking, timers, and completion requirements.

- Packaging and testing courses in SCORM 1.2 and/or SCORM 2004.

- Testing course completion, scores, bookmarking, resume behavior, and LMS communication.

- Troubleshooting HTML, JavaScript, CSS, browser, audio, and LMS-related issues.

- Testing courses in platforms such as LearnDash, Tin Canny, or similar learning-management systems.

- Using AI tools to assist with research, outlines, scripts, assessments, coding, quality assurance, and course production.

- Reviewing and correcting AI-generated material instead of copying it without verification.

- Maintaining organized project files, naming standards, version control, checklists, and production documentation.

- Communicating progress, delays, problems, and recommendations clearly.

- Completing work accurately and on schedule with limited supervision.



Required Qualifications



Applicants should have experience with most of the following:

- HTML5

- CSS

- JavaScript

- Responsive web development

- Reveal.js or a similar HTML presentation framework

- Instructional design

- eLearning course development

- SCORM concepts

- Learning-management systems

- Quiz and assessment development

- AI-assisted content creation

- Technical writing or educational content writing

- Browser developer tools and troubleshooting

- Mobile and desktop quality assurance



Candidates who have not previously used Reveal.js may still be considered, but they must have strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills and be able to demonstrate that they can learn Reveal.js quickly.



AI Experience



The candidate should know how to use AI tools for tasks such as:

- Course research

- Course outlines

- Learning objectives

- Narration scripts

- Scenario development

- Quiz generation

- Coding assistance

- HTML and JavaScript troubleshooting

- Editing and rewriting

- Quality assurance

- Fact-checking assistance

- Image and media planning



We are not looking for someone who simply copies and pastes AI-generated content. The candidate must be able to:

- Write effective prompts.

- Review AI output critically.

- Detect incorrect or invented information.

- Verify important facts.

- Improve the tone and instructional quality.

- Maintain consistency throughout a large course.

- Explain and defend the final work.



Computer and Internet Requirements



The candidate must have:

- A dependable computer capable of handling web development and multimedia course production.

- A modern processor and SSD storage.

- At least 16 GB of RAM preferred.

- A quality headset and microphone.

- A quiet and professional work environment.

- Reliable high-speed internet.

- Backup internet, such as a secondary provider or mobile hotspot.

- A backup plan for electrical outages.

- A webcam for meetings and project discussions.

- The ability to attend online meetings during U.S. Central Time.



Work Schedule and Availability



This is a full-time position. The employee must be available Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time. Because this schedule occurs overnight in the Philippines, applicants should only apply when they are comfortable maintaining an overnight work schedule on a long-term basis. The candidate must be fully available and responsive during the scheduled working hours.



Preferred Experience



Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

- Reveal.js

- LearnDash

- SCORM 1.2

- SCORM 2004

- xAPI

title: Construction Procurement Coordinator
description:
We're a Canadian real-estate developer in Halifax, Nova Scotia, building multi-unit residential projects. We don't self-perform — every trade and supplier is external. Which means our schedule lives or dies on whether materials and people show up when we said they would.



This job is chasing that, and it is more important than it sounds. Done well, procurement create value and it prevents loss. Nothing arrives late, nothing gets ordered twice, no crew stands around waiting for windows. That's the whole win, and right now nobody owns it.



**What you'll own**



- Sending RFQs, chasing quotes, comparing them like for like

- Raising purchase orders and tracking every one from order to delivery

- Knowing the required-on-site date for every long-lead item on every project — and knowing today whether we're going to miss it

- Following up. Then following up again. Then following up a third time

- Keeping the procurement tracker true enough that our PM can plan against it



**Who fits**



You are relentlessly organised. You follow up without being asked twice. When you're not sure of something, you ask someone — you don't guess and you don't quietly make it up. You are comfortable phoning and
ing suppliers who are ignoring you, repeatedly, politely, until they answer.



Construction experience helps and we'll teach what's missing. Purchasing, expediting, logistics or supply-chain background counts. So does being the person in your last job who everyone relied on because you never dropped anything.



**Hours**



Some overlap with Atlantic Canada mornings for supplier calls. We'll agree the exact window with you.



**Pay**



Tell us your number.



**To apply**



Put TRANSOM as the first word of your application. Then:



1. Show us how you tracked something with many moving parts — orders, deliveries, follow-ups. A screenshot or file beats a description.



2. A supplier has ignored three
s over eight days. The material is needed on site in three weeks. What exactly do you do next? Write the message you'd send.



3. Tell us about something that was late and it was your fault. What happened, and what did you change afterwards?
