title: Recruiter
description:
Recruiter (Talent Acquisition Specialist)

Childcare Marketing | Remote-First | Full-Time





Position Overview

We are looking for a Recruiter who can identify exceptional talent, build strong candidate relationships, and help Childcare Marketing and our clients build high-performing teams.



The Recruiter owns the full recruitment lifecycle - from sourcing and attracting candidates to conducting interviews, managing communication, and supporting successful hires. This role requires someone who understands that great recruiting is not about collecting resumes; it is about finding the right people who align with the opportunity, culture, and long-term goals.



You will partner closely with hiring managers to understand their needs, create effective sourcing strategies, and deliver a seamless hiring experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.





Why You Should Work Here 



Work That Matters: You transform lives by connecting families who need quality child care with the providers who serve them. 



Recession-Proof Growth: An established, fast-growing company that continues to thrive while many competitors struggle. 



Leadership That Has Your Back: A supportive, attentive team that answers your questions and helps you grow, professionally and personally. 



An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business - not just a name on the door. 



Small-Team Feel: A friendly, tight-knit environment where you are a person, not a headcount. 



Remote-First Flexibility: Work remotely while staying connected to a fast-moving, collaborative team. Buffalo-area candidates may also have opportunities for occasional in-person meetings, strategy sessions, or team gatherings. 



Top-of-Market Pay: We pay above market because we hire the best and want to keep them. 



Train to Be the Best: Access $100K+ in training, courses, and materials - enough to make you more knowledgeable than 99.9% of the account managers our competitors employ. 



A Workspace That Feels 
 Working from home can get lonely, so our virtual Sims-like office keeps the team connected day to day. 



Quarterly Town Halls: Every quarter, you get a full state-of-the-company update, so you are never guessing where things stand. 



The Dream-On Program: Each year, our CEO grants multiple wishes pulled straight from tea
mbers' dream boards. 



25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because we want you to have a real life outside work. 



Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days a year to volunteer with any charity you choose. 





What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will develop a strong understanding of our hiring process, company culture, and the types of people who thrive at Childcare Marketing. You'll begin building robust talent pipelines, earning the trust of hiring managers, and taking ownership of recruiting outcomes. Ongoing, you will be measured on:



Hiring Success: Consistently identify, attract, and hire exceptional candidates who are aligned with both the role and our culture.



Quality of Hire: Present high-caliber candidates who are well-qualified, thoroughly evaluated, and ready to succeed—not just available to interview.



Time to Hire: Keep recruitment processes moving efficiently while maintaining an exceptional candidate experience and high hiring standards.



Talent Pipeline: Build and maintain proactive pipelines for key roles, reducing the time needed to fill future openings.

Candidate Experience: Deliver a professional, responsive, and engaging experience that reflects positively on Childcare Marketing from first contact through onboarding.



Hiring Manager Partnership: Become a trusted partner to hiring managers by communicating proactively, providing thoughtful recommendations, and helping them make confident hiring decisions.



Recruitment Process Excellence: Continuously improve our hiring process through better organization, documentation, reporting, and data-driven recommendations.



Employer Brand: Represent Childcare Marketing with professionalism and enthusiasm, helping us become an employer of choice for top talent.





A Typical Week Might Include



Partnering with hiring managers to understand current hiring priorities, define ideal candidates, and create effective recruitment strategies.



Sourcing and engaging qualified candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, Monster, job boards, referrals, networking, and other talent channels.



Reviewing applications and identifying candidates who have the skills, experience, and mindset needed to succeed in the role.



Conducting structured screening interviews to evaluate qualifications, motivation, communication skills, and cultural alignment.



Managing candidate communication throughout the hiring process to ensure a professional and positive experience from first contact through the offer stage.



Coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and keeping hiring processes moving efficiently.



Building and maintaining talent pipelines so we are prepared for future hiring needs—not just reacting to open positions.



Maintaining accurate candidate records, recruitment activity, and hiring updates within our ATS.



Reviewing recruitment metrics and identifying opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, candidate quality, and hiring efficiency.



Supporting employer branding initiatives that strengthen Childcare Marketing's reputation as a place where talented people want to work.









Key Competencies



Talent Sourcing & Recruitment Strategy: Ability to proactively identify, attract, and engage qualified candidates through multiple sourcing channels.



Candidate Assessment: Skilled at evaluating experience, skills, motivation, and cultural alignment to identify top talent.



Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and consistently with candidates, hiring managers, and internal teams.



Organization & Attention to Detail: Manages multiple open roles, candidate pipelines, deadlines, and recruitment activities without letting important details slip.



Ownership & Accountability:  Takes responsibility for recruitment outcomes and proactively solves challenges throughout the hiring process.



Relationship Building: Builds trust with candidates and hiring managers through responsiveness, professionalism, and genuine engagement.







This Role Is Not for You If



You only prefer posting jobs and waiting for candidates instead of actively sourcing and building relationships.



You see recruiting as simply filling vacancies rather than finding the right person for the right opportunity.



You are uncomfortable conducting interviews or making recommendations based on candidate quality.



You need constant reminders to follow up, document next steps, or keep hiring processes moving.



You avoid difficult conversations with candidates or hiring managers.



You are not comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.



You focus on the number of applicants rather than the quality of candidates presented.



You prefer administrative tasks over building relationships and influencing hiring outcomes.







Skills and Experience Required



3–5 years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or a similar role.



Proven experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing candidates through offer acceptance.



Strong sourcing, networking, and candidate engagement skills, with the ability to proactively identify and attract qualified talent.



Experience conducting structured interviews, screening candidates, and evaluating qualifications, skills, and cultural fit.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple open roles and priorities simultaneously.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with hiring managers and cross-functional teams.



Experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms such as Jazz Recruiter, Indeed, Monster, LinkedIn, and other job boards or sourcing tools.



Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate candidate records, track recruitment activity, and manage candidate communication throughout the hiring process.







Preferred Skills and Experience



Previous experience recruiting for remote-first teams or distributed organizations.



Experience supporting multiple departments, hiring managers, or client accounts simultaneously.



Experience recruiting within a digital marketing agency, creative agency, technology company, SaaS business, or other fast-paced professional services environment.



Experience hiring for marketing, creative, sales, customer success, operations, or other client-facing roles.



Experience building proactive talent pipelines rather than relying solely on inbound applicants.



Experience tracking recruitment metrics such as source effectiveness, time-to-fill, candidate quality, interview conversion rates, and hiring outcomes.



Demonstrated ability to improve recruiting processes, strengthen candidate experience, and introduce more efficient ways of attracting top talent.



Experience working in an agency environment where speed, adaptability, communication, and delivering results are critical.







Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position.





About Childcare Marketing Group

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

title: Media Buyer / Performance Marketing Lead
description:
Join REEKON Tools, a US based company, as we upgrade the tools professionals use on construction projects big and small!  We are looking for an experienced Media Buyer to take full ownership of our paid acquisition across Meta and Google.  We make a variety of construction tools and software that we sell online and in stores to customers across the globe.

 

You will own roughly $1-1.5M in annual ad spend across Meta and Google.  This is a hands-on, in-platform role where  you will build, test, and optimize campaigns yourself, and you will do it alongside an internal creative team that produces a high volume of video and static assets into a high functioning machine.  Your job is to feed that engine, tell the creative team what is working and what to make next, and turn their output into profitable growth.  We will primarily be running ads to our own website which is Shopify based.

 

We are looking for someone who thinks in blended terms rather than platform reported ROAS, who has a real testing methodology rather than a list of hacks, and who is comfortable being the single owner of a budget this size.  If you have run seven figures a year and can walk us through the account, we want to talk.



This will be a full time remote role.



The Role



• Own day to day management of approximately $1.2M in annual paid spend across Meta and Google (Shopping, Performance Max, Search, and YouTube)

• Build, launch, and optimize campaigns in platform — account structure, budgets, bidding, audiences, and daily pacing

• Run a structured creative testing program with our internal creative team, and brief them on what to produce next based on what the data actually shows

• Report performance against blended MER and contribution margin targets, not just platform reported ROAS

• Manage our product data feeds for Google Shopping and the Meta catalog, including feed quality, titles, and segmentation

• Own tracking accuracy across Meta Pixel and CAPI, Google tags, and GA4, and surface discrepancies before they distort decisions

• Plan and run landing page and offer tests to improve conversion rate on paid traffic

•Help us grow demand creation and not only demand capture — we want to build new intent, not just harvest what already exists

• Create automations (n8n and Zapier) for reporting, pacing alerts, and creative trafficking

• Recommend where budget should move, including telling us clearly when we should be spending less

 

Your Background



• Minimum 4 years of hands on media buying experience, including at least 2 years with direct personal responsibility for $75-150k per month in spend

• Demonstrable ecommerce or DTC experience.  You must be able to walk us through accounts you personally ran, with real numbers

• Strong across both Meta and Google.  If you are meaningfully stronger on one, tell us which and be honest about the gap

• Working command of blended metrics (MER, CAC, contribution margin) and a clear view of when platform reported numbers are misleading you

• Solid measurement fundamentals: pixel and CAPI setup, conversion tracking, attribution windows, and the basics of incrementality testing

• Experience partnering with an in house creative team.  Writing briefs, diagnosing creative fatigue, and turning results into the next round of assets

• Exceptional written English - grammar, tone, and clarity must be outstanding, as you will be writing briefs and analyses we act on

title: Composer for Original Sonic Identity, YouTube Travel Channel (One Time Buyout)
description:
Remote | One Time Buyout



I am commissioning the sonic identity for my YouTube travel channel. One time project, full buyout, no ongoing commitment on either side.



ABOUT THE CHANNEL

Travel with Schu is a long form travel documentary channel. Real adventures in places most people never go, the food, the people, the corners off the tourist trail. Recent films shot in Lebanon, China and the United States.



WHAT I AM ACTUALLY BUYING

Not a song. A sting. Two to four seconds, one memorable phrase, plus longer bed versions cut from the same motif.



A jingle between cutscenes works because it is identical every single time, not because the underlying music is good. Repetition is the entire mechanism. This is a brand asset in the same category as a logo, and it will be treated as one.



THE REFERENCE

The benchmark is Simon Wilson's channel and his "Honey" sting, composed by David Cutter Music. His audience recognises it within about two seconds, and that recognition comes from playing the identical phrase in every single video, not from the music being complicated. That is exactly the effect I want.



The difference is that his is a free to use library track anyone can license. Mine needs to be original and owned outright, so it belongs to this channel and no other.



Please listen to it before you apply. Match the effect, not the sound. Anything that resembles it directly will be rejected.



THE ONE HARD CONSTRAINT



It has to work over Mississippi and Bali. Anything locked to one region or one genre breaks the moment the channel leaves that place. This is the first filter I will apply and it eliminates most obvious ideas.



DELIVERABLES





2 second stab. Hard transition sting. The workhorse, used between scenes



4 second version. Chapter card and cutscene title. Same motif, resolved ending



15 second bed. Sits under the cold open. Loopable, no hard ending



30 second bed. Optional. Seamless loop for longer setup sections



Stems. Drums, melody and bass delivered as separate files so my editor can strip elements down under dialogue



Format. WAV, 48kHz, 24 bit, plus MP3 reference copies



Motif. Every version derived from one four to six note phrase. Non negotiable



THE FIVE DIRECTIONS I AM SEARCHING AGAINST



Pitch against one of these, or propose your own if you can justify it against the Mississippi and Bali test.





Retro travelogue brass. Muted trumpet, vibraphone, walking bass. Sixties spy lounge, 110 to 130 BPM. Reads instantly as passport and adventure. Risk is tipping into pastiche if the arrangement is busy



Whistle and stomp. Handclaps, tambourine, foot stomp, whistled four note hook, 100 to 120 BPM. Whistling is the stickiest thing a human brain retains and it survives phone speakers at low volume. Risk is that it is heavily used in advertising, so it needs a distinctive interval



Brass fanfare stab. Single horn hit, one deep drum, short tail, two seconds maximum. The bold option, excellent as a Shorts hook. Risk is reading as sports broadcast or news bumper



Warm analog arp. Tape saturated synth arpeggio, four notes, soft attack. Neutral and global, cuts cleanly under a text card without fighting a voiceover. Risk is being genuinely generic



I have already ruled out delta blues and resonator slide as the primary. It sounds excellent but it fails the Mississippi and Bali test.

CONTRACT TERMS

These are not negotiable. Please only apply if you accept all four.





Full buyout. Worldwide, perpetual, all media, all platforms, including monetised YouTube and TikTok, sponsored content and paid advertising



Written confirmation of no third party samples. Every element original or from a cleared royalty free sample library



You must not register the work with Content ID. This is the one that catches people out. Composers routinely register their own catalogue, which then automatically claims videos using music I paid to own. I need this in writing



Exclusivity. You cannot resell or relicense the finished sting to anyone else



You will be credited by name in the description of every video on the channel and on the channel about page.



TIMELINE AND REVISIONS



One to two weeks turnaround. One revision round included. Please price accordingly.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not reply to this post directly. Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.



Fill out the application form here: 

For anything else, or if the form does not work for you,
 



Please link your portfolio in the form. Original work only, no AI generated tracks.

However, social media posting may be part of the scope as the role evolves. 



Because this person will represent the company in direct conversations with external partners, exceptional written English, grammar, professionalism, and communication judgment are essential.

* Secure appropriate organic and paid-media usage rights for high-performing content.



* Develop long-term relationships with strong partners and identify opportunities for repeat collaborations.



* Monitor partnership performance and report on content delivery, traffic, sales, engagement, costs, and return on investment.



* Work closely with the company’s marketing, creative, ecommerce, and leadership teams.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok,

* Ability to manage a high volume of conversations without losing important information or missing follow-ups.

* Sound judgment when representing a consumer brand publicly and privately.

* Ability to evaluate whether a creator is a strong commercial fit—not simply whether they have a large following.

* Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of results, and escalating important decisions when necessary.

* Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote work environment.

* Availability for regular overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



* Previous experience in influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, business development, or social media outreach.

* Experience negotiating U.S.-based creator or influencer agreements.

* Familiarity with ecommerce, Shopify, affiliate platforms, and performance marketing.

* Experience working with apparel, fitness, wellness, outdoor, lifestyle, or direct-to-consumer brands.

* Experience tracking partnership activity using spreadsheets, project-management tools, or CRM platforms.

* Understanding of FTC disclosure requirements and content usage rights.

* Experience reviewing social media analytics and identifying fake followers or low-quality engagement.



What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



* Build a consistent pipeline of qualified partnership opportunities.

* Generate strong response rates through thoughtful, personalized outreach.

* Negotiate financially responsible deals that protect the company’s interests.

* Maintain organized and accurate partnership records.

* Keep partners engaged and projects moving without excessive supervision.

* Secure high-quality content and commercially valuable usage rights.

* Develop repeat relationships with partners who generate meaningful awareness, content, traffic, and sales.

* Communicate with the polish and professionalism expected from an official company representative.



Performance Measures



Performance may be evaluated using:



* Number of qualified partners identified and contacted

* Outreach response rate

* Partnerships successfully negotiated and activated

* Average partnership cost and negotiated value

* Content completion and on-time delivery rate

* Paid-media and organic usage rights secured

* Affiliate revenue and attributed sales

* Cost per piece of usable content

* Return on partnership investment

* Successful partners retained for repeat campaigns

How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your résumé.

2. A brief explanation of your relevant partnership, influencer, affiliate, or business-development experience.

3. A sample Instagram DM introducing a U.S.-based performance apparel company to a fitness or lifestyle creator.

4. A sample follow-up message to a creator who has not responded after five days.

5. A short response explaining how you would negotiate with a creator requesting a $1,000 fee when the approved budget is $500.

6. Your expected monthly compensation in U.S. dollars.

7. Your availability for working hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Applications containing major grammatical errors, generic responses, or copied-and-pasted outreach will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Outbound Caller - B2B Construction (Experienced, Remote)
description:
ABOUT HT BLINDS

HT Blinds is Vancouver's factory-direct window coverings manufacturer. 



Our commercial pipeline is built by phone. That is what this role exists to do.



THE ROLE

You will call construction companies from our list and find the right person.



That means navigating past reception, identifying who holds the role we need - project manager, estimator, or whoever handles subtrade procurement - and confirming their name, title, direct line, and
. You will note what you learn about the company's current activity, and you will follow up on the schedule the system gives you.



Every call is logged in our CRM the same day, in the structured fields provided. The record is the deliverable. A call that is not logged properly did not happen.



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO

Read this carefully. It is as important as the list above.

- You do not quote, price, or discuss cost. Ever.

- You do not negotiate, sell, or try to close anything.

- If a conversation turns into a live opportunity, you hand it to our sales lead the same morning. You do not carry it forward yourself.



Your job is to find the right person and record what you learn. Our team takes it from there.



HOURS

8:00 AM - 12:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday to Friday. This window is not flexible. It is when construction project managers are at their desks and before they leave for site.



In the Philippines that is 11:00 PM - 3:00 AM your local time. Apply only if you can hold this window consistently, five days a week, without exception.



The trial is three weeks at 20 hours per week. Hours increase after that for callers who meet the bar.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Clear, easily understood English on the phone. This is the single biggest requirement.

- Gatekeeper navigation. Building quick rapport with a receptionist and getting to the right person is a distinct skill, and it is most of this job.

- Confidence with brief, direct conversations. Construction people are busy and blunt. That is normal, not rejection.

- Disciplined data entry. Detail-oriented, with real follow-up discipline.

- Willingness to learn construction vocabulary - tender, scope letter, bid close. We train this. You have to want to learn it.

- Reliable internet, backup power, a quiet room, and a proper headset.

- Proven outbound calling, appointment setting, or B2B research experience. This is not an entry-level role. We are hiring experienced callers only.



Helpful, not required: any exposure to construction, trades, building supply, or architecture.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- A Canadian phone line through our own system, so your calls show a local Vancouver number

- CRM access, with everything you need for each call prepared in advance

- Scripts for every call type, plus recorded examples

- Direct coaching from our sales lead in the first weeks



HOW WE MEASURE THE TRIAL

Not raw dial counts. We measure:

- Contacts confirmed - name, title, direct line, and
 verified

- Records completed accurately, every field, same day

- Follow-ups kept on schedule



COMPENSATION

$7 to $8 USD per hour depending on experience, paid weekly, plus a per-outcome bonus for each confirmed contact record.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications missing any of these four items will not be reviewed.



1. Put the word SPECLINE in the first line of your application.



2. Record a voice sample, 60 to 90 seconds. Use this scenario:

You are calling a mid-sized general contractor for the first time. A receptionist answers. Your goal is to find out who handles subtrade procurement there and get that person's direct line.

Record the opening of that call as you would actually make it. Audio only. Any recorder is fine. Attach the audio file to your application or include a link to it.



3. In two or three sentences, tell us what you would do if the receptionist says: "We don't give out that information."



4. State your local time zone and the exact local hours that 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM Pacific corresponds to for you, and confirm you can work them five days a week.



HT Blinds - Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

Your job is to connect those systems into a thin, Wentwood-controlled integration and automation layer and build the technology on top of it, so data moves where it needs to, we can see what is happening across the business, and AI agents can work across functions instead of inside one tool. You will use the systems that already work, preserve clear systems of record, and avoid creating unnecessary duplicate infrastructure or databases. 



This is not a machine learning or data science role. We are looking for a builder. 



What You’ll Do:



- Build and operate the technical foundation for company-wide automation and AI, including integrations, service identities, permissions, secrets, logging, monitoring, exception handling, deployment, and rollback procedures 

-Build AI agents that can use tools, interact with company systems, and complete multi-step workflows 

-Build cross-functional agents that can pull information from one system, take action in another, and hand off to a person when judgment or approval is required 

-Turn documented SOPs and playbooks into working automations and agentic workflows 

- Connect our third-party platforms through APIs and webhooks as the default integration approach, using Power Automate, Zapier, Make, n8n, custom code, and controlled agent tools such as MCP where appropriate

-Build the infrastructure around automations and agents, including permissions, human approval gates, guardrails, retries, logging, alerts, evaluations, and human review 

-Write Python or JavaScript when no-code tools are not enough 

-Build agents for QC, document review, drafting, data extraction, research, reporting, and task execution 

-Monitor automations and agents, identify failures, and improve reliability 

-Test new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation tools and determine what is actually useful in production 

-Document what you build so systems can be maintained and improved over time 

-Ensure production code, repositories, service accounts, credentials, and documentation remain under Wentwood-controlled accounts rather than depending on an individual employee or contractor 



What We’re Looking For:



- 2+ years of experience building automations, integrations, internal tools, or software 

- Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents and agentic workflows 

- Experience with tool calling, multi-step execution, structured outputs, context management, and human-in-the-loop workflows

If your AI experience is primarily prompting ChatGPT or building basic automations, this is not the right role. 



Goal: Take documented business processes and turn them into reliable AI agents, automations, and connected systems that can operate across business functions, reduce manual work, and help our team operate at a significantly higher level while maintaining clear systems of record, human approval boundaries, production controls, and Wentwood ownership of the underlying infrastructure.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Raddix Property Group is a Philadelphia-based real estate investment and development firm. Their portfolio centers on historical row home mansions — acquired, fully renovated from close to certificate of occupancy (typically a 9-month cycle), and held for rental income. The business operates across multiple properties, multiple banks, and active development projects running simultaneously.



The firm's current fractional bookkeeper/controller has deep institutional knowledge of the business but is scaling back her involvement. Raddix needs a full-time Virtual Professional to own the day-to-day bookkeeping function — keeping the books clean, closing on time, every time — so the leadership team can stop chasing data and start making decisions.



The principal contact, Jim Farrell, is the CFO. 



Core Bookkeeping (Primary Responsibility):

• Maintain the books across the Raddix property portfolio in QuickBooks Desktop

• Post all journal entries, debits, and credits accurately and on time

• Perform bank reconciliations across multiple accounts (Mid-Penn, Univest, Truist, and others) using read-only bank feeds

• Execute hard closes and soft closes on schedule — no multi-month lag, no exceptions

• Manage accounts payable: mortgages, payroll, legal retainers, real estate agent commissions, recurring vendor expenses

• Maintain organized, audit-ready books that can support lender and investor requests

• Maintain, renew, and execute insurance policies for properties and construction 



Cash Position & Draw Schedule Support (Secondary Responsibility):

• Update and maintain the daily/weekly cash position worksheet — tracking rent roll receipts, scheduled payables, and available liquidity across all accounts

• Track mid-month and end-of-month construction bank draw schedules; flag draw timing shifts or delays that affect cash position

• Flag upcoming cash crunches based on draw timing, deferred costs, and AP obligations — give leadership lead time, not surprises

• Maintain separation between operating accounts, development accounts, and deferred maintenance reserves



Reporting & Coordination:

• Produce monthly financial packages (balance sheet, P&L, cash position summary) on a defined close schedule

• Surface data questions and discrepancies to Jim Farrell for resolution rather than making unilateral adjusting entries

title: Revenue Management
description:
We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with genuine, hands-on revenue management experience. Pricing is the heart of this role. You will own PriceLabs across our entire portfolio, and that is where your performance will be measured. The remaining hours are spent running the properties day to day, which is what makes the pricing work: you cannot price a portfolio well if you do not know what is actually happening in it.



This is not an entry-level admin role. You will be setting base prices, tuning minimum stays, building comp sets and reading market data, then acting on what it tells you.



Our target is 85 to 90% occupancy across the portfolio. Low occupancy means the price is too high. A calendar filling too fast means the price is too low. If reading that sentence made you want to open a dashboard, we want to hear from you.



This is a long-term position with room to grow into a senior property manager or client success role.



Responsibilities:



Revenue Management (the core of the role, approx. 8 hrs/week):

Own day-to-day dynamic pricing across the full portfolio in PriceLabs.

Set and maintain base prices, minimum prices, seasonal profiles, dynamic minimum stays, orphan gap rules and last-minute discounts.

Build and maintain competitor sets for each property and monitor Market Dashboards for pricing and occupancy trends.

Monitor pace and pickup against the 85 to 90% occupancy target and adjust proactively rather than reactively.

Manage PriceLabs syncing with our PMS (Hostfully) and troubleshoot listings not pushing rates correctly.

Connect and configure new properties in PriceLabs as they are onboarded.

Report on ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and revenue by property, and flag underperforming listings early with a recommended fix.

Property Management (approx. 32 hrs/week):

Manage guest communications through our PMS and AI messaging tools, maintaining our five-star communication standard and fast response times.

Coordinate changeover cleaning teams across the portfolio, confirm turnovers are scheduled and completed, and review the post-clean video for every property, including under beds, all white goods, and under sofas and tables.

Handle maintenance issues end to end: triage the report, dispatch the right contractor, chase to completion, confirm the fix.

Manage guest issues and complaints using our established templates, and handle Airbnb Resolution Centre requests including damage and additional charge claims.

Monitor reviews, respond appropriately, and escalate anything that may warrant a removal case.

Keep listings, calendars, property information and compliance records accurate and up to date across all channels.

Support onboarding of new properties: gather property details, populate guest manuals, set up listings and get them live.

Write and maintain SOPs as processes are established.

Client Support:

Handle client inquiries and assist with invoicing, questions, and other support needs.

Prepare owner-facing revenue and performance summaries.

Business Support:

Manage and update tracking sheets, databases, and other business-related data.

Verify supplier invoices and prepare payments for approval.

Assist with various administrative tasks to support business growth.



Requirements:



Substantial hands-on experience with PriceLabs. You should be able to talk us through settings you have changed, why, and what happened to revenue as a result.

Proven short-term rental revenue management experience: ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, pace and pickup, booking windows, seasonality and comp sets.

Comfortable with numbers and able to reason about supply and demand rather than just follow a checklist. A background in economics, finance, data or hotel/airline revenue management is a strong advantage.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

A proactive, responsible, and reliable attitude.

Access to strong WIFI and a computer.



Desired Qualities:



Excited about working with a growing company on a long-term basis.

Ability to work independently and take initiative. Nobody will be checking your calendar for you.

Good judgement and commercial intuition. We would rather have someone who can spot that a price looks wrong than someone who can recite the jargon.

A positive, can-do attitude.

title: Design and Admin Support
description:
Full-Time Remote Role | Australian Construction & Engineering Business



We are looking for a technically capable **Construction Estimating & CAD Support Assistant** to work directly with the owner of a growing Australian construction, structural steel, civil and manufacturing business.



This is "not a general virtual assistant position"



A strong understanding of construction drawings, estimating and CAD drafting is a key requirement of the role. General business and administrative support will also form part of the position, but we are specifically looking for someone with enough construction knowledge to understand the work they are assisting with.



The successful applicant will ideally have a background in civil engineering, structural engineering, drafting, quantity surveying, construction estimating or a closely related field



You will work directly with the business owner across estimating, design, tenders, project tracking, procurement and general business administration.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Assisting with construction estimating and quantity take-offs

* Reading and interpreting detailed structural, civil and architectural drawings

* Reviewing engineering drawings, specifications and tender documentation

* Measuring quantities from drawings for steel, concrete, earthworks, civil works and other construction items

* Assisting with preparation of tender estimates and pricing schedules

* Obtaining and comparing supplier and subcontractor quotations

* Identifying discrepancies, missing information and potential issues within drawings and specifications

* Preparing and modifying AutoCAD drawings

* Producing basic structural, civil and fabrication drawings from sketches or instructions

* Updating drawings following design changes

* Understanding dimensions, sections, elevations, details and construction terminology

* Assisting with preliminary design development and preparation of information for engineers

* Maintaining tender and project trackers

* Following up outstanding quotations, drawings, approvals and project information

* Preparing spreadsheets, schedules and comparison tables

* Assisting with procurement and material enquiries

* Drafting professional
s and correspondence

* Researching construction products, suppliers, technical information and project requirements

* Organising project files and documentation

* General administrative support to the business owner



The role will be varied. You may spend part of the day doing a quantity take-off from structural drawings, then modify a CAD drawing, obtain supplier pricing, update a project tracker and prepare correspondence to a client or engineer.



Construction & Technical Skills



Applicants should have a genuine understanding of construction and engineering drawings.



You should be comfortable reading:



* Site plans

* General arrangement drawings

* Structural plans

* Civil drawings

* Sections and elevations

* Structural steel details

* Concrete and footing details

* Reinforcement drawings

* Drainage and civil details

* Fabrication drawings



You should understand common construction terminology and be able to determine what is actually required to build a project from the drawings and specifications provided



We do not require you to be a qualified structural engineer, but we do expect you to have enough technical understanding to confidently work with engineering information and recognise when something does not appear correct or when further information is required.



CAD Capability



CAD competency is an important part of this position.



Ideally you will be highly competent in AutoCAD or similar professional drafting software and capable of:



* Reading existing DWG drawings

* Creating drawings from sketches and mark-ups

* Modifying structural and civil drawings

* Producing plans, elevations, sections and details

* Working accurately with dimensions, levels and scales

* Managing drawing layers and layouts

* Preparing drawings suitable for review by engineers, clients and construction staff



Experience with structural steel, concrete, precast, civil infrastructure or fabrication drawings would be particularly valuable.



Experience with software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, Tekla, SolidWorks or similar packages would also be highly regarded.



Estimating Capability



You should be comfortable working with numbers and extracting information from construction documentation.



Ideally you will have experience with:



* Quantity take-offs

* Material schedules

* Bill of Quantities

* Steel quantities

* Concrete quantities

* Earthworks and civil quantities

* Comparing supplier quotations

* Building up construction costs

* Excel-based estimating

* Tender documentation



You do not necessarily need to be an experienced senior estimator, but you must have the technical ability to understand drawings and develop strong estimating skills.



Essential Requirements



* Strong construction or engineering knowledge

* Ability to confidently read **structural and civil drawings**

* CAD drafting experience

* Excellent written English

* Excellent spoken English

* Strong numerical skills

* Very high attention to detail

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills

* Excellent computer and internet research skills

* Highly organised

* Able to manage multiple priorities

* Able to work independently without constant supervision

* Comfortable communicating directly with Australian engineers, suppliers, contractors and staff

* Reliable internet connection and professional home working environment

* Available and responsive during Australian business hours, generally between 7:00am and 5:00pm AEST as required



Ideal Background



We would particularly like to hear from applicants with qualifications or experience in:



* Civil Engineering

* Structural Engineering

* Civil or Structural Drafting

* Construction Estimating

* Quantity Surveying

* Construction Management

* Structural Steel Detailing

* Precast Concrete

* Civil Infrastructure

* Building or Engineering Design



Previous experience working remotely for an Australian construction, engineering or manufacturing company would be highly regarded.



The Person We Want



We are ultimately looking for someone who can become a technical right-hand person to the business owner.



The objective of this position is to take work off the owner's desk.



You will suit this role if you:



* Can look at a set of drawings and understand what is being built

* Notice details and inconsistencies that other people miss

* Can complete a take-off accurately

* Are comfortable working with technical information

* Can turn a sketch or mark-up into a professional CAD drawing

* Ask intelligent questions when something does not make sense

* Can investigate a problem and come back with an answer

* Keep track of outstanding tasks without needing constant reminders

* Are comfortable moving between estimating, drafting, projects and administration

* Take ownership of tasks and follow them through to completion

* Want to understand how the entire business operates rather than perform one narrow function



We don't expect you to know everything immediately.



We do expect you to have a solid technical foundation in construction and the ability and willingness to learn quickly.



Working Hours



This is intended to be a full-time, long-term remote position based in the Philippines.



Because you will be working directly with an Australian business owner, you must be available and responsive during our working day, generally between 7:00am and 5:00pm Australian Eastern Time (AEST/AEDT).



Exact normal working hours can be agreed with the successful applicant, but substantial overlap with Australian business hours is essential.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your CV/resume

2. A short introduction explaining your construction and technical experience

3. Details of your estimating and quantity take-off experience

4. Details of your CAD experience and the software packages you use

5. Examples of structural, civil or construction drawings you have personally produced

6. Examples of estimates or quantity take-offs you have completed, if available

7. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

8. Your availability to commence



 directly to 



Important: Please describe one construction project where you personally had to read engineering drawings and either prepare a quantity take-off, estimate or CAD drawing.



Applicants who cannot demonstrate genuine construction drawing and CAD experience are unlikely to be suitable for this position.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short practical test involving construction drawings, quantity take-off and CAD drafting.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term role who can develop into a key technical and administrative support person within the business.

title: Operations & Bookkeeping Assistant — Long-Term, Part-Time to Full-Time, Growth to Team Lead (US Company)
description:
Job description (paste below this line)

Operations & Bookkeeping Assistant — we're building a team, and you'd be the first hire



We run a computer and phone repair company with two retail locations in Michigan, USA, plus a growing managed IT services side of the business. Small team, real customers, real numbers to keep straight.



We're hiring our first virtual assistant. Not a temporary one. We're looking for the person who becomes the operational backbone of this business, and who — if it goes the way we intend — is managing a small team of assistants under them within a year or two.



If you want a job where you do the same three tasks forever, this isn't it. If you want to be handed more responsibility every quarter and grow into leading people, keep reading.



Let's get the AI question out of the way



We use AI heavily. Every day. We're going to keep using it, and we'll expect you to use it too — we'll teach you if you're new to it.



We are not hiring you to replace you later. That's not the plan and it's not the math. Every process we automate frees you up for higher-value work, and the more we automate, the more work we can take on together. AI makes our small team capable of doing what a much bigger team does. It doesn't make the people unnecessary — it makes them worth more.



If you're excited about working alongside AI tools rather than worried about them, you'll fit here.



What you'll own, starting out



The core of this role is making sure the numbers are right and the money comes in.



Monthly true-ups — reconciling what we billed against what we delivered, across both locations, and flagging discrepancies

Invoice tracking — making sure every invoice we've issued gets paid, and every invoice we owe gets paid on time

Accounts receivable follow-up — professional, persistent follow-up on unpaid balances until they close

Inventory report verification — double-checking inventory counts and reports against what the system says, and chasing down the differences

General admin — data cleanup, list maintenance, keeping our service catalog and documentation accurate

Research projects — supplier sourcing, vendor comparisons, and other work where you go find answers and bring back a recommendation

What you'll grow into (in this order)

Customer communication —
 and SMS follow-up, making sure nothing from a customer goes unanswered, quote follow-ups, review requests. You'll start by drafting for our approval and move to sending on your own as trust builds.

Full bookkeeping — categorization, reconciliation, month-end close prep, working directly with our accountant

Process ownership — you write the SOPs for everything you learn, and those SOPs become how we train the next person

Team lead — hiring, onboarding, and managing additional assistants, with a pay increase to match



Step 4 is the actual goal. We're telling you that up front because we want someone who's aiming at it.



Who we're looking for



Required:



Strong with numbers. You should be genuinely comfortable in spreadsheets, reconciling two sources that don't match, and finding out why.

Excellent written English. You'll eventually be writing directly to US customers and chasing US businesses for payment. Your writing needs to be clean and professional.

2+ years working with a US-based or Western company

Detail-obsessed. This role is fundamentally about catching things other people missed.

The instinct to flag a problem rather than quietly work around it

Reliable computer, backup internet, backup power, quiet workspace

Willing to complete an NBI clearance and reference check before starting

Willing to be on camera for video calls



Strongly preferred:



Bookkeeping, AR/collections, or accounting experience (QuickBooks especially)

Experience with inventory or POS systems

Experience using AI tools in your actual work — tell us specifically how

Retail, repair shop, IT services, or MSP background



Not required: a specific degree, or prior "VA" job titles. We care what you can do.



The arrangement

Start: 20 hours/week, $600/month

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00pm–1:00am Manila time (that's 9am–1pm US Eastern, so we overlap for our morning). Flexible on the exact window if you have a strong reason — tell us what works.

After 60 days, assuming it's going well: full-time at $1,200–$1,400/month

13th month pay included

Annual increases, plus a significant raise when you step into team lead

Paid on time, every time, via Wise. We are not going to make you chase us for your own money — that would be a strange way to run a company that's asking you to chase other people for ours.

You'll work directly with the owner. No layers, no middle manager, no agency taking a cut of your pay.

HOW TO APPLY



Applications missing any of these steps get deleted without being read. This is the first test.



1. Start your application with the words "orange slices".



2. Answer these in writing, in your own words. Do not use AI to write your answers — we'll ask you about them live, and it's obvious when the two don't match.



Which US or Western company have you worked for, in what role, and for how long?

Our system says we sold 42 screen replacements last month. Our inventory report says we used 47 screens. Our purchase records show we bought 40. Walk me through how you'd figure out what's going on. What questions would you ask first?

A business customer owes us $1,840, it's 45 days overdue, they've ignored two
s, and they're a repeat customer we want to keep. Write the exact message you'd send next.

What's the most useful thing you've ever automated or improved at a job? What was it like before, what did you change, and how did you know it worked?

What AI tools have you used, and for what? Be specific. "ChatGPT sometimes" is not an answer.



3. Record a 60–90 second video (phone camera is fine) telling us: why this role interests you, and which part of it you think would be hardest for you.



4. Send a screenshot of your internet speed test, and tell us your backup power situation.



We read every complete application and reply to everyone we shortlist.

description:

when needed to make the video more engaging.

title: Real Estate Lead List Builder & Data Research VA – PropStream / DealMachine
description:
We are a growing roofing and restoration company in Colorado looking for a highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to build, clean, and maintain targeted homeowner lead lists for our outbound sales team.

This is NOT a cold calling position.



Your responsibility will be to make sure our cold callers are working from accurate, high-quality data instead of wasting time calling bad, duplicate, disconnected, or irrelevant numbers.

You will work primarily with PropStream and DealMachine to identify homeowners within specific geographic areas that we provide.



Responsibilities include:

• Building targeted homeowner lists using PropStream and DealMachine

• Searching specific neighborhoods, ZIP codes, addresses, and geographic target areas

• Identifying appropriate residential properties and property owners

• Skip tracing property owners to obtain contact information

• Cleaning and organizing raw lead data

• Removing duplicate records

• Identifying and removing obviously incorrect or unusable phone numbers

• Separating mobile, landline, and potentially invalid numbers when possible

• Cross-referencing records between multiple data sources

• Maintaining organized Google Sheets/CSV lead databases

• Tracking where each lead and phone number came from

• Preparing clean calling lists for a separate cold calling team



Accuracy is more important than simply producing a large number of records.

We recently tested outbound calling with lists where too many phone numbers were disconnected, invalid, or associated with the wrong person. The person hired for this position will be responsible for significantly improving the quality of the data before it ever reaches our callers.



Ideal candidate:

• Previous PropStream experience strongly preferred

• Previous DealMachine experience strongly preferred

• Experience with real estate lead generation or property research

• Experience with skip tracing and phone-number verification

• Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

• Extremely detail-oriented

• Understands deduplication and database cleanup

• Comfortable researching individual properties when information conflicts

• Able to follow detailed targeting criteria without adding irrelevant properties



Roofing experience is NOT required. Real estate/property-data experience is much more important.



Performance will be measured by:

• Percentage of records containing usable contact information

• Low duplicate rate

• Low wrong-number/disconnected-number rate

• Accuracy of property-owner information

• Ability to follow geographic/property targeting criteria

• Number of clean, call-ready records produced



When applying, please answer the following:



-How long have you used PropStream?

-How long have you used DealMachine?

-What skip-tracing tools have you used?



Describe how you would verify whether a phone number belongs to the correct property owner.

-If I gave you 1,000 raw property records, what steps would you take before handing the list to a cold caller?

-Approximately how many clean, verified homeowner records could you prepare in a 4-hour shift?



Please start your application with the words “CLEAN DATA” so I know you read the entire posting.

Candidates who perform well will have the opportunity for increased hours and long-term work.

title: Contract Support Specialist
description:
About Team Integrity Knowledge Center (TIKC) & Integrity Global Logistics (IGL)

Team Integrity Knowledge Center (TIKC) is a premier government contracting consulting and education firm that helps small businesses build, grow, and scale through strategic positioning, certifications, and contract readiness.

Integrity Global Logistics (IGL) is a minority women-owned logistics firm delivering transportation and supply chain solutions within the government and commercial sectors.



Together, these organizations operate at the intersection of strategy, execution, and opportunity, supporting businesses and agencies in navigating the government marketplace.



Both companies bid. This role exists to make sure every bid we pursue is found early, tracked accurately, built compliantly, and submitted on time.



Role Overview

We are seeking a Contract Support Specialist to own the mechanics of our government contracting pipeline across TIKC and IGL. This is a process, compliance, and deadline role, the operational engine behind capture.

You will monitor federal, state, and local procurement portals for qualifying opportunities, maintain the pipeline of active pursuits, build compliance matrices from solicitations, assemble proposal volumes and required documentation, coordinate teaming partner submissions, and manage the submission process end to end.

Capture strategy, pricing, and customer relationships are owned by executive leadership. Your success is measured by whether we identify the right opportunities early, submit complete and compliant packages, and never miss a deadline.

Key Responsibilities



Opportunity Identification & Pipeline Management

Monitor 
, BidBuy, GovCon iSurce, agency forecasts, and state and local portals daily for opportunities matching our NAICS codes, certifications, and capabilities

Screen and summarize opportunities for leadership go/no-go decisions, flagging set-aside status, incumbent history, and eligibility requirements

Maintain a single source-of-truth pipeline tracker with due dates, stage, decision status, and owner for every active pursuit

Track agency forecasts, sources sought notices, and RFIs to surface opportunities before solicitation release

Manage and maintain registrations and profiles across procurement portals and vendor systems



Solicitation Analysis & Compliance

Break down solicitations into a compliance matrix mapping every requirement to a response location, owner, and due date

Identify submission requirements early: page limits, formatting rules, required forms, certifications, portal specifications, and question deadlines

Draft and submit clarifying questions to contracting officers within posted deadlines

Perform final compliance review against the matrix before every submission; by confirm zero open items

Track amendments and modifications and communicate changes to all contributors immediately



Proposal Development Support

Effectively communicate with the proposal writing team

Coordinate teaming partner and subcontractor documentation, including letters of intent, agreements, and past performance submissions

Manage submission logistics through award notification, including portal upload, confirmation, and receipt documentation

Post-Submission & Continuous Improvement

Track submission outcomes and maintain win/loss records with debrief notes

Request and document debriefs on unsuccessful bids

Maintain and improve capture SOPs, templates, and checklists based on lessons learned

Provide leadership with regular pipeline reporting: active pursuits, upcoming deadlines, capacity risks, and win rate



Systems & Documentation

Manage capture workflows in GovCon iSource, including boards, automations, and deadline alerts

Maintain organized proposal archives and version control in Google Workspace

Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for solicitation analysis, content drafting support, and workflow efficiency

Document all capture processes and keep them current



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

On-time submission rate (100% — a late submission is a non-responsive submission)

Compliance accuracy: zero rejections for administrative or formatting non-compliance

Qualified opportunities identified per month

Pipeline accuracy and reporting timeliness

Lead time from solicitation release to internal kickoff

Bid/no-bid decision turnaround time

Content library currency: reps, certs, and past performance current at all times

Debrief capture rate on unsuccessful bids

Win rate contribution and proposal quality



Required Qualifications

Direct experience supporting government proposals, bids, or solicitation responses

Working knowledge of 
 and at least one state or local procurement portal

Demonstrated ability to read a solicitation and build a compliance matrix

Exceptional attention to detail and document control discipline

Proven ability to manage multiple hard deadlines simultaneously without slippage

Strong written communication skills in English, including editing and proofreading

Proficiency in Google Workspace and project management tools; 
 preferred

Ability to handle confidential pricing, teaming, and competitive information with discretion



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with transportation, logistics, or freight solicitations

Familiarity with FAR basics, set-aside programs, and small business certifications (8(a), WOSB, MBE, DBE, HUBZone)

Experience coordinating teaming agreements, joint ventures, or subcontractor packages

Background supporting a small business through the full bid lifecycle from identification to award

Experience with proposal content libraries and past performance databases

Familiarity with AI tools for document analysis and drafting



Ideal Candidate Traits

Deadline-driven — treats a submission date as immovable

Rigorous and checklist-oriented; finds the requirement everyone else missed

Proactive communicator who escalates risk early rather than absorbing it

Comfortable chasing contributors for inputs without being asked twice

Organized under pressure, especially in the final 48 hours before a deadline

Curious about government contracting and motivated to build expertise

Trustworthy with competitive and confidential information



Why This Role Matters

Contracts are won or lost long before award. They are lost when an opportunity is found too late to respond well, when a required form is missing, when a page limit is exceeded, or when a portal upload fails at 1:58 PM on a 2:00 PM deadline.

This role protects revenue at the point where it is most fragile. When executed well, it directly influences:

Pipeline volume — more qualified opportunities surfaced earlier

Bid quality — complete, compliant, well-produced submissions every time

Leadership capacity — executives focused on strategy, pricing, and relationships instead of document assembly

Institutional knowledge — a content library and win/loss record that compounds with every bid

Growth across TIKC and IGL — a repeatable, scalable capture process

This is not administrative support. This is the operational discipline that turns opportunity into award.

title: Product Development & Sourcing Manager
description:
About AUGO

Take life to go.



That’s what AUGO is about. For the mom whose back door is always open with kids and dogs running through. For the off-roader strapping his ATV onto the truck. For families, adventurers, and everyone in between — AUGO is built to come with you.



We’re a family-owned US e-commerce brand selling durable, practical products across home and outdoor categories — including our magnetic screen doors and retractable ratchet straps. We’ve built a strong Amazon business with thousands of 5-star reviews, selling across Amazon US and Europe, Walmart, and TikTok Shop.



We grow by launching new products. To do that at the pace we want, we need someone who can build them.



The Role

We’re looking for a Product Development & Sourcing Specialist to own everything between a product idea and a product that’s ready to launch.



The ideas are not the problem — we have more of them than we can execute. The problem is the middle: turning a direction into a complete, manufacturer-ready specification, finding the right factories, getting real quotes back, driving samples to a decision, and getting the product ready to go live on Amazon.



Our target is ten new products live every quarter. You are the person who makes that possible.



You’ll take a product idea and rough direction from our Head of R&D and carry it through specs, sourcing, quotes, negotiation, samples, and the product-side setup of the listing. You’ll direct our existing sourcing agent and deal with factories yourself.



This is not an assistant role. You are not waiting for instructions — you are the person who makes sure nothing sits.



Full-time. Reports directly to our Head of R&D.



What You’ll Own

Product Specs & Details

Develop detailed, brand-aligned product specifications — materials, colours, comfort, construction, and the features that differentiate the product — while meeting target costs, competitive pricing, and product-appropriate shipping dimensions. The Amazon size tier gets confirmed before the design is frozen, because half an inch changes the fee.



A complete spec pack within 1–2 days of approval, written so a factory can quote from it unchanged.



Manufacturer Search

Go wide, then narrow. Work Alibaba, 1688 and other channels to find and approach a large pool of factories, verify capability and capacity, and bring it down to a shortlist worth quoting.



5–8 strong, verified suppliers for each approved product within 3–5 business days.



Pricing, Landed Cost & Negotiation

Take the shortlist to real numbers. Negotiate, calculate landed cost per unit, and tell us whether the margin works. Not a quote-forwarder — the person who knows whether the number is good and pushes until it is.



Best realistic price, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and packaging all confirmed before sample approval. Quotes collected within 2–3 days.



Supplier Follow-Up

Suppliers go quiet. The job is to not let that stop anything.



No supplier question sits unanswered. Follow-ups happen daily until resolved.



Samples Through to a Decision

Order samples from the shortlist, track them, compare them against the spec, and run the revision rounds through to a final answer.



Samples ordered within 1–2 days of a decision to sample. Every change documented, every sample driven to a written approval or rejection.



Product Setup & Launch Readiness

Create and manage UPC, SKU, FNSKU and QR codes. Own packaging, inserts, warnings and labelling to AUGO’s established standards. Confirm packaging and FBA dimensions directly with the factory. Direct product images, A+ content and video — the person who knows the product’s specs and materials briefs the creative.



Organised Data & Reporting

Every product has a clear supplier comparison showing company quality, quote, specs, risks, open questions and a recommendation. An end-of-day report every working day, a weekly scorecard and KPIs, and daily contact with the Head of R&D.



Nobody should ever have to ask you where a product stands.



What Success Looks Like

•             Spec packs complete in 1–2 days and good enough to quote from unchanged



•             5–8 verified suppliers per product within 3–5 business days



•             Landed cost per unit calculated for every finalist and presented side by side



•             Every sample reaching a written decision against the spec — nothing sitting in a box



•             Products moving through the pipeline without being chased



•             The Head of R&D’s time spent on sourcing and specs measurably down



30 / 60 / 90 Day Plan

First 30 Days — Learn the Products and the System

•             Learn AUGO’s catalogue, the two hero products, and the pipeline end to end



•             Meet the sourcing agent and our active factories



•             Learn our spec format and rebuild one existing product’s spec pack from scratch



•             Understand FBA size tiers as they apply to our actual SKUs



•             Shadow a live product through at least two stages



•             The end-of-day report starts on day one



Days 31–60 — Take the Work

•             Own the specs outright. Take the product idea and direction from our Head of R&D and turn it into a complete, manufacturer-ready specification: materials and their grades, real-world dimensions and tolerances, construction and how each feature is actually built, colourways and finishes, packaging, inserts and labelling.



•             Do the work behind the spec. A direction is not a specification. You research what you don’t know, work out the parts nobody has worked out yet, and come back with something that can actually be built — and defend how you got there.



•             Catch the dimensional problems before the design is frozen, including the half inch that moves us into a worse FBA size tier.



•             Run a full search-to-shortlist cycle alone across Alibaba, 1688 and other channels — approaching factories, verifying capability and capacity, narrowing to a shortlist worth quoting.



•             Send RFQs, chase quotes to completion, and build the supplier comparison with landed cost per unit — without help



•             Reporting is running and nobody has to ask for it



Days 61–90 — Own It

•             Carry products from approval to approved sample with no chasing



•             Five to six products launched or launch-ready against forecast



•             Clear supplier and cost documentation in place



•             A credible pipeline toward the ten-product quarterly goal



Required Experience

•             Hands-on product sourcing experience — you’ve found factories yourself across Alibaba, 1688 or other channels, engaged suppliers directly, requested and compared meaningful quotes, and argued about MOQ and unit price. This is not a role for someone who has only “worked with suppliers.”



•             Experience taking a physical product from idea through to production



•             Managed a supplier relationship through at least one full production run



•             E-commerce experience — Amazon private label strongly preferred



•             Amazon Seller Central experience preferred, not required



Requirements

Required Skills

•             Sourcing. Sources efficiently across Alibaba, 1688 and other channels. Identifies and engages reliable suppliers. Requests and compares meaningful quotes.



•             Amazon listing literacy. You read a listing the way a seller does, not the way a shopper does — pulling dimensions, materials, construction and packaging detail off competitor listings and feeding it back into a spec.



•             Numeracy, genuinely. Margins, landed cost per unit, freight allocated per unit, CBM, percentages, FBA size tiers and dimensional weight. This job is arithmetic every day.



•             Clear written specifications — appropriately phased, without unnecessary complexity, and without simply transferring supplier listings into a spreadsheet.



•             Strong written English. You’ll report daily in writing and negotiate with factories in writing.



•             Reliable computer and internet connection, and daily overlap with our Head of R&D.



Who You Are

•             You figure things out. The idea and the direction come from our Head of R&D. Turning that into a real product — every part nobody has worked out yet — is on you. You go and find out rather than assume, you’re resourceful about how you get there, and what you come back with holds up.



•             Follow-through is your identity. You chase without being told to.



•             You push back on a first price. A quote is an opening position, not an answer.



•             Detail-oriented where it costs money — you catch a spec error before it becomes 2,000 defective units.



•             You balance quality, differentiation, cost and shipping practicality rather than optimising one and breaking the others.



•             Comfortable owning a pipeline, not just completing tasks handed to you.



•             Direct communicator. You flag a delay before it becomes one.



What We’ll Teach You

Our brand standards, product point of view, customer preferences, target price architecture, and the specific qualities that make a product right for our brand. Also the Amazon fee schedules and calculators, our spec templates, our existing suppliers and sourcing agent, and our internal tools and reporting rhythm.



We’re hiring for sourcing instinct and follow-through. The rest we can hand over.



Benefits

Benefits & Culture — Why You’ll Thrive at AUGO

Real Ownership

You run the product pipeline, not a task list. From spec to launch-ready, the product is yours.



Direct Line to Decision-Makers

You’ll work daily with our Head of R&D. No committees, no waiting weeks for an answer.



Paid Onboarding

We invest in training you properly rather than throwing you at the deep end on day one.



Your Work Is Visible

Every product you bring through shows up as a live listing with your fingerprints on it.



A Brand with Proven Traction

Thousands of 5-star reviews on Amazon. We’re not asking you to build from zero — we’re asking you to help us build faster.



Room to Grow

The product line and the team are both growing. So is this role.



Performance-Based Raises

Reviewed after 90 days, then annually.



Fully Remote

Work from wherever you’re most productive.



We review applications within 48 hours and reach out to qualified candidates for next steps.
